        Color[] colors = { Color.gray, Color.yellow, new Color(1f, 0.5f, 0f), Color.black };
        string[] names = { "Iron", "Gold", "Copper", "Coal" };
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        {
            var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Sphere);
            go.name = $"OreNode_{names[i]}";
            go.transform.position = new Vector3(-3 + i * 2, 0.5f, 5);
            go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = colors[i];
            nodes.Add(new OreNode { go = go, health = 100f, color = colors[i] });
        }

        // loose physics cubes (for magnet)
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            var cube = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
            cube.name = $"LooseCube_{i}";
            cube.transform.position = new Vector3(Random.Range(-4f, 4f), 0.5f, Random.Range(2f, 8f));
            cube.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * 0.3f;
            cube.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.Lerp(Color.red, Color.blue, i / 8f);
            var rb = cube.AddComponent<Rigidbody>();
            rb.mass = 0.5f;
            looseCubes.Add(cube);
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region player
    void CreatePlayer()
    {
        player = new GameObject("Proto_Player");
        player.transform.position = new Vector3(0, 1, 0);
        cc = player.AddComponent<CharacterController>();
        cc.height = 2f; cc.radius = 0.4f; cc.center = Vector3.up;

        var camGO = new GameObject("Camera");
        camGO.transform.parent = player.transform;
        camGO.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0, 1.6f, 0);
        cam = camGO.AddComponent<Camera>();
        camGO.AddComponent<AudioListener>();

        viewModelContainer = new GameObject("ViewModelContainer").transform;
        viewModelContainer.parent = camGO.transform;
        viewModelContainer.localPosition = new Vector3(0.4f, -0.3f, 0.8f);

        magnetPullOrigin = new GameObject("MagnetPullOrigin").transform;
        magnetPullOrigin.parent = camGO.transform;
        magnetPullOrigin.localPosition = new Vector3(0, 0, 1.5f);
    }
    #endregion

    #region tools creation
    void CreateTools()
    {
        // pickaxe — elongated cyan cube
        toolPickaxe = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        toolPickaxe.name = "Pickaxe";
        toolPickaxe.transform.localScale = new Vector3(0.08f, 0.08f, 0.4f);
        toolPickaxe.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.cyan;
        toolPickaxe.GetComponent<Collider>().enabled = false;
        SetupToolParenting(toolPickaxe);

        // magnet — magenta sphere
        toolMagnet = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Sphere);
        toolMagnet.name = "Magnet";
        toolMagnet.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * 0.15f;
        toolMagnet.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.magenta;
        toolMagnet.GetComponent<Collider>().enabled = false;
        SetupToolParenting(toolMagnet);

        // hammer — yellow cube
        toolHammer = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        toolHammer.name = "Hammer";
        toolHammer.transform.localScale = new Vector3(0.12f, 0.12f, 0.3f);
        toolHammer.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.yellow;
        toolHammer.GetComponent<Collider>().enabled = false;
        SetupToolParenting(toolHammer);
    }
    void SetupToolParenting(GameObject tool)
    {
        tool.transform.parent = viewModelContainer;
        tool.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
        tool.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
        tool.SetActive(false);
    }
    #endregion

    #region movement + look
    void HandleMovement()
    {
        float h = Input.GetAxis("Horizontal");
        float v = Input.GetAxis("Vertical");
        Vector3 move = player.transform.right * h + player.transform.forward * v;
        move.y = 0; move = move.normalized * moveSpeed;
        if (cc.isGrounded && Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Space)) yVel = 7f;
        yVel += Physics.gravity.y * Time.deltaTime;
        move.y = yVel;
        cc.Move(move * Time.deltaTime);
    }
    void HandleLook()
    {
        float mx = Input.GetAxis("Mouse X") * lookSens;
        float my = Input.GetAxis("Mouse Y") * lookSens;
        xRot -= my; xRot = Mathf.Clamp(xRot, -89f, 89f);
        player.transform.Rotate(Vector3.up * mx);
        cam.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(xRot, 0, 0);
    }
    #endregion

    #region tool switch
    void HandleToolSwitch()
    {
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha1)) SwitchTool(0);
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha2)) SwitchTool(1);
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha3)) SwitchTool(2);
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.G)) { MagnetDropAll(0.5f); SwitchTool(-1); }
    }
    void SwitchTool(int idx)
    {
        toolPickaxe.SetActive(false);
        toolMagnet.SetActive(false);
        toolHammer.SetActive(false);
        activeTool = idx;
        if (idx == 0) toolPickaxe.SetActive(true);
        if (idx == 1) toolMagnet.SetActive(true);
        if (idx == 2) toolHammer.SetActive(true);
    }
    #endregion

    #region tool input
    void HandleToolInput()
    {
        if (activeTool == 0) PickaxeInput();
        if (activeTool == 1) MagnetInput();
        if (activeTool == 2) HammerInput();
    }

    // === PICKAXE ===
    void PickaxeInput()
    {
        if (Input.GetMouseButton(0) && Time.time - lastSwingTime >= pickaxeCooldown)
        {
            lastSwingTime = Time.time;
            // swing visual: quick rotation punch
            StartCoroutine(SwingAnimation());
            StartCoroutine(PickaxeHit(0.2f));
        }
    }
    IEnumerator SwingAnimation()
    {
        float t = 0;
        while (t < 0.3f)
        {
            t += Time.deltaTime;
            float angle = Mathf.Sin(t / 0.3f * Mathf.PI) * 45f;
            toolPickaxe.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(-angle, 0, 0);
            yield return null;
        }
        toolPickaxe.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
    }
    IEnumerator PickaxeHit(float delay)
    {
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(delay);
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out var hit, pickaxeRange))
            yield break;

        // check ore node
        foreach (var node in nodes)
        {
            if (node.go == hit.collider.gameObject)
            {
                node.health -= pickaxeDamage;
                // flash white
                var rend = node.go.GetComponent<Renderer>();
                rend.material.color = Color.white;
                StartCoroutine(FlashBack(rend, node.color, 0.1f));
                Debug.Log($"[Proto_Tool] Hit {node.go.name}, health={node.health}");
                if (node.health <= 0) BreakNode(node);
                yield break;
            }
        }
        // push rigidbody
        var rb = hit.collider.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
        if (rb != null)
        {
            rb.AddForceAtPosition(cam.transform.forward * 5f, hit.point, ForceMode.Impulse);
            Debug.Log($"[Proto_Tool] Pushed {hit.collider.name}");
        }
    }
    IEnumerator FlashBack(Renderer rend, Color original, float delay)
    {
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(delay);
        if (rend != null) rend.material.color = original;
    }
    void BreakNode(OreNode node)
    {
        Debug.Log($"[Proto_Tool] BROKE {node.go.name}!");
        // spawn 3 small cubes
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        {
            var piece = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
            piece.transform.position = node.go.transform.position + Random.insideUnitSphere * 0.3f;
            piece.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * 0.2f;
            piece.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = node.color;
            var rb = piece.AddComponent<Rigidbody>();
            rb.mass = 0.3f;
            rb.linearVelocity = Random.insideUnitSphere * 3f + Vector3.up * 2f;
            looseCubes.Add(piece);
        }
        nodes.Remove(node);
        Destroy(node.go);
    }

    // === MAGNET ===
    void MagnetInput()
    {
        if (Input.GetMouseButton(1)) MagnetPull();
        if (Input.GetMouseButtonDown(0)) MagnetDropAll(pushForce);
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.R)) MagnetDropAll(0.5f);
    }
    void MagnetPull()
    {
        Collider[] cols = Physics.OverlapSphere(magnetPullOrigin.position, magnetRadius);
        foreach (var col in cols)
        {
            var rb = col.attachedRigidbody;
            if (rb == null || heldBodies.Contains(rb)) continue;
            if (rb.gameObject.GetComponent<CharacterController>()) continue; // skip player

            var anchor = new GameObject("MagnetAnchor");
            anchor.transform.position = magnetPullOrigin.position;
            anchor.transform.parent = magnetPullOrigin;
            var anchorRb = anchor.AddComponent<Rigidbody>();
            anchorRb.isKinematic = true;
            var sj = anchor.AddComponent<SpringJoint>();
            sj.connectedBody = rb;
            sj.autoConfigureConnectedAnchor = false;
            sj.connectedAnchor = Vector3.zero;
            sj.spring = 100f; sj.damper = 25f; sj.maxDistance = 0.01f;
            sj.breakForce = 120f;
            rb.linearDamping = 3f;
            heldBodies.Add(rb); magnetJoints.Add(sj); magnetAnchors.Add(anchor);
        }
    }
    void MagnetDropAll(float force)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < magnetAnchors.Count; i++)
            if (magnetAnchors[i] != null) Destroy(magnetAnchors[i]);
        magnetJoints.Clear(); magnetAnchors.Clear();
        foreach (var rb in heldBodies)
        {
            if (rb == null) continue;
            rb.AddForce(cam.transform.forward * force, ForceMode.Impulse);
            rb.linearDamping = 0f;
        }
        heldBodies.Clear();
    }
    void MagnetFixedLogic()
    {
        // cleanup broken joints
        for (int i = magnetJoints.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            if (magnetJoints[i] == null || magnetJoints[i].connectedBody == null)
            {
                if (i < magnetAnchors.Count && magnetAnchors[i] != null) Destroy(magnetAnchors[i]);
                if (i < heldBodies.Count) { var rb = heldBodies[i]; if (rb) rb.linearDamping = 0f; heldBodies.RemoveAt(i); }
                magnetJoints.RemoveAt(i); magnetAnchors.RemoveAt(i);
            }
        }
    }

    // === HAMMER ===
    void HammerInput()
    {
        if (Input.GetMouseButtonDown(0))
        {
            if (Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out var hit, 3f))
                Debug.Log($"[Proto_Tool] Hammer hit: {hit.collider.name} (Phase D: would Take/Pack building)");
        }
    }
    #endregion

    void OnGUI()
    {
        string[] toolNames = { "Pickaxe", "Magnet", "Hammer" };
        string active = activeTool >= 0 ? toolNames[activeTool] : "None";
        GUI.Label(new Rect(10, 10, 400, 25), $"Tool: {active} | 1=Pick 2=Mag 3=Ham G=unequip | Held: {heldBodies.Count}");
        // node health bars
        int y = 35;
        foreach (var node in nodes)
        {
            GUI.Label(new Rect(10, y, 200, 20), $"{node.go.name}: {node.health}/100");
            y += 20;
        }
    }
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c(New)/FLOW.md ==== -->
# Phase C — Data Flow & Event Architecture

## Portability Diagram

```
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  FREE — these DO NOT count as dependencies (shared infra, always available)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  GameEvents (partial)    — static event bus, every system fires/subscribes
  Singleton<T>            — base class for managers
  Singleton<UIManager>    — the ONLY singleton read allowed for L0
  GlobalEnumsAll/C        — shared enums (TagType, ResourceType, PieceType)
  SPACE_UTIL / INPUT.K    — user utility extensions
  UtilsPhaseAll/C         — shared static helpers
  BaseSellableItem etc.   — phase-b 3-MonoBehaviours/Physics/ (shared infra)
  1-Managers/             — ParticleManager lives here (shared, not _-Systems/)

  → Using ANY of these = still L0. They're project infrastructure.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════


═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  L0 — TRULY PORTABLE (zero deps on other _-Systems/ folders)
  Copy this folder to ANY Unity project → it compiles and works.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  MiningSystem/                              L0 ✅ PORTABLE │
  │                                                             │
  │  Owns: IDamageable (interface)                              │
  │  Scripts: OreNode, WeightedNodeDrop                         │
  │  Deps on other _-Systems/: NONE                             │
  │  Communicates via: GameEvents only                          │
  │    fires → OnSpawnOreRequested                              │
  │    fires → OnCreateParticleRequested                        │
  │    fires → OnOreNodeBroken, OnOreMined                      │
  │    fires → OnStaticBreakableBroken                          │
  │                                                             │
  │  Copy test: ✅ drop in empty project + subscribe events     │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  OreSystem/                                 L0 ✅ PORTABLE │
  │                                                             │
  │  Scripts: OrePiece, DamageableOrePiece, OreDataService,     │
  │    OrePiecePoolManager, OreManager, OreLimitManager,        │
  │    PhysicsLimitUIWarning, BaseBasket, OreSled,              │
  │    SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition + Ext, entities           │
  │  Deps on other _-Systems/: NONE                             │
  │    (IDamageable is in phase-b DamageSystem — FREE infra)    │
  │  Communicates via: GameEvents                               │
  │    subscribes ← OnSpawnOreRequested (spawns ore for nodes)  │

## Data Flows

### Mining a Node (Player with Pickaxe)

The player equips the pickaxe from Phase B's inventory, holds left-click. After the swing delay, `ToolPickaxe` raycasts from the camera. If the ray hits a collider whose parent has `IDamageable`, it calls `TakeDamage(damage, hitPoint)`.

**Inside OreNode.TakeDamage:** `health -= damage`. If health is still above zero, nothing else happens — the node took a hit but survived. The player sees sparks (Phase H will add hit particles). When health finally reaches zero, `BreakNode(hitPosition)` fires.

**BreakNode** is the big moment. First it picks `Random.Range(_minDrops, _maxDrops + 1)` — say 3 drops. For each drop, `UtilsPhaseC.WeightedRandom(_possibleDrops, d => d.Weight)` picks a prefab from the weighted list. Then `GameEvents.RaiseSpawnOreRequested(prefab, position, rotation, velocity, angularVelocity)` fires. The velocity is randomized: upward (2–4) + lateral spread (-1.5 to 1.5). Angular velocity is a random unit sphere direction × random magnitude (1–50).

**OrePiecePoolManager** subscribes to `OnSpawnOreRequested`. It receives the prefab GameObject, extracts `OrePiece` via `GetComponent`, looks up the pool key (`ResourceType + PieceType + IsPolished`), checks if there's a recycled piece in the queue. First time: **Instantiate**. Later: **dequeue**. Sets position, rotation, `SetActive(true)`, applies velocity and angular velocity. **Ore pieces fly out from the node, tumbling with physics.**

Then OreNode fires `RaiseCreateParticleRequested` — **ParticleManager** subscribes and Instantiates the break particle prefab at the hit point. A burst of particles plays.

Then `RaiseOreNodeBroken(position, resourceType)` fires for Phase D (update building supports above) and other future subscribers. `RaiseOreMined` fires for Phase F quest tracking. `RaiseStaticBreakableBroken` fires for Phase G save. Finally, `Destroy(gameObject)` — the node is gone.

### Selling Ore

Ore pieces on the ground can be pushed into a `SellerMachine` trigger volume. When an `OrePiece`'s Rigidbody enters the trigger, `SellerMachine.OnTriggerEnter` fires.

**Inside OnTriggerEnter:** First guard: `HasTag(markedForDestruction)` → skip (already being sold). Second guard: `attachedRigidbody == null` → skip. Then `GetComponentInParent<OrePiece>()` → found → calls `orePiece.SellAfterDelay(2f)`.

**Inside SellAfterDelay:** Detaches from magnet if held. Tags the entire GO hierarchy as `markedForDestruction` — **this prevents double-sell from multiple triggers**. Starts a coroutine that waits 2 seconds.

**After 2 seconds:** `GetSellValue()` computes `BaseSellValue × RandomPriceMultiplier` (each piece has a 0.9x–1.1x multiplier set on Start). `GameEvents.RaiseOreSold(sellValue, resourceType, pieceType, polishedPercent)` fires — **EconomyManager** (Phase A) subscribes to add money, **QuestManager** (Phase F) subscribes to track deposit progress. Then `Delete()` → `ReturnToPool` → piece deactivates, physics reset, re-tagged as Grabbable, enqueued for reuse. **The ore disappears from the world, money increases.**

### AutoMiner Spawning

AutoMiner sits at a mining node and spawns ore automatically. Each frame in `Update`: rotates the drill visual, decrements `timeUntilNextSpawn`. When it hits zero:

**TrySpawnOre:** Checks `OreLimitManager.ShouldBlockOreSpawning()` — if the physics limit is `blocked`, skip entirely. Rolls probability: `Random.Range(0, 100) <= SpawnProbability` (default 80%). If passes: `_resourceDefinition.GetOrePrefab(canProduceGems)` does a weighted random pick from the SO's ore list. `OrePiecePoolManager.SpawnPooledOre(prefab, spawnPoint.position)` spawns the ore. Timer resets with `SpawnRate × OreLimitManager.GetAutoMinerSpawnTimeMultiplier()` (1.0x normally, up to 2.0x when limited). **Ore appears at the spawn point and falls.**

### Physics Limit Warning

Every 15 seconds, `OreLimitManager.Update` counts non-sleeping `Rigidbody` entries in `OrePiece.AllOrePieces`. Based on count vs threshold: sets `OreLimitState` and fires `RaiseOreLimitChanged(state)`. **PhysicsLimitUIWarning** subscribes and switches panel visibility — `regular` = hidden, `slightlyLimited`/`highlyLimited` = soft warning (yellow), `blocked` = hard warning (red).

### Pool Lifecycle

`OrePiece.OnEnable` → add to `AllOrePieces`. `OrePiece.OnDisable` → remove from `AllOrePieces`. `ReturnToPool` → deactivate, zero physics, clear runtime state (baskets, sieve%, magnet ref, conveyor list), re-tag as Grabbable, parent under pool root, enqueue. Next `SpawnPooledOre` call with same key → dequeue instead of Instantiate. **Zero GC pressure after warmup.**

## Event Registry

| Event | Who Fires | Who Subscribes | Data |
|-------|-----------|---------------|------|
| `OnSpawnOreRequested` | OreNode.BreakNode | OrePiecePoolManager | `(GameObject prefab, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot, Vector3 vel, Vector3 angVel)` |
| `OnCreateParticleRequested` | OreNode.BreakNode | ParticleManager | `(GameObject prefab, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot)` |
| `OnOreNodeBroken` | OreNode.BreakNode | Phase D (supports), Phase G (save) | `(Vector3 pos, ResourceType type)` |
| `OnOreMined` | OreNode.BreakNode | Phase F (quests) | `(ResourceType type, Vector3 pos)` |
| `OnStaticBreakableBroken` | OreNode.BreakNode | Phase G (save) | `(Vector3 truncatedPos)` |
| `OnOreSold` | OrePiece.DelayThenSell, SellerMachine | EconomyManager (Phase A), QuestManager (Phase F) | `(float value, ResourceType, PieceType, float polished%)` |
| `OnOreLimitChanged` | OreLimitManager.Update | PhysicsLimitUIWarning | `(OreLimitState state)` |

Every connection is a GameEvent. No direct cross-system method calls. MiningSystem → OreSystem communication is purely via events. AutoMinerSystem and SellerSystem are L2 (game-specific) — they call OrePiecePoolManager and OreLimitManager singletons directly.

# Phase C — Mining & Ore System — GUIDE

## What It Looks Like When Running

You walk into a mine tunnel from the starting room. Glowing ore nodes are embedded in the walls and floor — different colors for each resource type (grey for Iron, yellow for Gold, orange for Copper, black for Coal).

Equip the pickaxe from your hotbar, hold left-click. The pickaxe swings, and after a short delay a raycast hits the node. Sparks fly from the impact point. The node takes damage. After 2-3 hits, the node shatters — 2 to 4 ore pieces fly out with random velocity, bouncing and rolling on the ground with physics. A burst of break particles plays at the impact point. The node disappears permanently.

The ore pieces on the ground are physical objects you can grab with the hand (right-click SpringJoint from Phase B) or pull with the magnet tool. Each piece has a random mesh variant and slight scale variation, plus a random price multiplier (0.9x-1.1x) so each piece is worth slightly different.

An AutoMiner machine placed at a node rotates continuously and spawns ore on a timer. 80% probability each cycle, configurable spawn rate. When too many physics objects are active (500+ moving), OreLimitManager kicks in — slows auto-miner rate, eventually blocks spawning entirely. A UI warning appears.

Push ore into a SellerMachine trigger volume — ore sits for 2 seconds, then money increases and the ore disappears (returned to the pool for reuse). OrePiecePoolManager recycles all ore — zero Instantiate/Destroy after the initial warmup. Smooth performance.

## Modifications to Earlier Phases

### Phase A — EconomyManager

EconomyManager (Phase A) should subscribe to `OnOreSold` to add money:

```csharp
// File: phase-a/_-Systems/EconomySystem/EconomyManager.cs
// ADD in Start() or Awake():

// purpose: SellerMachine and OrePiece fire this when ore is sold
GameEvents.OnOreSold += (sellValue, resourceType, pieceType, polishedPercent) =>  // ← ADD
{                                                                                  // ← ADD
    AddMoney(sellValue);                                                           // ← ADD
    DispatchOnItemSoldEvent();                                                     // ← ADD
};                                                                                 // ← ADD
```

### Phase B — ToolPickaxe (CRITICAL — mining won't work without this)

ToolPickaxe.PerformAttack must check `IDamageable` on the raycast hit and call `TakeDamage`. Without this, swinging the pickaxe at an OreNode does nothing. Also adds the `CanBreakOreIntoCrushed` check for Phase E crushable ore, and particle creation via GameEvents.

```csharp
// File: phase-b(New)/Scripts/_-Systems/ToolSystem/ToolBaseSub/ToolPickaxe.cs
// REPLACE the PerformAttack coroutine body — after the raycast hit:

// → Phase C: if this pickaxe can break ore into crushed pieces, try that first  // ← ADD
if (_canBreakOreIntoCrushed)                                                       // ← ADD
{                                                                                   // ← ADD
    OrePiece orePiece = hit.collider.GetComponent<OrePiece>();                     // ← ADD
    if (orePiece != null && orePiece.CrushedPrefab != null                         // ← ADD
        && orePiece.CrushedPrefab.GetComponent<OrePiece>() != null                 // ← ADD
        && orePiece.PieceType == PieceType.ore                                     // ← ADD
        && orePiece.TryConvertToCrushed())                                         // ← ADD
    {                                                                               // ← ADD
        GameEvents.RaiseCreateParticleRequested(                                   // ← ADD
            Singleton<ParticleManager>.Ins.GetOreNodeHitParticlePrefab(),           // ← ADD
            hit.point, Quaternion.LookRotation(hit.normal));                       // ← ADD
        yield return new WaitForFixedUpdate();                                     // ← ADD
        UtilsPhaseC.SimpleExplosion(hit.point, 0.5f, 2f, 0.5f);                   // ← ADD
        yield break;                                                               // ← ADD
    }                                                                               // ← ADD
}                                                                                   // ← ADD

// → Phase C: check IDamageable (OreNode, DamageableOrePiece)                      // ← ADD
IDamageable damageable = hit.collider.GetComponent<IDamageable>();                  // ← ADD
if (damageable != null)                                                             // ← ADD
{                                                                                   // ← ADD
    damageable.TakeDamage(_damage, hit.point);                                     // ← ADD
    GameEvents.RaiseCreateParticleRequested(                                       // ← ADD
        Singleton<ParticleManager>.Ins.GetOreNodeHitParticlePrefab(),              // ← ADD
        hit.point, Quaternion.LookRotation(hit.normal));                           // ← ADD
}                                                                                   // ← ADD
else                                                                                // ← ADD
{                                                                                   // ← ADD
    GameEvents.RaiseCreateParticleRequested(                                       // ← ADD
        Singleton<ParticleManager>.Ins.GetGenericHitImpactParticle(),              // ← ADD
        hit.point, Quaternion.LookRotation(hit.normal));                           // ← ADD
}                                                                                   // ← ADD

// → existing AddForce + PhysicsSoundPlayer code stays below                        // ← KEEP
```

## Source vs Phase Diff

| What | Original Source | Our Implementation |
|------|----------------|-------------------|
| OreNode → OrePiecePoolManager | Direct `Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Instance.SpawnPooledOre()` call | Fires `GameEvents.RaiseSpawnOreRequested` — OrePiecePoolManager subscribes. Makes MiningSystem L0 portable. |
| OreNode → ParticleManager | Direct `Singleton<ParticleManager>.Instance.CreateParticle()` call | Fires `GameEvents.RaiseCreateParticleRequested` — ParticleManager subscribes. MiningSystem doesn't import ParticleManager. |
| OreNode → SavingLoadingManager | Direct `Singleton<SavingLoadingManager>.Instance.AddDestroyedStaticBreakablePosition()` | Fires `GameEvents.RaiseStaticBreakableBroken()` — Phase G subscribes. |
| OreNode → BuildingManager | Direct `Singleton<BuildingManager>.Instance.BuildingSupportsCollisionLayers` | Fires `GameEvents.RaiseOreNodeBroken()` — Phase D subscribes for support update. |
| OreNode → SoundManager | Direct `Singleton<SoundManager>.Instance.PlaySoundAtLocation()` | Stubbed as `// Phase H:` — SoundManager is Phase H. |
| OrePiece.SellAfterDelay → EconomyManager | Direct `Singleton<EconomyManager>.Instance.AddMoney()` | Fires `GameEvents.RaiseOreSold()` — EconomyManager subscribes. Decoupled. |
| OrePiece.SellAfterDelay → QuestManager | Direct `Singleton<QuestManager>.Instance.OnResourceDeposited()` | Fires `GameEvents.RaiseOreSold()` — QuestManager subscribes (Phase F). |
| PhysicsLimitUIWarning | Static instance with `SwitchState(state)` called by OreLimitManager | Subscribes to `GameEvents.OnOreLimitChanged` — no direct call from OreLimitManager. |
| OreLimitManager → SettingsManager | Direct `Singleton<SettingsManager>.Instance.MovingPhysicsObjectLimit` | Uses `[SerializeField] int _movingPhysicsObjectLimit` — Phase H replaces with SettingsManager read. |
| AutoMiner → BuildingManager | Direct access for green/red light materials | Uses `[SerializeField] Material _greenLightMaterial/_redLightMaterial` — self-contained. |
| AutoMiner.OnEnable building logic | Complex BuildingPlacementNode finding + Pack validation | Simplified — configures from definition, turns off if no definition. Phase D completes building integration. |
| WeightedNodeDrop.OrePrefab | `OrePiece` type | `GameObject` type — MiningSystem doesn't import OrePiece. OrePiecePoolManager extracts component. |
| Original enums | PascalCase (ResourceType.Iron, PieceType.Ore) | camelCase (ResourceType.iron, PieceType.ore) per project convention |

## Systems & Testability

### Individual Systems

| System | Scripts | Decoupling | Level |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------|
| MiningSystem | IDamageable, OreNode, WeightedNodeDrop | Events only: SpawnOreRequested, CreateParticleRequested, OreNodeBroken, OreMined, StaticBreakableBroken | L0 |
| OreSystem | OrePiece, DamageableOrePiece, OreDataService, OrePiecePoolManager, OreManager, OreLimitManager, PhysicsLimitUIWarning, entities, SO_ | Subscribes: SpawnOreRequested, OreLimitChanged. Fires: OreSold, OreLimitChanged | L0 |
| AutoMinerSystem | AutoMiner | Reads: OrePiecePoolManager.Ins, OreLimitManager.Ins | L2 |
| SellerSystem | SellerMachine | Fires: OreSold. Reads: OrePiece directly | L2 |

| System | .cs Test | Manual/*.md | Needs Other Systems? |
|--------|---------|------------|---------------------|
| MiningSystem | MiningTest.md (driver) | MiningFlowTest.md | NO — fires events only |

using System;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: GlobalEnumsC — partial class extends phase-All GameEvents

/// <summary>
/// Phase C events — mining, ore lifecycle, selling, physics limit, particle creation.
/// All ore events use enums (ResourceType, PieceType), never concrete OrePiece class,
/// keeping GameEvents decoupled from any _-Systems/ folder.
///
/// OreNode fires RaiseSpawnOreRequested for each ore drop — OrePiecePoolManager subscribes.
/// OreNode fires RaiseCreateParticle — ParticleManager subscribes.
/// OrePiece fires RaiseOreSold — EconomyManager + QuestManager subscribe.
/// OreLimitManager fires RaiseOreLimitChanged — PhysicsLimitUIWarning subscribes.
/// </summary>
public static partial class GameEvents
{
    #region ore spawning — OreNode fires, OrePiecePoolManager subscribes
    // when ore spawn requested >>
    public static event Action<GameObject, Vector3, Quaternion, Vector3, Vector3> OnSpawnOreRequested;
    public static void RaiseSpawnOreRequested(GameObject prefab, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot, Vector3 vel, Vector3 angVel)
    {
        OnSpawnOreRequested?.Invoke(prefab, pos, rot, vel, angVel);
        LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnSpawnOreRequested), OnSpawnOreRequested);
    }
    // << when ore spawn requested
    #endregion
    #region particle creation — any script fires, ParticleManager subscribes
    // when particle requested >>
    public static event Action<GameObject, Vector3, Quaternion> OnCreateParticleRequested;
    public static void RaiseCreateParticleRequested(GameObject prefab, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot = default)
    {
        OnCreateParticleRequested?.Invoke(prefab, pos, rot);
        LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnCreateParticleRequested), OnCreateParticleRequested);
    }
    // << when particle requested
    #endregion
    #region ore node broken — OreNode fires, Phase D supports + Phase G save subscribe
    // when ore node broken >>
    public static event Action<Vector3, ResourceType> OnOreNodeBroken;
    public static void RaiseOreNodeBroken(Vector3 position, ResourceType resourceType)
    {
        OnOreNodeBroken?.Invoke(position, resourceType);
        LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnOreNodeBroken), OnOreNodeBroken);
    }
    // << when ore node broken
    #endregion
    #region ore mined — OreNode fires, quest tracking subscribes (Phase F)
    // when ore mined >>
    public static event Action<ResourceType, Vector3> OnOreMined;
    public static void RaiseOreMined(ResourceType resourceType, Vector3 position)
    {
        OnOreMined?.Invoke(resourceType, position);
        LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnOreMined), OnOreMined);
    }
    // << when ore mined
    #endregion
    #region ore sold — OrePiece/SellerMachine fires, EconomyManager + quest tracking subscribe
    // when ore sold >>
    public static event Action<float, ResourceType, PieceType, float> OnOreSold;
    public static void RaiseOreSold(float sellValue, ResourceType resourceType, PieceType pieceType, float polishedPercent)
    {
        OnOreSold?.Invoke(sellValue, resourceType, pieceType, polishedPercent);
        LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnOreSold), OnOreSold);
    }
    // << when ore sold
    #endregion
    #region ore limit changed — OreLimitManager fires, PhysicsLimitUIWarning subscribes
    // when ore limit changed >>
    public static event Action<OreLimitState> OnOreLimitChanged;
    public static void RaiseOreLimitChanged(OreLimitState state)
    {
        OnOreLimitChanged?.Invoke(state);
        LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnOreLimitChanged), OnOreLimitChanged);
    }
    // << when ore limit changed
    #endregion
    #region static breakable broken — OreNode fires, Phase G SavingLoadingManager subscribes
    // when static breakable broken >>
    public static event Action<Vector3> OnStaticBreakableBroken;
    public static void RaiseStaticBreakableBroken(Vector3 truncatedPosition)
    {
        OnStaticBreakableBroken?.Invoke(truncatedPosition);
        LogSubscribersCount(nameof(OnStaticBreakableBroken), OnStaticBreakableBroken);
    }
    // << when static breakable broken
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c(New)/Scripts/1-Managers/ParticleManager.cs ==== -->
// deps: Singleton<T>, GameEvents — generic particle spawner

using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// I spawn particle prefabs at world positions. I hold references to commonly used particle
/// prefabs (GenericHitImpact, OreNodeHit, BreakOreNode) so other scripts can reference them
/// via Singleton&lt;ParticleManager&gt;.Ins without each script needing its own prefab reference.
///
/// I also subscribe to OnCreateParticleRequested from GameEvents — this is how MiningSystem's
/// OreNode requests particles without importing me directly (MiningSystem is L0 portable).
///
/// Who uses me: OreNode (via GameEvents), ToolPickaxe (hit particles), Phase E machines.
/// Events I fire: none.
/// Events I subscribe to: OnCreateParticleRequested.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Managers/ParticleManager")]
public class ParticleManager : Singleton<ParticleManager>
{
    #region inspector — commonly referenced particle prefabs
    [SerializeField] GameObject _genericHitImpactParticle;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _oreNodeHitParticlePrefab;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _breakOreNodeParticlePrefab;
    #endregion

    #region public API — prefab getters
    public GameObject GetGenericHitImpactParticle() => _genericHitImpactParticle;
    public GameObject GetOreNodeHitParticlePrefab() => _oreNodeHitParticlePrefab;
    public GameObject GetBreakOreNodeParticlePrefab() => _breakOreNodeParticlePrefab;
    #endregion

    #region unity lifecycle
    /// <summary> Subscribes to OnCreateParticleRequested so portable systems can request
    /// particles without importing this class. </summary>
    protected override void Awake()
    {
        base.Awake();
        // purpose: MiningSystem's OreNode fires this to spawn break particles without importing ParticleManager
        GameEvents.OnCreateParticleRequested += HandleCreateParticle;
    }

    private void OnDestroy()
    {
        GameEvents.OnCreateParticleRequested -= HandleCreateParticle;
    }
    #endregion

    #region event handlers
    /// <summary> Handles event-driven particle creation requests. </summary>
    private void HandleCreateParticle(GameObject prefab, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot)
        => CreateParticle(prefab, pos, rot);
    #endregion

    #region public API — create
    /// <summary> Instantiates a particle prefab at the given position and rotation.
    /// Optionally scales it. Particle self-destructs when its ParticleSystem finishes. </summary>
    public void CreateParticle(GameObject particlePrefab, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation = default, Vector3 scale = default)
    {
        // → instantiate particle at position
        GameObject go = Object.Instantiate(particlePrefab, position, rotation);
        // → optionally set scale
        if (scale != default) go.transform.localScale = scale;
    }

    /// <summary> Overload taking Euler angles instead of Quaternion. </summary>
    public void CreateParticle(GameObject particlePrefab, Vector3 position, Vector3 eulerRotation, Vector3 scale = default)
        => CreateParticle(particlePrefab, position, Quaternion.Euler(eulerRotation), scale);
    #endregion
}

// deps: none — shared enums for Phase C

/// <summary>
/// What kind of raw resource this is. Iron, Gold, Copper, etc.
/// OreNode drops a specific ResourceType. OrePiece carries one ResourceType for its lifetime.
/// OreDataService maps each value to a display color. OreManager formats colored names.
/// Phase E machines filter/sort by this. Phase F quests track deposits by this.
///
/// Values use camelCase per project convention.
/// INVALID = fallback / uninitialized. broken = debris pieces.
/// slag = byproduct from smelting mixed ores. mystery = special event ore.
/// </summary>
public enum ResourceType
{
    invalid = 0,
    iron = 1,
    coal = 2,
    gold = 3,
    slag = 4,
    diamond = 5,
    emerald = 6,
    copper = 7,
    broken = 8,
    ruby = 9,
    steel = 10,
    celestite = 11,
    quartz = 12,
    amethyst = 13,
    mystery = 14
}

/// <summary>
/// What processing stage this ore piece is at. Ore → Crushed → Ingot → Plate/Rod/Pipe/etc.
/// Each PieceType has a different sell value multiplier and box volume.
/// Phase E machines convert between PieceTypes (CrusherMachine: ore→crushed, CastingFurnace: crushed→ingot).
/// OreDataService formats display names with piece type labels (drillBit→"Drill Bit").
///
/// Values use camelCase per project convention.
/// </summary>
public enum PieceType
{
    invalid = 0,
    ore = 1,
    crushed = 2,
    ingot = 3,
    plate = 4,
    gem = 5,
    pipe = 6,
    rod = 7,
    drillBit = 8,
    threadedRod = 9,
    gear = 10,
    oreCluster = 11,
    junkCast = 12,
    geode = 13
}

/// <summary>
/// Ore limit throttle state — OreLimitManager checks every 15s how many ore pieces
/// are actively moving. regular = normal spawning. slightlyLimited = AutoMiner 25% slower.
/// highlyLimited = 50% slower. blocked = AutoMiner stops entirely. PhysicsLimitUIWarning
/// subscribes to OnOreLimitChanged and shows/hides the warning panel based on this.
/// </summary>
public enum OreLimitState
{
    regular = 0,
    slightlyLimited = 1,
    highlyLimited = 2,
    blocked = 3
}

using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Contract for world objects that can be permanently destroyed and need their position
/// saved for persistence. OreNode implements this — when mined, its truncated position
/// is saved so the node doesn't reappear on load.
///
/// Phase G's SavingLoadingManager calls FindObjectsOfType&lt;ISaveLoadableStaticBreakable&gt;()
/// during save and calls GetPosition() on each. During load, it uses DestroyFromLoading()
/// on any node whose position matches a saved destroyed position.

/// </summary>
public interface ISaveLoadableStaticBreakable
{
    Vector3 GetPosition();
    void MarkStaticPositionAsBroken();

}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c(New)/Scripts/4-Utils/PhaseCLOG.cs ==== -->
// deps: ResourceDescription, GlobalEnumsC — snapshot formatters for Phase C

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Snapshot formatters targeting Phase C collections. Called by OreDataService.GetSnapshot()
/// for test logging. Each method formats one collection into a readable string.
/// </summary>
public static class PhaseCLOG
{
    /// <summary> Formats a List&lt;ResourceDescription&gt; into a readable JSON-like snapshot showing
    /// each resource type and its hex display color. </summary>
    public static string LIST_RESOURCE_DESC__TO__JSON(List<ResourceDescription> descriptions)
    {
        if (descriptions == null || descriptions.Count == 0) return "[]";
        var entries = descriptions.Select(d => new
        {
            type = d.ResourceType.ToString(),
            color = "#" + ColorUtility.ToHtmlStringRGB(d.DisplayColor)
        });
        // → manual JSON-like format for readability
        var lines = new List<string>();
        foreach (var e in entries)
            lines.Add($"  {{ type: \"{e.type}\", color: \"{e.color}\" }}");
        return "[\n" + string.Join(",\n", lines) + "\n]";
    }
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c(New)/Scripts/4-Utils/UtilsPhaseC.cs ==== -->
// deps: none — static helpers for Phase C

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Static utility methods extracted from Phase C scripts. WeightedRandom appears in 4 places
/// in the main source (OreNode, AutoMinerResourceDefinition, OrePiece sieving, OrePiece cluster).
/// Extracted here as a generic reusable method.
///
/// SimpleExplosion applies a spherical force to nearby rigidbodies — used by DamageableOrePiece
/// when it breaks from collision damage.
/// </summary>
public static class UtilsPhaseC
{
    #region weighted random
    /// <summary> Weighted random selection from a list. Sums all weights via getWeight selector,
    /// rolls Random.value × total, then scans cumulatively until the roll is reached.
    /// Returns the selected item, or default(T) if the list is null/empty.
    ///
    /// Used by: OreNode (drop prefabs), SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition (ore prefabs),
    /// OrePiece.CompleteSieving, OrePiece.CompleteClusterBreaking. </summary>
    public static T WeightedRandom<T>(List<T> items, Func<T, float> getWeight)
    {
        // → early out
        if (items == null || items.Count == 0) return default;
        if (items.Count == 1) return items[0];
        // → sum weights
        float total = 0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i++) total += getWeight(items[i]);
        // → roll
        float roll = UnityEngine.Random.value * total;
        float cumulative = 0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
        {
            cumulative += getWeight(items[i]);
            if (roll <= cumulative) return items[i];
        }
        // → fallback to last (floating point edge)
        return items[items.Count - 1];
    }
    #endregion

    #region physics helpers
    /// <summary> Applies an outward explosion force to all rigidbodies within radius of center.
    /// Used by DamageableOrePiece.TakeDamage when health reaches zero — pushes nearby objects
    /// away with a mini explosion effect. </summary>
    public static void SimpleExplosion(Vector3 center, float radius, float force, float upwardModifier)
    {
        // → find all colliders in sphere
        Collider[] hits = Physics.OverlapSphere(center, radius);
        for (int i = 0; i < hits.Length; i++)
        {
            Rigidbody rb = hits[i].attachedRigidbody;
            if (rb != null)
                rb.AddExplosionForce(force, center, radius, upwardModifier, ForceMode.Impulse);
        }
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c(New)/Scripts/5-Tests/Manual/AutoMinerVisualTest.md ==== -->
# Manual Test — Auto-Miner Visual (AutoMinerSystem)

## What This Tests

AutoMiner visual behavior: rotator spinning, ore spawning on timer, probability-based drops, light color change on toggle, and OreLimitManager throttling. This is a hands-on visual test — you watch the auto-miner work.

## Prerequisites

| Singleton | Component | Inspector Setup |
|-----------|-----------|----------------|
| OreManager | `OreManager` | Resource descriptions wired |
| OrePiecePoolManager | `OrePiecePoolManager` | OrePiece prefabs in list |
| OreLimitManager | `OreLimitManager` | `_movingPhysicsObjectLimit` = 20 (low for testing) |
| ParticleManager | `ParticleManager` | Optional |

| Asset | Type | Setup |
|-------|------|-------|
| `IronMinerDef` | `SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition` | SpawnProbability=80, SpawnRate=2, add IronOre with Weight=100 |
| `TurnOn` | `SO_Interaction` | Name="Turn On" |
| `TurnOff` | `SO_Interaction` | Name="Turn Off" |

## Setup Guide

### Step 1 — Create SO Assets

1. Right-click in Project → Create → MineMGL/SO/AutoMinerResourceDefinition → name `"IronMinerDef"`
   - SpawnProbability: 80
   - SpawnRate: 2 (seconds between spawns)
   - `_possibleOrePrefabs`: + add IronOre prefab, Weight=100

2. Create two SO_Interaction assets (if not from Phase A): `"TurnOn"` (Name="Turn On"), `"TurnOff"` (Name="Turn Off")

### Step 2 — Build AutoMiner GO

1. Create empty GO `"AutoMiner"` at position (0, 0.5, 5)
2. Add component → `AutoMiner`
3. Create child:
   - **`Rotator`** — Cylinder, scale (0.3, 1, 0.3), position (0, 1, 0). This is the spinning drill visual.
   - **`SpawnPoint`** — Empty GO, position (0, -0.5, 0) relative to AutoMiner. Ore spawns here.
   - **`LightMesh`** — Small sphere, scale (0.1, 0.1, 0.1), position (0, 0.5, 0.3). Material slot 0 = base, slot 1 = light color.

4. Wire AutoMiner fields:

| Field | Drag From |
|-------|-----------|
| `_rotator` | Rotator child (Hierarchy) |
| `_oreSpawnPoint` | SpawnPoint child (Hierarchy) |
| `_lightMeshRenderer` | LightMesh child's Renderer (Hierarchy) |
| `_resourceDefinition` | IronMinerDef SO (Project) |
| `_interactions` | Add TurnOn + TurnOff SO_Interaction (Project) |
| `_greenLightMaterial` | Any green material (Project) |
| `_redLightMaterial` | Any red material (Project) |
| `_enabled` | ✓ (checked) |
| `_canProduceGems` | ✓ (checked) |
| `_fallbackOrePrefab` | IronOre prefab (Project) |

### Step 3 — Ground + Camera

1. Ground plane at y=0
2. Camera positioned to see the AutoMiner

### Final Hierarchy

```
Scene
├── OreManager
├── OrePiecePoolManager
├── OreLimitManager
├── ParticleManager
├── Main Camera
├── Ground
└── AutoMiner
    ├── Rotator          (Cylinder)
    ├── SpawnPoint        (Empty)
    └── LightMesh         (Sphere, 2 materials)
```

## How It Works (System Flow)

**Scene loads:** AutoMiner.OnEnable sets `rotationAxis` from `_rotateZ`/`_rotateY` flags (default: Vector3.right = drill rotates around X axis). Calls `ConfigureFromDefinition()` which copies SpawnProbability=80 and SpawnRate=2 from the SO. Calls `Toggle(true)` → `TurnOn()` → sets `_enabled=true`, swaps LightMesh material slot 1 to green.

**Each frame (Update):** Calculates rotation angle: `360° / (SpawnRate × OresPerRotation) × deltaTime`. Rotates `_rotator` around `rotationAxis` by that angle — **Rotator spins continuously**. Decrements `timeUntilNextSpawn` by deltaTime. When it hits zero:

**TrySpawnOre:** First checks `OreLimitManager.ShouldBlockOreSpawning()` — if blocked, skips. Then rolls `Random.Range(0, 100) <= 80` (SpawnProbability). If passes: `_resourceDefinition.GetOrePrefab(true)` picks weighted random prefab → `OrePiecePoolManager.SpawnPooledOre(prefab, spawnPoint.position, spawnPoint.rotation)` → **ore piece appears at SpawnPoint and falls with gravity**. Timer resets: `_spawnRate × OreLimitManager.GetAutoMinerSpawnTimeMultiplier()` (1.0x normally, up to 2.0x when limited).

**Interaction (Turn Off):** Via interaction wheel or test call → `TurnOff()` → `_enabled = false`, swaps LightMesh to **red material**. Update early-returns because `!_enabled`. **Rotator stops, no more spawns.**

**OreLimitManager throttle:** With `_movingPhysicsObjectLimit = 20`, after spawning 20+ non-sleeping ore pieces, OreLimitManager sets `slightlyLimited` → spawn timer multiplied by 1.25x (slower). At 120+ pieces: `blocked` → `ShouldBlockOreSpawning()` returns true → **no spawning at all**.

## Manual Test Flow

1. **DO:** Press Play
   - **EXPECT:** **Rotator cylinder spins** around its axis. LightMesh is **green**.
   - **Behind the scenes:** AutoMiner.OnEnable → ConfigureFromDefinition → Toggle(true) → TurnOn.

2. **DO:** Wait 2 seconds
   - **EXPECT:** First ore piece **appears at SpawnPoint** and **falls to ground** with physics.
   - **Behind the scenes:** timeUntilNextSpawn reaches 0 → TrySpawnOre → probability roll passes → SpawnPooledOre.

3. **DO:** Wait 10 more seconds (5 more spawn cycles)
   - **EXPECT:** ~4-5 ore pieces on the ground (80% probability means ~1 in 5 misses).
   - **Behind the scenes:** Each cycle: probability roll, spawn or skip.

4. **DO:** In Inspector, set AutoMiner._enabled to false (uncheck checkbox)
   - **EXPECT:** **Rotator stops spinning**. No more ore spawns. LightMesh stays green (TurnOff not called yet — just _enabled toggled directly).

5. **DO:** Call `AutoMiner.Toggle(false)` via Inspector debug mode (or add a test key)
   - **EXPECT:** LightMesh turns **red**. Rotator still stopped.
   - **Behind the scenes:** TurnOff → _enabled=false, ChangeLightMaterial(red).

6. **DO:** Call `AutoMiner.Toggle(true)`
   - **EXPECT:** LightMesh turns **green**, **rotator resumes spinning**, ore starts spawning again.

### Throttle Test

7. **DO:** Change `OreLimitManager._movingPhysicsObjectLimit` to 5 in Inspector
8. **DO:** Wait for 10+ ore pieces to accumulate (don't let them sleep — nudge them)
9. **DO:** Wait 15 seconds for OreLimitManager check cycle
   - **EXPECT:** Console: `[OreTest] Ore limit state: slightlyLimited` (or higher)
   - **EXPECT:** Spawn rate noticeably slower (timer ×1.25 to ×2.0)

10. **DO:** Accumulate 50+ moving pieces
    - **EXPECT:** `Ore limit state: blocked`. **No more ore spawns** even though AutoMiner is on.

## Pitfall Warnings

- **⚠️ Pitfall #2 — Scene Instance vs Prefab:** `_rotator`, `_oreSpawnPoint`, `_lightMeshRenderer` must be dragged from **Hierarchy** (scene instances), not Project. They are children of this AutoMiner GO.
- **⚠️ Pitfall #6 — LayerMask at Nothing:** AutoMiner doesn't use LayerMask, but OreLimitManager reads from OrePiece.AllOrePieces which requires pieces to have Rigidbody.
- **⚠️ Pitfall #9 — Static Lists:** `OrePiece.AllOrePieces` survives domain reload. On 2nd Play, stale nulls may exist. OreManager handles cleanup.
- **⚠️ Pitfall #10 — Execution Order:** OrePiecePoolManager.Awake must run before OreManager.Start (OreManager reads prefab list from pool manager). Both use default execution order — Awake runs before Start, so this is safe.

## Summary Checklist

- [ ] Rotator spins continuously when enabled
- [ ] Ore spawns every ~SpawnRate seconds
- [ ] Probability roll means not every tick produces ore
- [ ] Toggle off → rotation stops, light turns red, no spawns
- [ ] Toggle on → rotation resumes, light turns green, spawns resume
- [ ] OreLimitManager slows spawn rate when many objects active
- [ ] Blocked state → zero spawns
- [ ] No NullReferenceExceptions

# Manual Test — Mining Flow (MiningSystem + OreSystem)

## What This Tests

The full mining flow from pickaxe hit to ore pieces bouncing on the ground. This is the core gameplay loop of Phase C: hit node → node health decreases → node shatters → ore pieces fly out with physics → pieces settle on ground → particles play.

## Prerequisites

| Singleton | GO Name | Component | Why |
|-----------|---------|-----------|-----|
| OreManager | `OreManager` | `OreManager` | Resource descriptions for OreDataService |
| OrePiecePoolManager | `OrePiecePoolManager` | `OrePiecePoolManager` | Spawns/recycles ore pieces |
| OreLimitManager | `OreLimitManager` | `OreLimitManager` | Physics object limit tracking |
| ParticleManager | `ParticleManager` | `ParticleManager` | Creates break particles |

| Test Script | GO Name | Why |
|-------------|---------|-----|
| `OreTest.cs` | `OreTest` | M key simulates pickaxe raycast + hit |

## Setup Guide

### Step 1 — Create Singletons

1. Create empty GO `"OreManager"` → Add Component → `OreManager`
   - `_allResourceDescriptions`: click + to add entries:

| # | ResourceType | DisplayColor (RGBA) |
|---|-------------|-------------------|
| 0 | iron | (0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1) — grey |
| 1 | gold | (1.0, 0.84, 0.0, 1) — yellow |
| 2 | copper | (0.72, 0.45, 0.2, 1) — orange |

2. Create empty GO `"OrePiecePoolManager"` → Add Component → `OrePiecePoolManager`
   - `_allOrePiecePrefabs`: we'll add prefabs after creating them (Step 3)

3. Create empty GO `"OreLimitManager"` → Add Component → `OreLimitManager`
   - `_movingPhysicsObjectLimit`: 500 (default)

4. Create empty GO `"ParticleManager"` → Add Component → `ParticleManager`
   - `_breakOreNodeParticlePrefab`: drag a particle prefab here (or leave null — event still fires, just no visual)

### Step 2 — Create OrePiece Prefab

1. Create a **Cube** in the scene → rename to `"IronOre"`
2. Scale to (0.3, 0.3, 0.3) — small ore chunk
3. Add components:
   - `Rigidbody` (default settings — mass=1, drag=0, useGravity=true)
   - `MeshCollider` → check `Convex = true`
   - `OrePiece`
4. Set OrePiece fields:

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ResourceType | iron |
| PieceType | ore |
| BaseSellValue | 1.0 |
| IsPolished | false |
| VolumeInsideBox | 0.1 |
| UseRandomMesh | false (only 1 mesh) |
| UseRandomScale | true |
| `_scaleVariance` | (0.05, 0.05, 0.05) |
| MeshFilter | Drag the MeshFilter component on this GO |
| MeshCollider | Drag the MeshCollider component on this GO |

5. **Tag**: Edit → Project Settings → Tags → add tag `"Grabbable"` if not exists → set this GO's tag to `"Grabbable"`
6. Drag `IronOre` from Hierarchy to Project panel → creates prefab
7. Delete the scene instance
8. Go to `OrePiecePoolManager` inspector → add `IronOre` prefab to `_allOrePiecePrefabs`

### Step 3 — Create OreNode

1. Create a **Sphere** in scene → rename to `"IronNode"` → scale (2, 2, 2)
2. Position: (0, 1, 8) — in front of camera
3. Add component → `OreNode`
4. Set OreNode fields:

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| `_resourceType` | iron |
| `_health` | 30 |
| `_minDrops` | 2 |
| `_maxDrops` | 4 |
| `_possibleDrops` | Click + → set OrePrefab = IronOre prefab (from Project), Weight = 100 |
| `_models` | Leave empty (sphere stays visible) |
| `_breakParticlePrefab` | Drag ParticleManager's break prefab, or null |

### Step 4 — Create Test + Ground

1. Create GO `"OreTest"` → Add Component → `OreTest`
   - `_hitDamage`: 15
   - `_maxRaycastDistance`: 50
2. Create Plane `"Ground"` at position (0, 0, 0) — scale (10, 1, 10)
3. Ensure Camera is positioned at (0, 2, 0) looking toward (0, 1, 8)

### Final Hierarchy

```
Scene
├── OreManager          (OreManager)
├── OrePiecePoolManager (OrePiecePoolManager)
├── OreLimitManager     (OreLimitManager)
├── ParticleManager     (ParticleManager)
├── OreTest             (OreTest)
├── Main Camera         (Camera)
├── Ground              (Plane, Collider)
└── IronNode            (Sphere, OreNode, SphereCollider)
```

## How It Works (System Flow)

**Scene loads:** All singletons register in Awake. OreManager.Start builds OreDataService from `_allResourceDescriptions`. OrePiecePoolManager.Awake builds the prefab lookup dictionary from `_allOrePiecePrefabs` and subscribes to `OnSpawnOreRequested`. ParticleManager.Awake subscribes to `OnCreateParticleRequested`. OreNode.Start picks a random model (if `_models` is populated) and copies `_health` to runtime.

**Player aims at node and hits M:** `OreTest.Update` detects M key → raycasts from camera forward → hits IronNode's SphereCollider → calls `GetComponentInParent<IDamageable>()` → finds OreNode → calls `TakeDamage(15, hitPoint)`. Inside TakeDamage: health drops from 30 to 15. Not zero yet → nothing else happens. Console logs the hit.

**Second M press → node breaks:** `TakeDamage(15, hitPoint)` → health drops from 15 to 0 → `BreakNode(hitPoint)` fires. Inside BreakNode:
1. **Drop count:** `Random.Range(2, 5)` → e.g. 3 drops
2. **For each drop:** `UtilsPhaseC.WeightedRandom(_possibleDrops, d => d.Weight)` picks `IronOre` prefab. Random velocity computed (upward burst + lateral spread). `GameEvents.RaiseSpawnOreRequested(prefab, pos, rot, vel, angVel)` fires.
3. **OrePiecePoolManager.HandleSpawnOreRequested** receives the event → extracts `OrePiece` from prefab → calls `SpawnPooledOre(ironOre, pos, rot)` → first time: **Instantiate** new piece → sets position + rotation → `SetActive(true)` → applies velocity/angularVelocity. **Ore pieces fly out and tumble.**
4. **Particle:** `GameEvents.RaiseCreateParticleRequested(_breakParticlePrefab, hitPosition)` → ParticleManager receives → `Instantiate(particle, position)` → **break particle burst plays**.
5. **Events:** `RaiseOreNodeBroken(pos, iron)` fires (Phase D would update supports). `RaiseOreMined(iron, pos)` fires (Phase F would track quest). `RaiseStaticBreakableBroken(truncatedPos)` fires (Phase G would save).
6. **Destroy:** `Object.Destroy(gameObject)` → IronNode disappears from Hierarchy.

**Ore pieces on ground:** Each `OrePiece.OnEnable` adds itself to `AllOrePieces`. Rigidbody physics simulates bouncing and settling. `OreManager.Update` round-robin checks one piece per frame — if position is NaN or below y=-1000, returns to pool.

**Pool recycling:** If you spawn more ore (N key) after the original pieces are returned to pool (fell out of world or sold), OrePiecePoolManager **dequeues** from the pool instead of Instantiating. No GC pressure.

## Manual Test Flow

### Test 1 — Basic Mining

1. **DO:** Press Play
   - **EXPECT:** IronNode (sphere) visible at (0,1,8). Console: `[OreTest] Ready.`
   - **Behind the scenes:** All singletons registered. OreDataService built. Pool prefab dict built.

   - **Behind the scenes:** `OreNode.TakeDamage(15, hitPoint)` → health: 30→15. Not ≤0, no break.

- **⚠️ Pitfall #8 — Dual Collider:** OreNode uses a single SphereCollider (not a trigger). No dual collider needed for mining — the pickaxe hits via raycast, not trigger.
- **⚠️ Pitfall #9 — Static Lists:** `OrePiece.AllOrePieces` is static. On 2nd Play press, stale null refs may exist. OreManager.Update handles nulls (removes them). Expected behavior.

# Manual Test — Seller Machine (SellerSystem)

## What This Tests

SellerMachine trigger volume: ore enters → 2-second delay → OnOreSold fires → ore returns to pool. Visual verification that ore disappears after delay, not instantly. Also tests that already-tagged ore and non-rigidbody objects are properly skipped.

## Prerequisites

| Singleton | Component | Inspector Setup |
|-----------|-----------|----------------|
| OreManager | `OreManager` | Resource descriptions |
| OrePiecePoolManager | `OrePiecePoolManager` | OrePiece prefabs |
| OreLimitManager | `OreLimitManager` | Default settings |

| Tag | Must Exist In | What Fails If Missing |
|-----|--------------|----------------------|
| `Grabbable` | Edit → Project Settings → Tags | OrePiece default tag. Pool reset re-tags pieces. |
| `MarkedForDestruction` | Edit → Project Settings → Tags | SellAfterDelay tags ore to prevent double-sell. HasTag/SetTag use this. |

## Setup Guide

### Step 1 — Create Singletons

(Same as MiningFlowTest.md setup — OreManager, OrePiecePoolManager, OreLimitManager)

### Step 2 — Create SellerMachine

1. Create Cube GO `"SellerMachine"` at position (3, 0.5, 5)
2. Scale: (2, 1, 2) — wide platform
3. **Keep the default BoxCollider** (physical surface — ore slides on it)
4. Create child `"TriggerZone"`:
   - Add `BoxCollider` → check **Is Trigger = true** → size (1.8, 0.5, 1.8), center (0, 0.5, 0)
   - Add `SellerMachine` component to **this child** (OnTriggerEnter needs to be on the trigger collider's GO)

**⚠️ Pitfall #8 — Dual Collider Setup:** The parent Cube has a physical collider (ore lands on it). The child TriggerZone has a trigger collider (detects ore entry). SellerMachine script goes on the **trigger child**, not the parent. If SellerMachine is on the parent, OnTriggerEnter won't fire because the parent's collider isn't a trigger.

### Step 3 — Spawn Point + Test Script

1. Create GO `"OreTest"` → Add `OreTest.cs`
2. Camera positioned to see the SellerMachine
3. Ground plane at y=0

### Final Hierarchy

```
Scene
├── OreManager
├── OrePiecePoolManager
├── OreLimitManager
├── OreTest
├── Main Camera
├── Ground
└── SellerMachine          (Cube, BoxCollider IsTrigger=false)
    └── TriggerZone        (BoxCollider IsTrigger=true, SellerMachine)
```

## How It Works (System Flow)

**Ore enters trigger:** When an OrePiece's Rigidbody enters the TriggerZone's trigger collider, Unity calls `SellerMachine.OnTriggerEnter(other)`.

**Inside OnTriggerEnter:** First checks `other.gameObject.HasTag(TagType.markedForDestruction)` — if true, skip (already being sold by another seller). Then checks `other.attachedRigidbody == null` — skip non-physics objects. Then `GetComponentInParent<OrePiece>()` — if found, calls `orePiece.SellAfterDelay(2f)`.

**Inside SellAfterDelay:** Detaches from magnet if held (`CurrentMagnetTool.DetachBody`). Tags this GO and all children as `markedForDestruction` via `SetTag(TagType.markedForDestruction)` — **this prevents other triggers (other sellers, conveyors) from double-processing this piece**. Starts coroutine `DelayThenSell(2f)`.

**2 seconds later (DelayThenSell):** `yield return new WaitForSeconds(2f)`. Checks `this != null && isActiveAndEnabled` (piece might have been recycled during delay). Calculates `GetSellValue()` = `BaseSellValue × RandomPriceMultiplier` rounded to 2 decimals. Fires `GameEvents.RaiseOreSold(sellValue, ResourceType, PieceType, PolishedPercent)` — **EconomyManager subscribes to add money, QuestManager subscribes to track deposit**. Calls `Delete()` → `OrePiecePoolManager.ReturnToPool(this)` → **piece deactivates** (SetActive false), resets all physics (zero velocity, reset drag, clear baskets, re-tag as Grabbable), parents under pool root, enqueued for reuse.

**What the player sees:** Ore slides onto the seller machine, sits there for 2 seconds, then **disappears**. Money increases (once EconomyManager subscribes to OnOreSold in the real game).

## Manual Test Flow

1. **DO:** Press Play
   - **EXPECT:** SellerMachine cube visible. Console: `[OreTest] Ready.`

2. **DO:** Press N to spawn ore, then manually nudge it toward SellerMachine (or spawn above it)
   - **EXPECT:** Ore piece lands on the seller's physical surface (the parent cube).

3. **DO:** Nudge ore into the TriggerZone area (center of the seller platform)
   - **EXPECT:** Console: nothing yet — SellAfterDelay starts a 2-second coroutine.
   - **Behind the scenes:** `OnTriggerEnter` → `SellAfterDelay(2)` → ore tagged as `markedForDestruction`.

4. **DO:** Wait 2 seconds
   - **EXPECT:** Ore piece **disappears** (deactivated, returned to pool). Console: `[OreTest] Ore sold: $1.XX, iron ore, polished: 0%`
   - **Behind the scenes:** `DelayThenSell` → `RaiseOreSold` → `Delete` → `ReturnToPool`.

5. **DO:** Press K
   - **EXPECT:** Active count decreased by 1, Pooled count increased by 1.

6. **DO:** Spawn 3 ore pieces, push all into seller simultaneously
   - **EXPECT:** All 3 disappear after ~2 seconds. 3 separate `Ore sold` console messages.
   - **Behind the scenes:** Each fires independent coroutine. No interference.

### Edge Case — Double Sell Prevention

7. **DO:** Spawn ore, push it into seller trigger, then immediately push it into a SECOND seller trigger (if you create one)
   - **EXPECT:** Only ONE sell event fires. Second seller's OnTriggerEnter checks `HasTag(markedForDestruction)` → returns early.

### Edge Case — Non-Physics Object

8. **DO:** Create a Cube with NO Rigidbody, push it into the trigger zone
   - **EXPECT:** Nothing happens. `attachedRigidbody == null` → early return.

## Pitfall Warnings

- **⚠️ Pitfall #5 — Missing Tags:** Both `Grabbable` and `MarkedForDestruction` tags must exist in Project Settings → Tags. If `MarkedForDestruction` is missing, `SetTag` will fail silently and double-sell can occur.
- **⚠️ Pitfall #8 — Dual Collider:** SellerMachine MUST be on the trigger collider's GO. If it's on the physical collider GO, OnTriggerEnter never fires. Always: physical collider on parent, trigger collider + SellerMachine on child.
- **⚠️ Pitfall #9 — Static Lists:** `OrePiece.AllOrePieces` survives Play mode restart. On 2nd press, stale entries exist but OreManager cleans them up.

## Summary Checklist

- [ ] Ore entering trigger → SellAfterDelay starts (not instant)
- [ ] 2-second delay before sell completes
- [ ] OnOreSold fires with correct sell value, ResourceType, PieceType
- [ ] Ore piece disappears (returned to pool, not destroyed)
- [ ] Active/pooled counts update correctly (K key)
- [ ] Already-tagged ore is skipped (no double-sell)
- [ ] Non-rigidbody objects are ignored
- [ ] Multiple ore pieces sell independently
- [ ] No NullReferenceExceptions

// deps: GameEvents, GlobalEnumsC, OrePiecePoolManager, OreManager, OreLimitManager, ParticleManager

using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// UI-level vertical slice test for the entire Phase C flow: mine node → spawn ore → sell ore.
/// Uses keyboard shortcuts to simulate actions without needing a player controller.
///
/// Prerequisites:
///   - OreManager (singleton, with ResourceDescriptions wired)
///   - OrePiecePoolManager (singleton, with _allOrePiecePrefabs wired)
///   - OreLimitManager (singleton)
///   - ParticleManager (singleton)
///   - At least one OreNode in the scene
///   - At least one SellerMachine trigger in the scene
///   - PhysicsLimitUIWarning (optional — for limit warning visual)
///
/// NOT required: PlayerMovement, PlayerCamera, ToolPickaxe, InventorySystem, ShopSystem.
///
/// How to test:
///   M = Simulate pickaxe hit on nearest OreNode (TakeDamage 15)
///   N = Spawn a test ore piece at camera position
///   K = Print OrePiece.AllOrePieces count + OrePiecePoolManager inactive count
///   L = Force OreLimitManager recheck
///
/// Checklist:
///   [ ] M hits node → health decreases → after 2-3 hits node shatters
///   [ ] Ore pieces fly out with random velocity on break
///   [ ] Break particle plays at hit point
///   [ ] Console: "[GameEvents] OnOreNodeBroken raised for -> N subscribers"
///   [ ] N spawns ore at camera → piece falls with physics
///   [ ] Pushing ore into SellerMachine trigger → ore disappears after 2s
///   [ ] Console: "[GameEvents] OnOreSold raised for -> N subscribers"
///   [ ] K shows correct active/inactive counts
///   [ ] With 500+ active pieces: PhysicsLimitUIWarning shows
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Tests/OreTest")]
public class OreTest : MonoBehaviour
{
    #region inspector
    [SerializeField] float _hitDamage = 15f;
    [SerializeField] float _maxRaycastDistance = 50f;
    #endregion
    #region private state
    Camera cam;
    #endregion

    #region unity lifecycle
    /// <summary> Caches camera, locks cursor, subscribes to ore events for console logging. </summary>
    private void Start()
    {
        cam = Camera.main;
        Cursor.lockState = CursorLockMode.Locked;
        Cursor.visible = false;

        // purpose: log when ore node breaks
        GameEvents.OnOreNodeBroken += (pos, type) =>
            Debug.Log($"[OreTest] Node broken at {pos}, type: {type}");

        // purpose: log when ore is sold
        GameEvents.OnOreSold += (value, rt, pt, polish) =>
            Debug.Log($"[OreTest] Ore sold: ${value:F2}, {rt} {pt}, polished: {polish:F0}%");

        // purpose: log ore limit state changes
        GameEvents.OnOreLimitChanged += (state) =>
            Debug.Log($"[OreTest] Ore limit state: {state}");

        // purpose: log particle creation
        GameEvents.OnCreateParticleRequested += (prefab, pos, rot) =>
            Debug.Log($"[OreTest] Particle created: {prefab.name} at {pos}");

        // purpose: log ore spawn requests
        GameEvents.OnSpawnOreRequested += (prefab, pos, rot, vel, angVel) =>
            Debug.Log($"[OreTest] Ore spawn: {prefab.name} at {pos}");

        Debug.Log("[OreTest] Ready. M=hit node, N=spawn ore, K=counts, L=force limit check");
    }

    /// <summary> Each frame: checks for test key presses and executes the corresponding action. </summary>
    private void Update()
    {
        // → M: simulate pickaxe hit on nearest OreNode via raycast
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.M))
        {
            if (Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, _maxRaycastDistance))
            {
                IDamageable damageable = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<IDamageable>();
                if (damageable != null)
                {
                    damageable.TakeDamage(_hitDamage, hit.point);
                    Debug.Log($"[OreTest] Hit {hit.collider.name} for {_hitDamage} damage at {hit.point}");
                }
                else
                {
                    Debug.Log($"[OreTest] Raycast hit {hit.collider.name} — not IDamageable");
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.Log("[OreTest] Raycast missed");
            }
        }

        // → N: spawn a test ore piece at camera position
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.N))
        {
            var prefabs = Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.GetAllOrePiecePrefabs();
            if (prefabs.Count > 0)
            {
                OrePiece prefab = prefabs[Random.Range(0, prefabs.Count)];
                Vector3 pos = cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * 2f;
                Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.SpawnPooledOre(prefab, pos, Quaternion.identity);
                Debug.Log($"[OreTest] Spawned {prefab.ResourceType} {prefab.PieceType} at {pos}");
            }
        }

        // → K: print counts
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.K))
        {
            int active = OrePiece.AllOrePieces.Count;
            int inactive = Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.GetInactiveCount();
            Debug.Log($"[OreTest] Active: {active}, Pooled: {inactive}, Total: {active + inactive}");
        }

        // → L: force ore limit recheck
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.L))
        {
            Singleton<OreLimitManager>.Ins.OnObjectLimitChanged();
            Debug.Log("[OreTest] Forced ore limit recheck");
        }
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-c(New)/Scripts/_-Systems/AutoMinerSystem/AutoMiner.cs ==== -->
// deps: OrePiecePoolManager, OreLimitManager, SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition, GlobalEnumsC, IInteractable (phase-a), ICustomSaveDataProvider

using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// I'm an automated ore spawner placed at a mining node. I rotate continuously and spawn ore
/// on a timer based on my SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition (probability, rate, weighted prefabs).
/// I implement IInteractable so the player can interact via the interaction wheel to turn me
/// on/off. OreLimitManager throttles my spawn rate when too many physics objects exist.
///
/// On Enable: I configure from my ResourceDefinition (SpawnProbability, SpawnRate). If no
/// definition is set, I turn off and wait for Phase D's BuildingPlacementNode to attach one.
///
/// Each frame when Enabled: I rotate the Rotator child, decrement TimeUntilNextSpawn, and
/// when it hits zero I call TrySpawnOre — probability roll + OrePiecePoolManager.SpawnPooledOre.
///
/// Phase D: BuildingPlacementNode calls SetResourceDefinition() when this is placed at a node.
/// Phase G: LoadFromSave/GetCustomSaveData for on/off persistence.
///
/// Who uses me: InteractionSystem (turn on/off), Phase D BuildingPlacementNode (attach definition).
/// Events I fire: none.
/// Events I subscribe to: none.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/AutoMiner/AutoMiner")]
public class AutoMiner : MonoBehaviour, IInteractable, ICustomSaveDataProvider
{
    #region inspector
    [SerializeField] string _objectName = "Auto-Miner Mk1";
    [SerializeField] GameObject _rotator;
    [SerializeField] bool _rotateY;
    [SerializeField] bool _rotateZ;
    [SerializeField] Transform _oreSpawnPoint;
    [SerializeField] bool _enabled = true;
    [SerializeField] int _oresPerRotation = 12;
    [SerializeField] OrePiece _fallbackOrePrefab;
    [SerializeField] bool _canProduceGems = true;
    // Phase H: [SerializeField] LoopingSoundPlayer _audioSource_Loop;
    [SerializeField] Renderer _lightMeshRenderer;
    [SerializeField] List<SO_Interaction> _interactions;
    [SerializeField] SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition _resourceDefinition;
    [SerializeField] Material _greenLightMaterial;
    [SerializeField] Material _redLightMaterial;
    [Header("--- From Resource Definition ---")]
    [Range(0f, 100f)] [SerializeField] float _spawnProbability = 80f;
    [Range(0f, 20f)] [SerializeField] float _spawnRate = 2f;
    #endregion
    #region private state
    Vector3 rotationAxis;
    protected float timeUntilNextSpawn;
    #endregion

    #region IInteractable
    public bool ShouldUseInteractionWheel() => true;
    public List<SO_Interaction> GetInteractions() => _interactions;
    public string GetObjectName() => _objectName;

    /// <summary> Handles interaction wheel selection — "Turn On" or "Turn Off". </summary>
    public void Interact(SO_Interaction selectedInteraction)
    {
        // → match interaction name to action
        string name = selectedInteraction.Name;
        if (name == "Turn On") TurnOn();
        else if (name == "Turn Off") TurnOff();
    }
    #endregion

    #region unity lifecycle
    /// <summary> Sets rotation axis from inspector flags, configures from ResourceDefinition if set,
    /// and toggles to initial enabled state. </summary>
    protected virtual void OnEnable()
    {
        // → determine rotation axis
        rotationAxis = _rotateZ ? Vector3.back : (_rotateY ? Vector3.down : Vector3.right);
        // → configure spawn params from definition if available
        if (_resourceDefinition != null)
            ConfigureFromDefinition();
        // → if no definition, turn off and wait for Phase D to attach one
        if (_resourceDefinition == null)
        {
            Toggle(false);
            return;
        }
        Toggle(_enabled);
    }

    private void Start()
    {
        timeUntilNextSpawn = _spawnRate;
    }

    /// <summary> Every frame when enabled: rotates the drill visual and decrements the spawn timer.
    /// When timer reaches zero, TrySpawnOre rolls probability and spawns via pool. Timer resets
    /// with OreLimitManager multiplier applied (slower when too many objects exist). </summary>
    protected virtual void Update()
    {
        if (!_enabled || _spawnRate <= 0f) return;
        if (_resourceDefinition == null) return;
        // → rotate drill visual
        float angle = 360f / (_spawnRate * _oresPerRotation) * Time.deltaTime;
        _rotator.transform.Rotate(rotationAxis, angle);
        // → decrement spawn timer
        timeUntilNextSpawn -= Time.deltaTime;
        timeUntilNextSpawn = Mathf.Min(timeUntilNextSpawn, _spawnRate);
        if (timeUntilNextSpawn <= 0f)
        {
            TrySpawnOre();
            // → reset timer with ore limit multiplier (slows down when many objects exist)
            timeUntilNextSpawn += _spawnRate * Singleton<OreLimitManager>.Ins.GetAutoMinerSpawnTimeMultiplier();
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region public API
    /// <summary> Sets the resource definition from BuildingPlacementNode (Phase D) after this
    /// auto-miner is placed at a node. Reconfigures spawn probability and rate. </summary>
    public void SetResourceDefinition(SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition def)
    {
        _resourceDefinition = def;
        if (def != null) ConfigureFromDefinition();
    }

    /// <summary> Turns on/off. On: starts spawning + loop sound + green light. Off: stops. </summary>
    public void Toggle(bool on)
    {
        if (on) TurnOn(); else TurnOff();
    }
    #endregion

    #region private API
    /// <summary> Copies SpawnProbability and SpawnRate from the SO definition to local fields. </summary>
    protected virtual void ConfigureFromDefinition()
    {
        if (_resourceDefinition == null) { Debug.Log("AutoMiner has no resource definition!"); return; }
        _spawnProbability = _resourceDefinition.SpawnProbability;
        _spawnRate = _resourceDefinition.SpawnRate;
    }

    /// <summary> Probability roll → if passes AND not blocked by OreLimitManager, spawns one ore
    /// piece at the spawn point via OrePiecePoolManager. Falls back to _fallbackOrePrefab if
    /// the definition returns null. </summary>
    protected virtual void TrySpawnOre()
    {
        // → check if spawning is blocked by physics limit
        if (Singleton<OreLimitManager>.Ins.ShouldBlockOreSpawning()) return;
        // → probability roll
        if (Random.Range(0f, 100f) > _spawnProbability) return;
        // → pick weighted random ore prefab from definition
        OrePiece prefab = _resourceDefinition.GetOrePrefab(_canProduceGems);
        if (prefab == null) prefab = _fallbackOrePrefab;
        if (prefab == null) return;
        // → spawn via pool
        Singleton<OrePiecePoolManager>.Ins.SpawnPooledOre(prefab, _oreSpawnPoint.position, _oreSpawnPoint.rotation);
    }

    /// <summary> Enables spawning, starts loop sound, sets light to green. </summary>
    protected virtual void TurnOn()
    {
        _enabled = true;
        // Phase H: _audioSource_Loop.Play();
        ChangeLightMaterial(_greenLightMaterial);
    }

    /// <summary> Disables spawning, pauses loop sound, sets light to red. </summary>
    protected virtual void TurnOff()
    {
        _enabled = false;
        // Phase H: _audioSource_Loop.Pause();
        ChangeLightMaterial(_redLightMaterial);
    }

    /// <summary> Swaps the second material slot on the light mesh to the given material (green/red). </summary>
    protected void ChangeLightMaterial(Material material)
    {
        if (_lightMeshRenderer == null || material == null) return;
        Material[] mats = _lightMeshRenderer.sharedMaterials;
        if (mats.Length > 1) mats[1] = material;
        _lightMeshRenderer.sharedMaterials = mats;
    }
    #endregion

    #region ICustomSaveDataProvider
    /// <summary> Restores on/off state from save data JSON. Called by SavingLoadingManager (Phase G)
    /// after re-instantiating this auto-miner from a save file. </summary>
    public virtual void LoadFromSave(string customDataJson)
    {
        AutoMinerSaveData data = JsonUtility.FromJson<AutoMinerSaveData>(customDataJson);
        if (data == null) data = new AutoMinerSaveData();
        Toggle(data.IsOn);
    }
    /// <summary> Returns JSON with current on/off state for saving. </summary>
    public virtual string GetCustomSaveData()
    {
        return JsonUtility.ToJson(new AutoMinerSaveData { IsOn = _enabled });
    }
    #endregion
}

# AutoMinerSystem — Vertical Slice Test

## What This Tests

AutoMiner spawning ore on a timer, configurable from SO_AutoMinerResourceDefinition, throttled by OreLimitManager. Interaction wheel turns on/off. **No player controller, no building system needed.**

- [ ] Rotator spins continuously
