using System.Collections.Generic;
using DG.Tweening;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IInteractable (InteractionSystem), ICustomSaveDataProvider (Phase G), DOTween, Singleton<BuildingManager>

/// <summary>
/// I'm a toggleable hatch on a chute building. When the player interacts via the interaction wheel
/// ("Toggle"), I DOTween-rotate two hatch parts between open and closed positions. I also swap the
/// light indicator material between green (open) and red (closed) via BuildingManager's shared materials.
/// I implement IInteractable for the interaction wheel and ICustomSaveDataProvider so the save system
/// can persist my open/closed state.
///
/// Who uses me: interaction wheel (Interact), save system (LoadFromSave/GetCustomSaveData).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Building/ChuteHatch")]
public class ChuteHatch : MonoBehaviour, IInteractable, ICustomSaveDataProvider
{
    #region Inspector Fields
    [SerializeField] bool _isClosed;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _closedObjects;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _openObjects;
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _closedRotation;
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _openRotation;
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _closedRotation2;
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _openRotation2;
    [SerializeField] Transform _rotatingPart;
    [SerializeField] Transform _rotatingPart2;
    [SerializeField] Renderer _lightRenderer;
    [SerializeField] float _rotateDuration = 0.35f;
    [SerializeField] Ease _rotateEase = Ease.OutCubic;
    [SerializeField] List<SO_InteractionOption> _interactions;
    #endregion

    #region Private Fields
    Tween rotTween;
    Tween rotTween2;
    #endregion

    #region Unity Lifecycle
    /// <summary> Sets initial rotation from serialized state (no animation on load). </summary>
    private void OnEnable() { SetDirectionFromLoading(_isClosed); }
    #endregion

    #region Toggle
    /// <summary> Animated toggle — kills existing tweens, plays sound, swaps light material,
    /// DOTween-rotates both hatch parts to open or closed position. </summary>
    private void SetDirection(bool closed)
    {
        // → kill any in-progress tweens
        rotTween?.Kill();
        rotTween2?.Kill();
        // → play toggle sound (Phase H: SoundManager)
        // Singleton<SoundManager>.Ins.PlaySoundAtLocation(_toggleSound, _rotatingPart.position);
        // → swap light indicator material
        ChangeLightMaterial(closed ? Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetRedLightMaterial() : Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetGreenLightMaterial());
        _isClosed = closed;
        // → animate both rotating parts
        Vector3 target1 = closed ? _closedRotation : _openRotation;
        Vector3 target2 = closed ? _closedRotation2 : _openRotation2;
        _closedObjects?.SetActive(closed);
        _openObjects?.SetActive(!closed);
        rotTween = _rotatingPart.DOLocalRotate(target1, _rotateDuration).SetEase(_rotateEase);
        rotTween2 = _rotatingPart2.DOLocalRotate(target2, _rotateDuration).SetEase(_rotateEase);
    }

    /// <summary> Instant set (no animation) — used on load. </summary>
    private void SetDirectionFromLoading(bool closed)
    {
        _isClosed = closed;
        ChangeLightMaterial(closed ? Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetRedLightMaterial() : Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetGreenLightMaterial());
        _closedObjects?.SetActive(closed);
        _openObjects?.SetActive(!closed);
        _rotatingPart.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(closed ? _closedRotation : _openRotation);
        _rotatingPart2.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(closed ? _closedRotation2 : _openRotation2);
    }

    /// <summary> Swaps the third material slot on the light renderer to the given material. </summary>
    private void ChangeLightMaterial(Material mat)
    {
        if (_lightRenderer == null) return;
        Material[] mats = _lightRenderer.sharedMaterials;
        if (mats.Length > 2) mats[2] = mat;
        _lightRenderer.sharedMaterials = mats;
    }
    #endregion

    #region IInteractable
    public bool ShouldUseInteractionWheel() => true;
    public List<SO_InteractionOption> GetOptions() => _interactions;
    public string GetObjectName() => "Chute Hatch";
    /// <summary> Routes "Toggle" interaction to SetDirection(!_isClosed). </summary>
    public void Interact(SO_InteractionOption selectedOption)
    {
        if (selectedOption.interactionType == InteractionType.toggle) SetDirection(!_isClosed);
    }
    #endregion

    #region ICustomSaveDataProvider (Phase G stub)
    public void LoadFromSave(string json)
    {
        var data = JsonUtility.FromJson<RoutingConveyorSaveData>(json) ?? new RoutingConveyorSaveData();
        SetDirectionFromLoading(data.IsClosed);
    }
    public string GetCustomSaveData() => JsonUtility.ToJson(new RoutingConveyorSaveData { IsClosed = _isClosed });
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/ChuteTop.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: Singleton<BuildingManager>

/// <summary>
/// I'm the top piece of a chute building. On enable, I wait one frame then raycast upward to check
/// if a Hopper building is directly above me. If so, I replace myself with the HopperChuteVersion
/// prefab (a variant with a hole for ore to fall through from the hopper).
///
/// Who uses me: scene only (auto-checks on placement).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Building/ChuteTop")]
public class ChuteTop : MonoBehaviour
{
    #region Inspector Fields
    [SerializeField] GameObject _hopperChuteVersionPrefab;
    #endregion

    #region Unity Lifecycle
    /// <summary> Starts a coroutine that waits one frame then checks for a Hopper above. </summary>
    private void OnEnable() { StartCoroutine(WaitThenCheckForHopperAbove()); }
    #endregion

    #region Check
    /// <summary> Waits end of frame, raycasts up 1m on building placement layers. If hit collider
    /// has a Hopper component in parent, converts self to hopper chute version. </summary>
    private IEnumerator WaitThenCheckForHopperAbove()
    {
        if (Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins == null) yield break;
        yield return new WaitForEndOfFrame();
        if (!enabled) yield break;
        // → raycast upward to find hopper
        Vector3 origin = transform.position + Vector3.up * 0.25f;
        if (Physics.Raycast(origin, Vector3.up, out RaycastHit hit, 1f,
            Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetBuildingPlacementRaycastLayer()))
        {
            // → check if what we hit has a Hopper component (Phase E)
            if (hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<MonoBehaviour>() != null)
            {
                // → replace self with hopper variant
                ConvertToHopperVersion();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary> Instantiates the hopper-compatible chute variant at my position/rotation
    /// and destroys myself. </summary>
    private void ConvertToHopperVersion()
    {
        Object.Instantiate(_hopperChuteVersionPrefab, transform.position, transform.rotation);
        Object.Destroy(gameObject);
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/ModularBuildingSupports.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: Singleton<BuildingManager>, GlobalEnumsD (SupportType)

/// <summary>
/// I spawn modular scaffolding legs downward from a building to the ground. On Start I raycast down
/// to find the floor (or another building's supports below me), calculate how many support segments
/// fit, then Instantiate top-piece + N middle-pieces + bottom-cap. The bottom-cap variant depends on
/// what I land on: flat ground gets a normal cap, landing on a Roller/Conveyor/Chute/Walled support
/// uses a specialized connector prefab instead.
///
/// When buildings are stacked or the wrench tool toggles supports, BuildingObject calls
/// RespawnSupports — I destroy all spawned legs and re-raycast to recalculate.
///
/// Who uses me: BuildingObject (via BaseModularSupports reference).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Building/ModularBuildingSupports")]
public class ModularBuildingSupports : BaseModularSupports
{
    #region Inspector Fields
    [SerializeField] SupportType _supportType;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _topSupportPrefab;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _middleSupportPrefab;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _bottomCapPrefab;
    [SerializeField] float _supportSpacing = 1f;
    [SerializeField] int _maxSupports = 15;
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _raycastOffset = new Vector3(0f, 0.4f, 0f);
    [Header("Connector Prefabs (landing on another support type)")]
    [SerializeField] GameObject _bottomToRollerPrefab;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _middleToRollerPrefab;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _bottomToConveyorPrefab;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _middleToConveyorPrefab;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _bottomToChutePrefab;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _middleToChutePrefab;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _bottomToWalledPrefab;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _middleToWalledPrefab;
    [Header("Offsets & Randomization")]
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _topSupportOffset;
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _middleSupportOffset;
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _bottomCapOffset;
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _minBottomCapRotation = new Vector3(-0.1f, -1f, -0.1f);
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _maxBottomCapRotation = new Vector3(0.1f, 1f, 0.1f);
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _minBottomCapScale = new Vector3(0.95f, 0.95f, 0.95f);
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _maxBottomCapScale = new Vector3(1.05f, 1.05f, 1.05f);
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _rotationOffset;
    #endregion

    #region Private Fields
    List<GameObject> spawnedSupports = new List<GameObject>();
    #endregion

    public SupportType GetSupportType() => _supportType;

    #region SpawnSupports
    /// <summary> Raycasts down from this transform, calculates segment count, instantiates
    /// top + middle + bottom-cap (or connector variant if landing on another support type).
    /// All spawned GOs are parented to this transform and tracked in spawnedSupports list. </summary>
    public override void SpawnSupports()
    {
        // → skip if supports disabled on parent building or max is 0
        if ((buildingObject != null && !buildingObject.GetBuildingSupportsEnabled()) || _maxSupports <= 0) return;

        Vector3 pos = transform.position;
        Quaternion rot = transform.rotation * Quaternion.Euler(_rotationOffset);
        // → raycast down to find ground or another support
        if (!Physics.Raycast(pos + transform.rotation * _raycastOffset, Vector3.down, out RaycastHit hit,
            _supportSpacing * _maxSupports, Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetBuildingSupportsCollisionLayers()))
            return;

        int segmentCount = Mathf.RoundToInt((hit.distance - _raycastOffset.y) / _supportSpacing) + 1;
        int count = Mathf.Min(segmentCount, _maxSupports);
        bool useTop = _topSupportPrefab != null;

        // → check what we landed on
        var hitSupport = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<ModularBuildingSupports>();
        if (hitSupport != null)
        {
            // → landing on another support — use connector prefab based on support type
            bool handled = TrySpawnConnector(hitSupport.GetSupportType(), pos, ref count, ref rot, ref useTop);
            if (!handled && hitSupport.GetSupportType() == SupportType.none) return;
        }
        else
        {
            // → landing on ground or a building with flat support type
            var hitBuilding = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<BuildingObject>();
            if (hitBuilding != null && hitBuilding.GetSupportType() != SupportType.flat) return;
            if (Mathf.RoundToInt(hit.distance / _supportSpacing) + 1 > segmentCount) count++;
            InstantiateBottomCap(hit.point, rot);
        }

        count--;
        // → spawn top piece
        if (useTop)
        {
            var top = Object.Instantiate(_topSupportPrefab, pos + transform.rotation * _topSupportOffset, rot);
            spawnedSupports.Add(top);
        }
        // → spawn middle pieces
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            pos.y -= _supportSpacing;
            var mid = Object.Instantiate(_middleSupportPrefab, pos + transform.rotation * _middleSupportOffset, rot);
            spawnedSupports.Add(mid);
        }
        // → parent all spawned supports to this transform
        foreach (var go in spawnedSupports) go.transform.parent = transform;
    }

    /// <summary> Tries to spawn a connector prefab when landing on another support type.
    /// Returns true if handled (connector spawned or early return needed). </summary>
    private bool TrySpawnConnector(SupportType type, Vector3 pos, ref int count, ref Quaternion rot, ref bool useTop)
    {
        GameObject bottomPrefab = null, middlePrefab = null;
        switch (type)
        {
            case SupportType.roller:   bottomPrefab = _bottomToRollerPrefab;   middlePrefab = _middleToRollerPrefab;   break;
            case SupportType.conveyor: bottomPrefab = _bottomToConveyorPrefab; middlePrefab = _middleToConveyorPrefab; break;
            case SupportType.chute:    bottomPrefab = _bottomToChutePrefab;    middlePrefab = _middleToChutePrefab;    break;
            case SupportType.walled:   bottomPrefab = _bottomToWalledPrefab;   middlePrefab = _middleToWalledPrefab;   break;
            case SupportType.flat:     return false; // normal ground behavior
            default:                   return false;
        }
        count--;
        if (count > 0)
        {
            if (middlePrefab == null) return true; // can't connect
            var mid = Object.Instantiate(middlePrefab, pos - new Vector3(0f, count, 0f), rot);
            spawnedSupports.Add(mid);
        }
        else
        {
            if (bottomPrefab == null) return true;
            useTop = false;
            var bot = Object.Instantiate(bottomPrefab, pos, rot);
            spawnedSupports.Add(bot);
        }
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary> Instantiates bottom cap with slight random rotation and scale for visual variety. </summary>
    private void InstantiateBottomCap(Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation)
    {
        if (_bottomCapPrefab == null) return;
        Vector3 euler = new Vector3(
            Random.Range(_minBottomCapRotation.x, _maxBottomCapRotation.x),
            Random.Range(_minBottomCapRotation.y, _maxBottomCapRotation.y),
            Random.Range(_minBottomCapRotation.z, _maxBottomCapRotation.z));
        Vector3 scale = new Vector3(
            Random.Range(_minBottomCapScale.x, _maxBottomCapScale.x),
            Random.Range(_minBottomCapScale.y, _maxBottomCapScale.y),
            Random.Range(_minBottomCapScale.z, _maxBottomCapScale.z));
        var go = Object.Instantiate(_bottomCapPrefab, position + transform.rotation * _bottomCapOffset, Quaternion.Euler(euler) * rotation);
        go.transform.localScale = scale;
        spawnedSupports.Add(go);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Respawn
    /// <summary> Destroys all spawned support GOs, clears list, re-runs SpawnSupports. </summary>
    public override void RespawnSupports(bool RespawnNextFrame = false)
    {
        if (RespawnNextFrame) StartCoroutine(DelayedRespawn());
        else RebuildSupports();
    }

    private void RebuildSupports()
    {
        if (this == null) return;
        foreach (var go in spawnedSupports) { if (go != null) Object.Destroy(go); }
        spawnedSupports.Clear();
        SpawnSupports();
    }

    private IEnumerator DelayedRespawn()
    {
        yield return new WaitForFixedUpdate();
        RebuildSupports();
    }

    private void OnDestroy()
    {
        foreach (var go in spawnedSupports) { if (go != null) Object.Destroy(go); }
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/RobotGrabberArm.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: GlobalEnumsC (ResourceType, PieceType) — game-specific

/// <summary>
/// I'm an automated arm building that grabs ore pieces from a trigger zone and moves them along
/// an arc path to a target position. I filter ore by ResourceType and PieceType. Each frame I
/// move my IK target toward the current ore piece, grab it when close enough (set kinematic),
/// then carry it along a parabolic arc to the TargetPosition. On arrival I release it and
/// select the next valid ore from my trigger zone.
///
/// I tag grabbed ore as MarkedForDestruction so other systems skip it. On release or disable
/// I restore the tag to Grabbable.
///
/// Who uses me: placed as part of a building prefab.
/// Events I fire: none. Events I subscribe to: none.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Building/RobotGrabberArm")]
public class RobotGrabberArm : MonoBehaviour
{
    #region Inspector Fields
    [SerializeField] ResourceType _filterResourceType;
    [SerializeField] PieceType _filterPieceType;
    [SerializeField] Transform _origin;
    [SerializeField] Transform _ikTarget;
    [SerializeField] Transform _targetPosition;
    [SerializeField] float _moveSpeed = 5f;
    [SerializeField] float _rotateSpeed = 10f;
    [SerializeField] float _grabDistance = 0.2f;
    [SerializeField] float _releaseDistance = 0.1f;
    [SerializeField] float _arcHeight = 0.5f;
    #endregion

    #region Private Fields
    HashSet<OrePiece> orePiecesInRange = new HashSet<OrePiece>();
    Transform targetOrePiece;
    bool isGrabbing;
    Rigidbody grabbedRigidbody;
    Vector3 grabPosition;
    float grabProgress;
    #endregion

    #region Unity Lifecycle
    /// <summary> Each frame: moves IK target toward ore, grabs when close, carries along arc,
    /// releases at target position and selects next ore. </summary>
    private void Update()
    {
        if (targetOrePiece == null) return;
        // → check range
        Vector3 toTarget = targetOrePiece.position - _origin.position;
        if (!isGrabbing && toTarget.magnitude > 3f) { DropObject(); return; }
        // → move IK toward ore
        Vector3 dir = toTarget.normalized;
        Vector3 aimPos = targetOrePiece.position - dir * 0.2f;
        _ikTarget.position = Vector3.MoveTowards(_ikTarget.position, aimPos, _moveSpeed * Time.deltaTime);
        if (dir != Vector3.zero)
        {
            Quaternion look = Quaternion.LookRotation(dir, Vector3.forward);
            _ikTarget.rotation = Quaternion.Slerp(_ikTarget.rotation, look, _rotateSpeed * Time.deltaTime);
        }
        // → grab when close enough
        if (!isGrabbing && Vector3.Distance(_ikTarget.position, targetOrePiece.position) < _grabDistance)
        {
            isGrabbing = true;
            grabbedRigidbody = targetOrePiece.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
            if (grabbedRigidbody != null) grabbedRigidbody.isKinematic = true;
            targetOrePiece.SetParent(null);
            grabPosition = targetOrePiece.position;
            grabProgress = 0f;
        }
        // → carry along arc to target
        if (isGrabbing)
        {
            grabProgress += Time.deltaTime * _moveSpeed / Vector3.Distance(grabPosition, _targetPosition.position);
            Vector3 arcPos = GetArcPosition(grabPosition, _targetPosition.position, _arcHeight, grabProgress);
            targetOrePiece.position = arcPos;
            if (Vector3.Distance(arcPos, _targetPosition.position) < _releaseDistance)
            {
                targetOrePiece.position = _targetPosition.position;
                DropObject();
                SelectNewTarget();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary> Releases any grabbed object and resets state. </summary>
    private void OnDisable() { DropObject(); }
    #endregion

    #region Grab / Drop
    /// <summary> Releases the grabbed ore — restores kinematic, clears tag, resets state. </summary>
    private void DropObject()
    {
        if (grabbedRigidbody != null) { grabbedRigidbody.isKinematic = false; grabbedRigidbody = null; }
        if (targetOrePiece != null) { targetOrePiece.gameObject.tag = "Grabbable"; targetOrePiece = null; }
        isGrabbing = false;
    }

    /// <summary> Calculates a parabolic arc position between start and end at progress t (0-1). </summary>
    private Vector3 GetArcPosition(Vector3 start, Vector3 end, float height, float t)
    {
        t = Mathf.Clamp01(t);
        Vector3 linear = Vector3.Lerp(start, end, t);
        float arc = 4f * height * t * (1f - t);
        return linear + Vector3.up * arc;
    }
    #endregion

    #region Target Selection
    /// <summary> Picks the first valid ore piece from the trigger zone that isn't grabbed
    /// by a magnet or already marked for destruction. Tags it as MarkedForDestruction. </summary>
    private void SelectNewTarget()
    {
        orePiecesInRange.RemoveWhere(o => o == null);
        var valid = orePiecesInRange.Where(o => o.GetCurrentMagnetTool() == null && !o.CompareTag("MarkedForDestruction"));
        if (valid.Any())
        {
            OrePiece pick = valid.First();
            targetOrePiece = pick.transform;
            targetOrePiece.tag = "MarkedForDestruction";
            orePiecesInRange.Remove(pick);
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Trigger Zone
    /// <summary> Adds ore entering the detection zone to candidates. </summary>
    private void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
    {
        OrePiece piece = other.GetComponent<OrePiece>();
        if (piece != null)
        {
            orePiecesInRange.Add(piece);
            if (targetOrePiece == null) SelectNewTarget();
        }
    }

    /// <summary> Removes ore leaving the detection zone from candidates. </summary>
    private void OnTriggerExit(Collider other)
    {
        OrePiece piece = other.GetComponent<OrePiece>();
        if (piece != null) orePiecesInRange.Remove(piece);
    }
    #endregion
}

using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: Singleton<BuildingManager>

/// <summary>
/// I'm a simple repeating support leg — I raycast down and spawn N copies of SupportPrefab
/// at equal spacing from my position to the ground. Used for scaffolding-style buildings.
/// Unlike ModularBuildingSupports, I don't have connector variants — just straight down legs.
///
/// Who uses me: BuildingObject (via BaseModularSupports reference).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Building/ScaffoldingSupportLeg")]
public class ScaffoldingSupportLeg : BaseModularSupports
{
    #region Inspector Fields
    [SerializeField] GameObject _supportPrefab;
    [SerializeField] float _supportSpacing = 1f;
    [SerializeField] int _maxSupports = 15;
    #endregion

    #region SpawnSupports
    /// <summary> Destroys existing children, raycasts down, spawns N repeating leg prefabs. </summary>
    public override void SpawnSupports()
    {
        // → destroy any existing children from previous spawn
        foreach (Transform child in transform) Object.Destroy(child.gameObject);
        // → check supports enabled + raycast down
        if (buildingObject != null && !buildingObject.GetBuildingSupportsEnabled()) return;
        if (!Physics.Raycast(transform.position, Vector3.down, out RaycastHit hit, 20f,
            Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetScaffoldingSupportsCollisionLayers()))
            return;
        // → calculate count and spawn
        int count = Mathf.RoundToInt(hit.distance / _supportSpacing) + 1;
        Vector3 pos = transform.position;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            Object.Instantiate(_supportPrefab, pos, transform.rotation, transform);
            pos.y -= _supportSpacing;
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Respawn
    /// <summary> Destroys and respawns all legs. Optionally waits one fixed frame. </summary>
    public override void RespawnSupports(bool RespawnNextFrame = false)
    {
        if (RespawnNextFrame) StartCoroutine(DelayedRespawn());
        else RebuildSupports();
    }

    private void RebuildSupports()
    {
        if (this == null) return;
        SpawnSupports();
    }

    private IEnumerator DelayedRespawn()
    {
        yield return new WaitForFixedUpdate();
        RebuildSupports();
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/Scripts/_-Systems/BuildingSystem/ToolBuilder_PhaseD.cs ==== -->
using UnityEngine;

// deps: BaseHeldTool (Phase B), BuildingManager, BuildingDataService, SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition
// This file REPLACES phase-b/Scripts/_-Systems/ToolSystem/ToolBaseSub/ToolBuilder.cs
// CROSS-PHASE MOD REQUIRED: BaseHeldTool (Phase B) needs protected write fields:
//   protected string toolName { set => _name = value; }
//   protected string toolDescription { set => _description = value; }
//   protected int toolMaxAmount { set => _maxAmount = value; }

/// <summary>
/// I show a ghost preview and place buildings on the world grid. When equipped from inventory,
/// my Update() runs every frame — it raycasts from the camera, snaps to the grid via
/// BuildingManager.GetClosestGridPosition, and calls BuildingManager.UpdateGhostObject to
/// position and color the ghost (green/red/orange).
///
/// Left-click (PrimaryFire) calls BuildingManager.CanPlaceObject — if valid, instantiates the
/// real BuildingObject at the ghost's position. Quantity decrements; at 0, I destroy myself.
///
/// R (Reload) rotates the ghost 90°. If the building is snapped and supports mirroring, R
/// mirrors instead. Q (QButtonPressed) cycles through alternate prefab variants.
///
/// DropItem() overrides base to instantiate a BuildingCrate instead of dropping the tool GO —
/// because a "building tool" doesn't make sense as a world object, only as a packed crate.
/// OnDisable cleans up the ghost and hides placement node previews.
///
/// Who uses me: InventoryOrchestrator (equip/switch/drop), BuildingManager (ghost + place).
/// Events I fire: RaiseBuildingPlaced (on successful placement).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Tools/ToolBuilder")]
public class ToolBuilder : BaseHeldTool
{
    #region Inspector Fields
    [SerializeField] float _useRange = 3f;
    #endregion

    #region Private Fields
    SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition definition;
    int currentPrefabIndex;
    Quaternion currentRotation = Quaternion.identity;
    int quantity = 1;
    #endregion

    #region Public API — Definition
    public SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition GetDefinition() => definition;
    public void SetDefinition(SO_BuildingInventoryDefinition def) => definition = def;
    public void SetCurrentRotation(Quaternion rot) => currentRotation = rot;
    public int GetQuantity() => quantity;
    public void SetQuantityDirect(int val) => quantity = val;

    /// <summary> Configures this tool from the building definition — copies name, description,
    /// max stack size. Called after SetDefinition. If definition is null, logs error and
    /// destroys self (corrupt save or missing mod). </summary>
    public void Setup()
    {
        if (definition != null)
        {
            // → cross-phase mod: BaseHeldTool needs protected write access for these
            toolName = definition.Name;
            toolDescription = definition.Description;
            currentPrefabIndex = 0;
            toolMaxAmount = definition.MaxInventoryStackSize;
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.LogError($"ToolBuilder doesn't have a Definition, destroying! {name}");
            Object.Destroy(this);
        }
    }

    /// <summary> Returns true if currently using the mirrored (index 1) prefab variant. </summary>
    public bool IsUsingMirroredVersion() => currentPrefabIndex == 1;

    /// <summary> Returns keybind help text shown on HUD when this tool is active. </summary>
    public string GetControlsText()
    {
        // → Phase H replaces with KeybindManager.GetBindingText
        string text = $"Drop - G\nPlace Building - LMB\nRotate - R";
        if (definition.BuildingPrefabs.Count > 1)
            text += $"\n{definition.QButtonFunction} - Q";
        return text;
    }
    #endregion

    #region Overrides — BaseHeldTool
    public override string GetEquipButtonLabel() => "Build";
    public override Sprite GetIcon() => definition != null ? definition.GetIcon() : null;
    public override int GetQty() => quantity;
    public override void SetQty(int val) => quantity = val;
    public override void AddQty(int delta) => quantity += delta;
    public override int GetMaxAmount() => definition != null ? definition.MaxInventoryStackSize : 1;

    /// <summary> Every frame while equipped: raycasts from camera to find build position,
    /// snaps to grid, updates ghost via BuildingManager, and shows placement node ghosts. </summary>
    public override void HandleActiveInput()
    {
        base.HandleActiveInput();
        if (ownerCam == null) return;
        // → get build position from camera raycast
        Vector3 buildPos = GetBuildPosition(ownerCam);
        Vector3Int gridPos = Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetClosestGridPosition(buildPos);
        // → update ghost object at grid position
        Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.UpdateGhostObject(gridPos, GetSelectedPrefab(), currentRotation, this);
        // → show placement node ghosts
        foreach (var node in BuildingPlacementNode.GetAll())
            node.ShowGhost(true, GetSelectedPrefab().GetPlacementNodeRequirement());
    }

    /// <summary> R key: rotates ghost 90°. If snapped and building supports mirror-when-snapped,
    /// mirrors instead of rotating. </summary>
    public override void Reload()
    {
        if (definition.GetMainPrefab().GetRotatingShouldMirrorWhenSnapped()
            && Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetCurrentObjectIsSnapped())
        {
            MirrorObject();
            return;
        }
        // → rotate 90° around Y axis
        currentRotation *= Quaternion.Euler(0f, 90f, 0f);
        Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.SetCurrentObjectIsSnapped(false);
    }

    /// <summary> Q key: cycles between normal and mirrored prefab variants.
    /// If only 2 prefabs, toggles 0↔1. If 3+, increments and wraps. </summary>
    public override void QButtonPressed() => CycleAlternateModels();

    /// <summary> Increments prefab index (wraps around), then destroys ghost so it
    /// rebuilds with the new prefab on next UpdateGhostObject call. </summary>
    private void CycleAlternateModels()
    {
        currentPrefabIndex++;
        if (currentPrefabIndex >= definition.BuildingPrefabs.Count)
            currentPrefabIndex = 0;
        Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.CleanUpGhostObject();
    }

    /// <summary> Toggles between index 0 and 1 specifically — used by Reload() when the building
    /// supports mirror-when-snapped. Different from CycleAlternateModels which increments. </summary>
    private void MirrorObject()
    {
        if (definition.BuildingPrefabs.Count > 1)
        {
            currentPrefabIndex = (currentPrefabIndex == 1) ? 0 : 1;
            Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.CleanUpGhostObject();
        }
    }

    /// <summary> Left-click: if ghost is green (valid placement), instantiates the real building
    /// at ghost position, decrements quantity, destroys self at 0. </summary>
    public override void PrimaryFire()
    {
        if (ownerCam == null) return;
        // → get placement position
        Vector3 buildPos = GetBuildPosition(ownerCam);
        Vector3Int gridPos = Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetClosestGridPosition(buildPos);
        // → check if placement is valid
        var result = Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.CanPlaceObject(gridPos, GetSelectedPrefab(), currentRotation,
            GetSelectedPrefab().GetRequiresFlatGround(), definition.CanBePlacedInTerrain,
            GetSelectedPrefab().GetPlacementNodeRequirement(), out BuildingPlacementNode attachedNode, this);
        if (result != CanPlaceBuilding.valid) return;
        // → instantiate real building at ghost transform position/rotation
        Transform ghostT = Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetGhostObjectTransform();
        BuildingObject placed = Object.Instantiate(GetSelectedPrefab(), ghostT.position, ghostT.rotation);
        // → attach to placement node if applicable
        if (attachedNode != null) attachedNode.AttachBuilding(placed);
        // purpose: quest tracking + save system
        GameEvents.RaiseBuildingPlaced(ghostT.position);
        // → decrement quantity (DebugManager.UnlimitedBuilding would skip this — Phase J)
        quantity--;
        if (quantity <= 0) Object.Destroy(gameObject);
    }

    /// <summary> Drop override: instead of dropping the tool GO, spawns a BuildingCrate at
    /// camera forward with the current definition and quantity. Then destroys self. </summary>
    public override void DropItem()
    {
        if (definition != null && ownerCam != null)
        {
            // → spawn crate from definition's packed prefab (or fallback)
            var crate = Object.Instantiate(
                definition.PackedPrefab ? definition.PackedPrefab : Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetBuildingCratePrefab(),
                ownerCam.transform.position + ownerCam.transform.forward * 0.5f,
                ownerCam.transform.rotation);
            crate.SetDefinition(definition);
            crate.SetQuantity(GetQty());
            // → apply forward velocity
            Rigidbody rb = crate.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
            if (rb != null) rb.linearVelocity = ownerCam.transform.forward * 5f;
        }
        // → zero quantity so inventory knows to remove slot
        quantity = 0;
        // purpose: InventoryOrchestrator removes this from slot
        GameEvents.RaiseItemDropped(this);
        Object.Destroy(gameObject);
    }

    /// <summary> When unequipped or switched away: cleans up ghost, hides placement node ghosts,
    /// hides building info UI. </summary>
    protected override void OnDisable()
    {
        base.OnDisable();
        // → hide all placement node ghosts
        foreach (var node in BuildingPlacementNode.GetAll())
            node.ShowGhost(false);
        // → clean up ghost object
        if (Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins != null)
            Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.CleanUpGhostObject();
    }
    #endregion

    #region Public API — Test support
    /// <summary> For BuildingTest.cs — simulates ghost update without a real ToolBuilder Update loop. </summary>
    public void SimulateGhostUpdate(Camera cam, Vector3Int gridPos)
    {
        Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.UpdateGhostObject(gridPos, GetSelectedPrefab(), currentRotation, this);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Unity Lifecycle
    /// <summary> Calls Setup() on start to configure from definition (if assigned in inspector
    /// or by a previous LoadFromSave). </summary>
    private void Start() => Setup();
    #endregion

    #region Private
    /// <summary> Returns the currently selected BuildingObject prefab (normal or mirrored variant). </summary>
    private BuildingObject GetSelectedPrefab() => definition.BuildingPrefabs[currentPrefabIndex];

    /// <summary> Raycasts from camera, returns hit point or camera forward * useRange. </summary>
    private Vector3 GetBuildPosition(Camera cam)
    {
        if (Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit,
            _useRange, Singleton<BuildingManager>.Ins.GetBuildingPlacementRaycastLayer()))
            return hit.point;
        return cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * _useRange;
    }
    #endregion

    #region ISaveLoadableObject (Phase G)
    public override void LoadFromSave(string json) { /* Phase G: restore definition + qty */ }
    public override string GetCustomSaveData() => "{}"; /* Phase G */
    #endregion
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: none

/// <summary>
/// I replace individual Renderer components on conveyor belt GOs with batch rendering data.
/// On enable I compute my transform matrix (TRS), add myself to the static AllConveyors list,
/// flag NeedsUpdate so ConveyorRenderer rebuilds its batches, and disable my Renderer so Unity
/// doesn't draw me individually. ConveyorRenderer then draws all conveyors in one DrawMeshInstanced call.
///
/// Who uses me: ConveyorRenderer reads AllConveyors + CachedMatrix each frame.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent")]
public class ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent : MonoBehaviour
{
    #region Inspector Fields
    [SerializeField] int _meshIndex;
    #endregion

    #region Private Fields
    Matrix4x4 cachedMatrix;
    static readonly List<ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent> allConveyors = new List<ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent>();
    static bool needsUpdate = true;
    #endregion

    #region Static API
    public static List<ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent> GetAllConveyors() => allConveyors;
    public static bool GetNeedsUpdate() => needsUpdate;
    public static void SetNeedsUpdate(bool val) => needsUpdate = val;
    #endregion

    #region Public API
    public Matrix4x4 GetCachedMatrix() => cachedMatrix;
    public int GetMeshIndex() => _meshIndex;

    /// <summary> Recalculates cached TRS matrix from current transform and flags NeedsUpdate. </summary>
    public void RefreshMatrix()
    {
        cachedMatrix = Matrix4x4.TRS(transform.position, transform.rotation, transform.lossyScale);
        needsUpdate = true;
    }
    #endregion

    #region Unity Lifecycle
    /// <summary> Computes TRS matrix, registers in static list, disables individual Renderer. </summary>
    private void OnEnable()
    {
        cachedMatrix = Matrix4x4.TRS(transform.position, transform.rotation, transform.lossyScale);
        allConveyors.Add(this);
        needsUpdate = true;
        // → disable individual renderer — ConveyorRenderer draws us via batch instancing
        var rend = GetComponent<Renderer>();
        if (rend != null) rend.enabled = false;
    }

    /// <summary> Unregisters from static list, flags NeedsUpdate. </summary>
    private void OnDisable()
    {
        allConveyors.Remove(this);
        needsUpdate = true;
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/ConveyorBelt.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: GameEvents, BasePhysicsObject (Phase B 3-MonoBehaviours/Physics/)
// CROSS-PHASE MOD: BasePhysicsObject needs AddTouchingConveyorBelt(ConveyorBelt) + RemoveTouchingConveyorBelt(ConveyorBelt)
// See GUIDE.md Modifications section #4

/// <summary>
/// I push physics objects along my forward direction using velocity injection. Any Rigidbody that
/// enters my trigger collider gets a BasePhysicsObject component (auto-added if missing), and I
/// accumulate conveyor velocity on it each FixedUpdate. ConveyorBeltManager then applies the final
/// averaged velocity in its own FixedUpdate (which runs first due to [DefaultExecutionOrder(-10)]).
///
/// I maintain a static AllConveyorBelts list so ConveyorBeltManager can round-robin clean null refs.
/// Disabled = belt stops pushing but objects remain tracked until they leave the trigger.
///
/// Who uses me: ConveyorBeltManager (cleanup + apply), BasePhysicsObject (velocity accumulation).
/// Events I fire: none. Events I subscribe to: none.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/ConveyorBelt")]
public class ConveyorBelt : MonoBehaviour
{
    #region Inspector Fields
    [SerializeField] float _speed = 0.8f;
    [SerializeField] bool _disabled;
    [SerializeField] bool _retainYVelocity;
    #endregion

    #region Private Fields
    protected List<BasePhysicsObject> physicsObjectsOnBelt = new List<BasePhysicsObject>();
    protected Vector3 pushVelocity;
    #endregion

    #region Static Registry
    static List<ConveyorBelt> allConveyorBelts = new List<ConveyorBelt>();
    public static List<ConveyorBelt> GetAllConveyorBelts() => allConveyorBelts;
    #endregion

    #region Public API
    public float GetSpeed() => _speed;
    public bool GetDisabled() => _disabled;
    public void SetDisabled(bool val) => _disabled = val;

    /// <summary> Changes belt speed and recalculates push velocity. </summary>
    public void ChangeSpeed(float newSpeed)
    {
        _speed = newSpeed;
        pushVelocity = transform.forward * _speed;
    }

    /// <summary> Adds a physics object to this belt's tracking list. Called on trigger enter. </summary>
    public void AddPhysicsObject(BasePhysicsObject obj)
    {
        physicsObjectsOnBelt.Add(obj);
        obj.AddTouchingConveyorBelt(this);
    }

    /// <summary> Removes a physics object from this belt. Called on trigger exit. </summary>
    public void RemovePhysicsObject(BasePhysicsObject obj) => physicsObjectsOnBelt.Remove(obj);

    /// <summary> Removes null, inactive, or kinematic objects. Called by ConveyorBeltManager round-robin. </summary>
    public void ClearNullObjectsOnBelt()
    {
        for (int i = physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            var obj = physicsObjectsOnBelt[i];
            if (obj == null || !obj.isActiveAndEnabled || obj.Rb.isKinematic)
                physicsObjectsOnBelt.RemoveAt(i);
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Unity Lifecycle
    /// <summary> Calculates push velocity from forward * speed, registers in static list. </summary>
    protected virtual void OnEnable()
    {
        pushVelocity = transform.forward * _speed;
        allConveyorBelts.Add(this);
    }

    /// <summary> Each fixed frame: if not disabled, accumulates conveyor velocity on all tracked objects. </summary>
    protected virtual void FixedUpdate()
    {
        if (_disabled || physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count == 0) return;
        for (int i = physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            physicsObjectsOnBelt[i].AddConveyorVelocity(pushVelocity, _retainYVelocity);
    }

    /// <summary> Removes all tracked objects' belt reference, clears list, unregisters from static list. </summary>
    protected virtual void OnDisable()
    {
        foreach (var obj in physicsObjectsOnBelt) { if (obj != null) obj.RemoveTouchingConveyorBelt(this); }
        physicsObjectsOnBelt.Clear();
        allConveyorBelts.Remove(this);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Trigger
    /// <summary> When a non-kinematic Rigidbody enters, finds or adds BasePhysicsObject and starts tracking. </summary>
    private void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
    {
        Rigidbody rb = other.attachedRigidbody;
        if (rb == null || rb.isKinematic) return;
        // → find or auto-add BasePhysicsObject
        var bpo = rb.GetComponent<BasePhysicsObject>();
        if (bpo == null) bpo = rb.gameObject.AddComponent<BasePhysicsObject>();
        if (bpo != null) AddPhysicsObject(bpo);
    }

    /// <summary> When a Rigidbody exits, removes from tracking and unlinks belt reference. </summary>
    private void OnTriggerExit(Collider other)
    {
        Rigidbody rb = other.attachedRigidbody;
        if (rb == null) return;
        var bpo = rb.GetComponent<BasePhysicsObject>();
        if (bpo != null)
        {
            physicsObjectsOnBelt.Remove(bpo);
            bpo.RemoveTouchingConveyorBelt(this);
        }
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/ConveyorBeltManager.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: Singleton<T>, BasePhysicsObject (Phase B)

/// <summary>
/// I batch-apply conveyor velocities to all registered physics objects in one FixedUpdate pass.
/// Each ConveyorBelt accumulates velocity on BasePhysicsObject during its own FixedUpdate. Then
/// I run (with [DefaultExecutionOrder(-10)] so I go first) and apply the averaged velocity to
/// each object's Rigidbody. This ensures objects on overlapping belts get a blended velocity.
///
/// I also round-robin clean null references from ConveyorBelt lists (one belt per Update frame)
/// to avoid iteration errors from destroyed objects.
///
/// Who uses me: ConveyorBelt (registers objects via static Register/Unregister).
/// Events I fire: none. Events I subscribe to: none.
/// </summary>
[DefaultExecutionOrder(-10)]
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/ConveyorBeltManager")]
public class ConveyorBeltManager : Singleton<ConveyorBeltManager>
{
    #region Private Fields
    static readonly List<BasePhysicsObject> objects = new List<BasePhysicsObject>();
    int currentBeltIndex;
    #endregion

    #region Static API
    /// <summary> Registers a physics object for batch velocity application. </summary>
    public static void Register(BasePhysicsObject obj)
    {
        if (obj != null && !objects.Contains(obj)) objects.Add(obj);
    }

    /// <summary> Unregisters a physics object (destroyed or left all belts). </summary>
    public static void Unregister(BasePhysicsObject obj)
    {
        if (obj != null) objects.Remove(obj);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Unity Lifecycle
    /// <summary> Round-robin cleans one belt per frame — removes nulls from its tracked list. </summary>
    private void Update()
    {
        var belts = ConveyorBelt.GetAllConveyorBelts();
        if (belts.Count == 0) { currentBeltIndex = 0; return; }
        if (currentBeltIndex >= belts.Count) currentBeltIndex = 0;
        var belt = belts[currentBeltIndex];
        if (belt == null) belts.RemoveAt(currentBeltIndex);
        else belt.ClearNullObjectsOnBelt();
        currentBeltIndex++;
    }

    /// <summary> Applies averaged accumulated velocity to every registered physics object's
    /// Rigidbody, then resets accumulators for the next frame. Uses BasePhysicsObject's
    /// public fields: Count, SumVelocity, RetainY, BestY, Rb, ResetAccum(). </summary>
    private void FixedUpdate()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < objects.Count; i++)
        {
            var obj = objects[i];
            if (obj.Count == 0) { obj.ResetAccum(); continue; }
            Rigidbody rb = obj.Rb;
            Vector3 vel = obj.SumVelocity / obj.Count;
            // → preserve Y if belt requests it, or use best upward Y
            if (obj.RetainY) vel.y = rb.linearVelocity.y;
            else if (obj.BestY > 0f) vel.y = obj.BestY;
            rb.linearVelocity = vel;
            obj.ResetAccum();
        }
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/ConveyorBeltShaker.cs ==== -->
using System;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: ConveyorBelt (same system)

/// <summary>
/// I extend ConveyorBelt with left-right + up-down oscillation. In addition to the normal forward
/// push velocity, I add a sine-wave sideways component (ShakeFrequency controls flip rate, ShakeSpeed
/// controls magnitude) and a vertical sine-wave. This makes ore bounce side to side as it travels,
/// useful for shaker table conveyors.
///
/// Who uses me: placed as variant of ConveyorBelt on shaker-type buildings.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/ConveyorBeltShaker")]
public class ConveyorBeltShaker : ConveyorBelt
{
    #region Inspector Fields
    [Header("Shaker Settings")]
    [SerializeField] float _shakeSpeed = 2f;
    [SerializeField] float _shakeFrequency = 2f;
    [SerializeField] float _verticalShakeSpeed = 1f;
    [SerializeField] float _verticalShakeFrequency = 3f;
    #endregion

    #region Private Fields
    Vector3 rightDir;
    Vector3 upDir;
    #endregion

    #region Unity Lifecycle
    /// <summary> Caches right and up directions on enable. </summary>
    protected override void OnEnable()
    {
        base.OnEnable();
        rightDir = transform.right;
        upDir = transform.up;
    }

    /// <summary> Each fixed frame: combines forward push + sideways sine + vertical sine. </summary>
    protected override void FixedUpdate()
    {
        if (GetDisabled() || physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count == 0) return;
        float t = Time.fixedTime;
        // → sideways oscillation (square-wave sign from sine)
        float sideSign = Mathf.Sign(Mathf.Sin(t * MathF.PI * 2f * _shakeFrequency));
        Vector3 sideVel = rightDir * (_shakeSpeed * sideSign);
        // → vertical oscillation (smooth sine)
        float vertVal = Mathf.Sin(t * MathF.PI * 2f * _verticalShakeFrequency);
        Vector3 vertVel = upDir * (_verticalShakeSpeed * vertVal);
        // → combine with forward push
        Vector3 combined = sideVel + vertVel;
        for (int i = physicsObjectsOnBelt.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            physicsObjectsOnBelt[i].AddConveyorVelocity(pushVelocity + combined, false);
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/ConveyorRenderer.cs ==== -->
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent (same system)

/// <summary>
/// I batch-render all conveyor belt visuals via Graphics.DrawMeshInstanced for performance.
/// Instead of each conveyor having its own Renderer, they register a ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent
/// which caches a Matrix4x4. I collect all matrices grouped by MeshIndex, and in LateUpdate I draw
/// them in batches of 1023 (Unity's instancing limit). When NeedsUpdate is true (a conveyor was
/// added/removed/moved), I rebuild the matrix batches from the static AllConveyors list.
///
/// Who uses me: scene singleton. ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent registers automatically.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/ConveyorRenderer")]
public class ConveyorRenderer : MonoBehaviour
{
    #region Nested Type
    [Serializable]
    public class ConveyorMeshSet
    {
        public Mesh Mesh;
        public Material[] Materials;
    }
    #endregion

    #region Inspector Fields
    [SerializeField] ConveyorMeshSet[] _conveyorMeshSets;
    #endregion

    #region Private Fields
    readonly Dictionary<int, List<Matrix4x4>> meshBatches = new Dictionary<int, List<Matrix4x4>>();
    const int BatchSize = 1023;
    #endregion

    #region Unity Lifecycle
    /// <summary> Each late update: rebuilds matrix batches if dirty, then draws all conveyors
    /// via DrawMeshInstanced in batches of 1023. </summary>
    private void LateUpdate()
    {
        // → rebuild batches when a conveyor was added/removed/moved
        if (ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent.GetNeedsUpdate())
        {
            meshBatches.Clear();
            foreach (var comp in ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent.GetAllConveyors())
            {
                if (!meshBatches.TryGetValue(comp.GetMeshIndex(), out var list))
                {
                    list = new List<Matrix4x4>();
                    meshBatches[comp.GetMeshIndex()] = list;
                }
                list.Add(comp.GetCachedMatrix());
            }
            ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent.SetNeedsUpdate(false);
        }
        // → draw batches
        foreach (var kvp in meshBatches)
        {
            var meshSet = _conveyorMeshSets[kvp.Key];
            var matrices = kvp.Value;
            for (int sub = 0; sub < meshSet.Materials.Length; sub++)
                DrawBatched(matrices, meshSet.Mesh, sub, meshSet.Materials[sub]);
        }
    }

    /// <summary> Draws matrices in batches of 1023 via Graphics.DrawMeshInstanced. </summary>
    private void DrawBatched(List<Matrix4x4> matrices, Mesh mesh, int submesh, Material mat)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < matrices.Count; i += BatchSize)
        {
            int count = Mathf.Min(BatchSize, matrices.Count - i);
            Graphics.DrawMeshInstanced(mesh, submesh, mat, matrices.GetRange(i, count));
        }
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/Scripts/_-Systems/ConveyorSystem/ConveyorSplitterT2.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: none

/// <summary>
/// I'm a mechanical arm splitter that swings back and forth on a conveyor line, alternating
/// ore direction left/right. I run a coroutine SwingLoop that smoothly rotates RotatingThing
/// between minY and maxY local euler angles. When no ore passes for IdleTime seconds, the arm
/// pauses to save performance. OnTriggerEnter resets the idle timer so the arm resumes swinging.
///
/// Who uses me: placed on conveyor splitter building prefabs.
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/ConveyorSplitterT2")]
public class ConveyorSplitterT2 : MonoBehaviour
{
    #region Inspector Fields
    [SerializeField] float _minY = -35f;
    [SerializeField] float _maxY = 35f;
    [SerializeField] float _duration = 1.5f;
    [SerializeField] float _pauseTime = 2f;
    [SerializeField] float _idleTime = 1f;
    [SerializeField] Transform _rotatingThing;
    #endregion

    #region Private Fields
    Coroutine swingRoutine;
    float timeSinceLastObject;
    #endregion

    #region Unity Lifecycle
    /// <summary> Starts the swing loop coroutine. </summary>
    private void OnEnable()
    {
        swingRoutine = StartCoroutine(SwingLoop());
        timeSinceLastObject = 0f;
    }

    /// <summary> Stops the swing loop. </summary>
    private void OnDisable()
    {
        if (swingRoutine != null) StopCoroutine(swingRoutine);
    }

    /// <summary> Resets idle timer when ore enters the trigger. </summary>
    private void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other) { timeSinceLastObject = 0f; }

    /// <summary> Tracks time since last trigger event. </summary>
    private void Update() { timeSinceLastObject += Time.deltaTime; }
    #endregion

    #region Swing
    /// <summary> Infinite coroutine: alternates between minY and maxY with SmoothStep interpolation.
    /// Pauses between swings. If idle too long, yields short delays instead. </summary>
    private IEnumerator SwingLoop()
    {
        bool goingToMax = true;
        while (true)
        {
            // → idle check — if no ore recently, wait and retry
            if (timeSinceLastObject > _idleTime)
            {
                yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.25f);
                continue;
            }
            // → swing from start angle to end angle
            float startAngle = goingToMax ? _minY : _maxY;
            float endAngle = goingToMax ? _maxY : _minY;
            float elapsed = 0f;
            while (elapsed < _duration)
            {
                elapsed += Time.deltaTime;
                float t = Mathf.SmoothStep(0f, 1f, Mathf.Clamp01(elapsed / _duration));
                float y = Mathf.Lerp(startAngle, endAngle, t);
                Vector3 euler = _rotatingThing.localEulerAngles;
                _rotatingThing.localEulerAngles = new Vector3(euler.x, y, euler.z);
                yield return null;
            }
            // → pause at end of swing
            yield return new WaitForSeconds(_pauseTime);
            goingToMax = !goingToMax;
        }
    }
    #endregion
}

# ConveyorSystem — Vertical Slice Test

## What This Tests
Ore pieces flow along conveyor belt chains, all variants (shaker, blocker, splitter, routing) work independently.

## Prerequisites
- `ConveyorBeltManager` singleton in scene
- 3+ ConveyorBelt prefabs placed in a line (each has a trigger collider child)
- A Rigidbody sphere prefab (simulates ore) assigned to `ConveyorTest._testOrePrefab`
- Optional: ConveyorBlocker, ConveyorBlockerT2, ConveyorSplitterT2, RoutingConveyor

## NOT Required
PlayerMovement, BuildingSystem (placement), ShopSystem, InventorySystem.

## Test Script: `ConveyorTest.cs`
Attach to an empty GO.

| Key | What it does | What you should see |
|-----|-------------|-------------------|
| N | Spawns test ore above first belt | Sphere appears, starts moving along belt |
| M | Toggles ConveyorBlocker | Belt stops, ore halts |

## Console Output
```
[ConveyorTest] belt count: 3
[ConveyorTest] batch render count: 3
[ConveyorTest] spawned ore
[ConveyorTest] toggling blocker
```

## Checklist
- [ ] Ore sphere moves forward along belt chain
- [ ] Ore transitions smoothly between connected belts
- [ ] ConveyorBeltShaker: ore bounces left-right while moving forward
- [ ] ConveyorBeltShakerHorizontal: ore bounces left-right only (no vertical)
- [ ] ConveyorBlocker: hinge gate disables belt when closed
- [ ] ConveyorBlockerT2: sliding gate toggles on interaction
- [ ] ConveyorSplitterT2: arm swings and alternates ore direction
- [ ] RoutingConveyor: direction switches on interaction
- [ ] ConveyorBatchRenderingComponent: individual Renderers disabled, batch draw works
- [ ] ConveyorBeltManager [DefaultExecutionOrder(-10)]: velocity applied before belt FixedUpdate
- [ ] Static list survives Play → Stop → Play (stale null refs expected, round-robin cleans them)

using System.Collections.Generic;
using DG.Tweening;
using UnityEngine;

// deps: IInteractable (InteractionSystem), ICustomSaveDataProvider (Phase G), DOTween

/// <summary>
/// I'm a direction-switching conveyor junction. When the player interacts ("Switch Direction" or
/// "Toggle"), I DOTween-rotate the RotatingPart between open and closed euler angles, swap the
/// ClosedObjects/OpenObjects visibility, and play a sound. This effectively changes which output
/// path ore travels along.
///
/// I implement IInteractable for the interaction wheel and ICustomSaveDataProvider so Phase G
/// can persist my direction state.
///
/// Who uses me: interaction wheel (Interact), save system (Phase G).
/// </summary>
[AddComponentMenu("MineMGL/Conveyor/RoutingConveyor")]
public class RoutingConveyor : MonoBehaviour, IInteractable, ICustomSaveDataProvider
{
    #region Inspector Fields
    [SerializeField] string _name = "Routing Conveyor";
    [SerializeField] bool _isClosed;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _closedObjects;
    [SerializeField] GameObject _openObjects;
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _closedRotation;
    [SerializeField] Vector3 _openRotation;
    [SerializeField] Transform _rotatingPart;
    [SerializeField] float _rotateDuration = 0.35f;
    [SerializeField] Ease _rotateEase = Ease.OutCubic;
    [SerializeField] List<SO_InteractionOption> _interactions;
    #endregion

    #region Private Fields
    Tween rotTween;
    #endregion

    #region Unity Lifecycle
    /// <summary> Sets initial rotation from serialized state (no animation on load). </summary>
    private void OnEnable() { SetDirectionFromLoading(_isClosed); }
    #endregion

    #region Direction
    /// <summary> Animated direction change — kills tween, swaps visibility, DOTween-rotates. </summary>
    private void SetDirection(bool closed)
    {
        rotTween?.Kill();
        // Phase H: Singleton<SoundManager>.Ins.PlaySoundAtLocation(_toggleSound, _rotatingPart.position);
        _isClosed = closed;
        Vector3 target = closed ? _closedRotation : _openRotation;
        _closedObjects?.SetActive(closed);
        _openObjects?.SetActive(!closed);
        rotTween = _rotatingPart.DOLocalRotate(target, _rotateDuration).SetEase(_rotateEase);
    }

    /// <summary> Instant set (no animation) — used on scene load. </summary>
    private void SetDirectionFromLoading(bool closed)
    {
        _isClosed = closed;
        _closedObjects?.SetActive(closed);
        _openObjects?.SetActive(!closed);
        _rotatingPart.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(closed ? _closedRotation : _openRotation);
    }
    #endregion

    #region IInteractable
    public bool ShouldUseInteractionWheel() => true;
    public List<SO_InteractionOption> GetOptions() => _interactions;
    public string GetObjectName() => _name;
    /// <summary> Routes "switchDirection" or "toggle" to direction change. </summary>
    public void Interact(SO_InteractionOption selectedOption)
    {
        if (selectedOption.interactionType == InteractionType.switchDirection
            || selectedOption.interactionType == InteractionType.toggle)
            SetDirection(!_isClosed);
    }
    #endregion

    #region ICustomSaveDataProvider (Phase G stub)
    public void LoadFromSave(string json)
    {
        var data = JsonUtility.FromJson<RoutingConveyorSaveData>(json) ?? new RoutingConveyorSaveData();
        SetDirectionFromLoading(data.IsClosed);
    }
    public string GetCustomSaveData() => JsonUtility.ToJson(new RoutingConveyorSaveData { IsClosed = _isClosed });
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/prototype/Proto_BuildingPlacement.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// STANDALONE PROTOTYPE — Full BuildingSystem end-to-end. Zero external deps.
/// Drop on empty GO → Press Play. Creates everything at runtime with primitives.
///
/// Features covered:
///   ✅ Ghost preview (transparent green/red/orange, follows camera aim)
///   ✅ Grid snap (1m integer grid, same math as BuildingDataService)
///   ✅ Overlap validation (OverlapBox — red ghost when intersecting)
///   ✅ Flat ground check (orange ghost when surface normal too steep)
///   ✅ Rotation (R key — 90° increments)
///   ✅ Mirror / Q key (cycles between 2 prefab variants: cube vs wide-cube)
///   ✅ Conveyor snap alignment (auto-rotate to connect I/O snap points of neighbors)
///   ✅ Placement (LMB — instantiates real building, quantity decrements)
///   ✅ Quantity system (start with 5, decrement on place, HUD shows remaining)
///   ✅ Take (T — destroys building, adds +1 to quantity)
///   ✅ Pack (P — spawns crate with random velocity, destroys building)
///   ✅ Crate pickup (E near crate — adds to quantity, destroys crate)
///   ✅ Drop as crate (G — spawns crate at camera forward with velocity)
///   ✅ Scaffolding legs (raycast down from corners, spawn cylinder segments)
///   ✅ Support toggle (V — hide/show legs)
///   ✅ Support respawn (legs recalculate when building below is removed)
///   ✅ Highlight on look (simple color tint when looking at placed building)
///   ✅ Placement node (yellow sphere markers — building snaps to nearest node)
///   ✅ Placement node info text (console shows "Attaching to Node_Iron")
///
/// Controls:
///   WASD = move        LMB = place (if green)    T = take building
///   Mouse = look       R = rotate 90°            P = pack to crate
///   Q = mirror variant G = drop tool as crate    V = toggle supports
///   E = pickup crate   ESC = unlock cursor       1/2 = toggle flat ground req
/// </summary>
public class Proto_BuildingPlacement : MonoBehaviour
{
    #region State
    Camera cam; CharacterController cc; float pitch;
    GameObject ghost; Material matGreen, matRed, matOrange;
    Quaternion ghostRot = Quaternion.identity;
    List<PBuilding> buildings = new List<PBuilding>();
    List<PCrate> crates = new List<PCrate>();
    List<PNode> nodes = new List<PNode>();
    int quantity = 5, variantIndex;
    bool canPlace, requireFlatGround;
    PBuilding highlighted;
    Color highlightOrigColor;
    Vector3 lastGhostPos;
    bool isSnapped;
    #endregion

    void Start()
    {
        // → player
        cc = gameObject.AddComponent<CharacterController>(); cc.height = 1.8f;
        transform.position = new Vector3(5f, 1f, -3f);
        var cGO = new GameObject("Cam"); cGO.transform.parent = transform;
        cGO.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0, 0.8f, 0);
        cam = cGO.AddComponent<Camera>(); cam.nearClipPlane = 0.1f;

        // → floor + ramp (for flat ground test)
        MakeFloor();
        var ramp = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        ramp.name = "Ramp"; ramp.transform.position = new Vector3(12f, 0.5f, 0f);
        ramp.transform.localScale = new Vector3(4f, 0.2f, 3f);
        ramp.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0f, 0f, 20f);
        ramp.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.4f, 0.3f, 0.2f);

        // → placement nodes (yellow sphere markers at specific spots)
        nodes.Add(MakeNode("Node_Iron", new Vector3(3.5f, 0.3f, 4.5f)));
        nodes.Add(MakeNode("Node_Gold", new Vector3(6.5f, 0.3f, 4.5f)));

        // → ghost materials
        matGreen = MakeTransparentMat(new Color(0, 1, 0, 0.35f));
        matRed = MakeTransparentMat(new Color(1, 0, 0, 0.35f));
        matOrange = MakeTransparentMat(new Color(1, 0.6f, 0, 0.35f));

        // → ghost
        ghost = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        ghost.name = "Ghost"; Destroy(ghost.GetComponent<Collider>());
        ghost.GetComponent<Renderer>().material = matGreen; ghost.SetActive(false);

        // → light
        var lt = new GameObject("Lt").AddComponent<Light>();
        lt.type = LightType.Directional; lt.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(50, -30, 0);

        Cursor.lockState = CursorLockMode.Locked;
        Debug.Log("[Proto_Building] WASD=move LMB=place R=rotate Q=mirror T=take P=pack E=pickup crate G=drop V=supports 1=flatGround ESC=cursor");
        Debug.Log($"[Proto_Building] qty={quantity}");
    }

    void Update()
    {
        Move();
        UpdateHighlight();
        Ghost();
        Place();
        TakePackDrop();
        PickupCrate();
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha1)) { requireFlatGround = !requireFlatGround; Debug.Log($"[FlatGround] {requireFlatGround}"); }
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Escape))
            Cursor.lockState = Cursor.lockState == CursorLockMode.Locked ? CursorLockMode.None : CursorLockMode.Locked;
    }

    #region Movement
    void Move()
    {
        float mx = Input.GetAxis("Mouse X") * 2f, my = Input.GetAxis("Mouse Y") * 2f;
        transform.Rotate(0, mx, 0); pitch = Mathf.Clamp(pitch - my, -80, 80);
        cam.transform.localEulerAngles = new Vector3(pitch, 0, 0);
        Vector3 m = transform.right * Input.GetAxis("Horizontal") + transform.forward * Input.GetAxis("Vertical");
        m.y = -9.8f * Time.deltaTime;
        cc.Move(m * 5f * Time.deltaTime);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Highlight
    void UpdateHighlight()
    {
        // → clear previous highlight
        if (highlighted != null) { highlighted.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = highlightOrigColor; highlighted = null; }
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 6f)) return;
        var pb = hit.collider.GetComponent<PBuilding>();
        if (pb == null) return;
        highlighted = pb;
        highlightOrigColor = pb.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color;
        pb.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.Lerp(highlightOrigColor, Color.white, 0.4f);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Ghost
    void Ghost()
    {
        if (quantity <= 0) { ghost.SetActive(false); return; }
        Vector3 aim = Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit h, 6f) ? h.point : cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * 6f;
        // → grid snap
        Vector3 off = aim - new Vector3(0.5f, 0, 0.5f);
        int gx = Mathf.RoundToInt(off.x), gy = Mathf.Max(0, Mathf.RoundToInt(off.y)), gz = Mathf.RoundToInt(off.z);
        Vector3 gp = new Vector3(gx + 0.5f, gy, gz + 0.5f);
        ghost.SetActive(true);
        ghost.transform.position = gp;
        ghost.transform.rotation = ghostRot;
        ghost.transform.localScale = variantIndex == 0 ? Vector3.one : new Vector3(2f, 1f, 1f); // variant visual

        // → conveyor snap: check if any placed building is within 1.5m, try align
        if (gp != lastGhostPos)
        {
            isSnapped = false; lastGhostPos = gp;
            foreach (var b in buildings)
            {
                if (b == null || b.go == null) continue;
                if (Vector3.Distance(b.go.transform.position, gp) < 1.5f)
                {
                    // → try 4 rotations, pick the one where "output" of neighbor is closest to "input" of ghost
                    Vector3 neighborOutput = b.go.transform.position + b.go.transform.right * 0.6f;
                    float bestDist = 999f; Quaternion bestRot = ghostRot;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
                    {
                        Quaternion testRot = Quaternion.Euler(0, i * 90f, 0);
                        Vector3 ghostInput = gp + testRot * Vector3.left * 0.6f;
                        float dist = Vector3.Distance(ghostInput, neighborOutput);
                        if (dist < bestDist) { bestDist = dist; bestRot = testRot; }
                    }
                    if (bestDist < 0.5f) { ghostRot = bestRot; ghost.transform.rotation = ghostRot; isSnapped = true; }
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        // → validation
        canPlace = true;
        // overlap check
        Collider[] overlaps = Physics.OverlapBox(gp, Vector3.one * 0.45f, ghostRot, ~0, QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore);
        foreach (var c in overlaps) { if (c.GetComponent<PBuilding>() != null) { canPlace = false; break; } }

        // → flat ground check
        Material mat = matGreen;
        if (requireFlatGround && canPlace)
        {
            if (Physics.Raycast(gp + new Vector3(0, 0.1f, 0), Vector3.down, out RaycastHit fh, 1f))
            {
                if (Vector3.Dot(fh.normal, Vector3.up) < 0.9f) { canPlace = false; mat = matOrange; }
            }
            else { canPlace = false; mat = matOrange; }
        }

        // → placement node check
        PNode nearNode = null;
        foreach (var n in nodes) { if (!n.attached && Vector3.Distance(n.transform.position, gp) < 2f) { nearNode = n; break; } }
        if (nearNode != null) { ghost.transform.position = nearNode.transform.position; canPlace = true; mat = matGreen; }

        if (!canPlace && mat != matOrange) mat = matRed;
        ghost.GetComponent<Renderer>().material = mat;

        // → rotate / mirror
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.R))
        {
            if (isSnapped) { variantIndex = 1 - variantIndex; } // mirror when snapped
            else { ghostRot *= Quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0); }
        }
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Q)) { variantIndex = 1 - variantIndex; ghost.transform.localScale = variantIndex == 0 ? Vector3.one : new Vector3(2f, 1f, 1f); }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Place
    void Place()
    {
        if (!Input.GetMouseButtonDown(0) || !canPlace || quantity <= 0) return;
        var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        go.name = $"Bld_{buildings.Count}"; go.transform.position = ghost.transform.position;
        go.transform.rotation = ghost.transform.rotation; go.transform.localScale = ghost.transform.localScale;
        go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.HSVToRGB(Random.Range(0f, 1f), 0.4f, 0.85f);
        var pb = go.AddComponent<PBuilding>(); pb.go = go; buildings.Add(pb);
        SpawnSupports(pb);
        quantity--;
        // → attach to placement node if close
        foreach (var n in nodes) { if (!n.attached && Vector3.Distance(n.transform.position, go.transform.position) < 1f) { n.attached = true; n.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.gray; Debug.Log($"[Node] attached to {n.name}"); break; } }
        Debug.Log($"[Placed] {go.transform.position} qty={quantity}");
    }
    #endregion

    #region Take / Pack / Drop
    void TakePackDrop()
    {
        // → take / pack (look at building)
        if (highlighted != null)
        {
            if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.T))
            {
                buildings.Remove(highlighted); RespawnNeighborSupports(highlighted.go.transform.position);
                Destroy(highlighted.go); highlighted = null; quantity++;
                Debug.Log($"[TAKEN] +1 qty={quantity}");
            }
            if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.P))
            {
                Vector3 pos = highlighted.go.transform.position + Vector3.up * 0.5f;
                SpawnCrate(pos, highlighted.go.transform.rotation, Vector3.up * 2f);
                buildings.Remove(highlighted); RespawnNeighborSupports(highlighted.go.transform.position);
                Destroy(highlighted.go); highlighted = null;
                Debug.Log("[PACKED] crate spawned");
            }
            if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.V))
            {
                highlighted.supportsOn = !highlighted.supportsOn;
                foreach (var l in highlighted.legs) { if (l != null) l.SetActive(highlighted.supportsOn); }
                Debug.Log($"[Supports] {(highlighted.supportsOn ? "ON" : "OFF")}");
            }
        }
        // → drop tool as crate (G key)
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.G) && quantity > 0)
        {
            quantity--;
            SpawnCrate(cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * 0.5f, cam.transform.rotation, cam.transform.forward * 5f);
            Debug.Log($"[DROPPED] crate spawned, qty={quantity}");
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Crate Pickup
    void PickupCrate()
    {
        if (!Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.E)) return;
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 4f)) return;
        var cr = hit.collider.GetComponent<PCrate>();
        if (cr == null) return;
        quantity += cr.qty; crates.Remove(cr); Destroy(cr.gameObject);
        Debug.Log($"[PICKUP] crate → qty={quantity}");
    }
    #endregion

    #region Supports
    void SpawnSupports(PBuilding pb)
    {
        Vector3 p = pb.go.transform.position; float hw = 0.45f;
        Vector3[] corners = { p + new Vector3(-hw, 0, -hw), p + new Vector3(hw, 0, -hw), p + new Vector3(-hw, 0, hw), p + new Vector3(hw, 0, hw) };
        foreach (var c in corners)
        {
            if (!Physics.Raycast(c, Vector3.down, out RaycastHit h, 20f)) continue;
            if (h.distance < 0.1f) continue;
            int n = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.RoundToInt(h.distance)); Vector3 lp = c;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                var leg = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cylinder);
                leg.name = "Leg"; leg.transform.position = lp - Vector3.up * 0.5f;
                leg.transform.localScale = new Vector3(0.06f, 0.5f, 0.06f);
                leg.transform.parent = pb.go.transform;
                leg.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.3f, 0.3f, 0.3f);
                Destroy(leg.GetComponent<Collider>()); pb.legs.Add(leg); lp.y -= 1f;
            }
        }
    }
    void RespawnNeighborSupports(Vector3 removedPos)
    {
        foreach (var b in buildings)
        {
            if (b == null || b.go == null) continue;
            if (Vector3.Distance(b.go.transform.position, removedPos) < 3f)
            {
                foreach (var l in b.legs) { if (l != null) Destroy(l); }
                b.legs.Clear(); SpawnSupports(b);
            }
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Helpers
    void SpawnCrate(Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot, Vector3 force)
    {
        var c = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        c.name = "Crate"; c.transform.position = pos; c.transform.rotation = rot;
        c.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * 0.4f;
        c.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.6f, 0.4f, 0.2f);
        var rb = c.AddComponent<Rigidbody>(); rb.mass = 0.5f; rb.AddForce(force, ForceMode.Impulse);
        var cr = c.AddComponent<PCrate>(); cr.qty = 1; crates.Add(cr);
    }
    PNode MakeNode(string name, Vector3 pos)
    {
        var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Sphere);
        go.name = name; go.transform.position = pos; go.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * 0.5f;
        go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.yellow;
        Destroy(go.GetComponent<Collider>());
        return go.AddComponent<PNode>();
    }
    void MakeFloor()
    {
        var f = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Plane); f.transform.localScale = new Vector3(3, 1, 3);
        f.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.25f, 0.25f, 0.25f);
        // → raised platform for scaffolding test
        var plat = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        plat.name = "Platform"; plat.transform.position = new Vector3(0f, 1.5f, 5f);
        plat.transform.localScale = new Vector3(4f, 0.2f, 4f);
        plat.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.35f, 0.35f, 0.35f);
        // → grid lines
        for (int i = -10; i <= 10; i++)
        {
            MakeGridLine(new Vector3(i + 0.5f, 0.002f, 0), new Vector3(0.02f, 0.001f, 20f));
            MakeGridLine(new Vector3(0, 0.002f, i + 0.5f), new Vector3(20f, 0.001f, 0.02f));
        }
    }
    void MakeGridLine(Vector3 pos, Vector3 scale)
    {
        var l = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube); l.transform.position = pos;
        l.transform.localScale = scale; l.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.32f, 0.32f, 0.32f);
        Destroy(l.GetComponent<Collider>());
    }
    Material MakeTransparentMat(Color col)
    {
        var m = new Material(Shader.Find("Standard")); m.color = col;
        m.SetFloat("_Mode", 3);
        m.SetInt("_SrcBlend", (int)UnityEngine.Rendering.BlendMode.SrcAlpha);
        m.SetInt("_DstBlend", (int)UnityEngine.Rendering.BlendMode.OneMinusSrcAlpha);
        m.SetInt("_ZWrite", 0); m.DisableKeyword("_ALPHATEST_ON");
        m.EnableKeyword("_ALPHABLEND_ON"); m.DisableKeyword("_ALPHAPREMULTIPLY_ON");
        m.renderQueue = 3000; return m;
    }
    void OnGUI()
    {
        GUI.Label(new Rect(10, 10, 300, 25), $"Qty: {quantity}  Variant: {(variantIndex == 0 ? "Normal" : "Wide")}  FlatGround: {requireFlatGround}");
        GUI.Label(new Rect(10, 30, 500, 25), "LMB=place R=rotate Q=mirror G=drop T=take P=pack E=pickup V=supports 1=flatGround");
    }
    #endregion

    #region Nested
    public class PBuilding : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public GameObject go; public bool supportsOn = true;
        public List<GameObject> legs = new List<GameObject>();
    }
    public class PCrate : MonoBehaviour { public int qty = 1; }
    public class PNode : MonoBehaviour { public bool attached; }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/prototype/Proto_ConveyorFlow.cs ==== -->
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// STANDALONE PROTOTYPE — Full ConveyorSystem end-to-end. Zero external deps.
/// Drop on empty GO → Press Play. Creates everything at runtime with primitives.
///
/// Layout built at runtime:
///   Main line:    [Belt0] → [Belt1:Shaker] → [Belt2:Blocker] → [Belt3:Splitter] → [Belt4] → end
///   Branch line:  at Belt3 splitter → [BranchA] or [BranchB] (two diagonal belts)
///   Routing:      Belt4 has a RoutingJunction → toggles between forward and left output
///   BlockerT2:    a sliding gate on Belt2 (slides a visual part, not hinge)
///
/// Features covered:
///   ✅ Velocity injection via trigger (OnTriggerEnter/Exit + FixedUpdate accumulation)
///   ✅ Batch velocity apply (averaged across overlapping belts)
///   ✅ Belt-to-belt transition (exit one trigger, enter next seamlessly)
///   ✅ Shaker variant (sideways + vertical oscillation)
///   ✅ Horizontal-only shaker variant
///   ✅ ConveyorBlocker (hinge-based — angle threshold disables belt)
///   ✅ ConveyorBlockerT2 (sliding gate — smooth position lerp)
///   ✅ ConveyorSplitterT2 (swinging arm alternates ore direction)
///   ✅ RoutingConveyor (direction switch — rotates junction, swaps active outputs)
///   ✅ RetainYVelocity option (uphill belts)
///   ✅ Round-robin null cleanup (one belt per frame)
///   ✅ Batch rendering concept (disable individual renderers, draw via status text)
///   ✅ Multiple objects overlapping belts → averaged velocity
///   ✅ OnDisable cleanup (belt removes refs from all tracked objects)
///   ✅ Speed change at runtime
///
/// Controls:
///   N = spawn sphere on belt 0          J = toggle routing junction direction
///   M = toggle blocker (belt 2)         K = change belt 0 speed (cycles 1/2/4)
///   B = toggle shaker mode (belt 1)     H = toggle horizontal-only shaker (belt 1)
