///   L = toggle sliding gate (BlockerT2) RMB+mouse = orbit camera
///   F = spawn 10 spheres rapidly
/// </summary>
public class Proto_ConveyorFlow : MonoBehaviour
{
    #region Runtime State
    List<PBelt> allBelts = new List<PBelt>();
    List<PPhysObj> allPhysObjs = new List<PPhysObj>();
    PBelt blockerBelt, shakerBelt, routingBeltA, routingBeltB;
    Camera cam;
    float camYaw, camPitch = 25f;
    Vector3 camPivot;
    float camDist = 8f;
    bool blockerClosed, slidingGateClosed, routingIsClosed;
    Transform slidingGatePart;
    Transform routingPart;
    int cleanupIndex;
    int speedIndex;
    float[] speeds = { 2f, 1f, 4f };
    int spawnedCount;
    #endregion

    void Start()
    {
        // → camera (orbit mode)
        var camGO = new GameObject("Cam");
        cam = camGO.AddComponent<Camera>();
        camPivot = new Vector3(5f, 0.5f, 0f);
        UpdateCamOrbit();
        camGO.tag = "MainCamera";

        // → floor
        var floor = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Plane);
        floor.transform.localScale = new Vector3(4f, 1f, 4f);
        floor.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.2f, 0.2f, 0.2f);

        // → light
        var lt = new GameObject("Light").AddComponent<Light>();
        lt.type = LightType.Directional; lt.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(50, -30, 0);

        // → main belt line (5 belts, X direction)
        float beltLen = 2f, beltW = 1.2f;
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
        {
            var b = MakeBelt($"Belt_{i}", new Vector3(i * beltLen + 1f, 0.05f, 0f), Vector3.right, 2f, beltLen, beltW);
            allBelts.Add(b);
        }
        shakerBelt = allBelts[1];
        blockerBelt = allBelts[2];

        // → branch belts off splitter (belt 3 area) — two diagonal outputs
        var bA = MakeBelt("BranchA", new Vector3(7.5f, 0.05f, 1.5f), (Vector3.right + Vector3.forward).normalized, 2f, 2f, beltW * 0.7f);
        var bB = MakeBelt("BranchB", new Vector3(7.5f, 0.05f, -1.5f), (Vector3.right - Vector3.forward).normalized, 2f, 2f, beltW * 0.7f);
        allBelts.Add(bA); allBelts.Add(bB);

        // → routing junction at end of belt 4
        routingBeltA = MakeBelt("RouteA", new Vector3(11f, 0.05f, 0f), Vector3.right, 2f, 2f, beltW);
        routingBeltB = MakeBelt("RouteB", new Vector3(9.5f, 0.05f, 2f), Vector3.forward, 2f, 2f, beltW);
        allBelts.Add(routingBeltA); allBelts.Add(routingBeltB);
        routingBeltB.disabled = true; // default: forward active
        routingBeltB.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.gray;
        // → routing visual (rotating cube)
        var rGO = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        rGO.name = "RoutingPivot"; rGO.transform.position = new Vector3(9.5f, 0.3f, 0f);
        rGO.transform.localScale = new Vector3(0.3f, 0.15f, 0.8f);
        rGO.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.magenta;
        Destroy(rGO.GetComponent<Collider>());
        routingPart = rGO.transform;

        // → splitter arm on belt 3
        var arm = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        arm.name = "SplitterArm"; arm.transform.position = new Vector3(7f, 0.3f, 0f);
        arm.transform.localScale = new Vector3(0.08f, 0.08f, beltW * 0.8f);
        arm.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.cyan;
        Destroy(arm.GetComponent<Collider>());
        arm.AddComponent<PSplitter>();

        // → sliding gate on belt 2 (BlockerT2)
        var gate = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        gate.name = "SlidingGate"; gate.transform.position = new Vector3(5f, 0.35f, beltW * 0.5f + 0.15f);
        gate.transform.localScale = new Vector3(0.15f, 0.3f, 0.3f);
        gate.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.8f, 0.4f, 0f);
        Destroy(gate.GetComponent<Collider>());
        slidingGatePart = gate.transform;

        // → status text via Debug
        Debug.Log("[Proto_ConveyorFlow] READY — N=sphere M=blocker B=shaker H=hShaker L=slidingGate J=routing K=speed F=10x");
    }

    void Update()
    {
        // → spawn
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.N)) SpawnSphere();
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.F)) { for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) SpawnSphere(); }

        // → blocker (belt 2 — disable flag, like hinge-based ConveyorBlocker)
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.M))
        {
            blockerClosed = !blockerClosed;
            blockerBelt.disabled = blockerClosed;
            blockerBelt.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = blockerClosed ? Color.red : Color.green;
            Debug.Log($"[Blocker] {(blockerClosed ? "CLOSED — belt stops" : "OPEN — belt pushes")}");
        }

        // → shaker toggle (belt 1 — sideways + vertical)
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.B))
        {
            shakerBelt.shakerMode = shakerBelt.shakerMode == ShakerMode.none ? ShakerMode.full : ShakerMode.none;
            shakerBelt.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = shakerBelt.shakerMode != ShakerMode.none ? Color.yellow : Color.green;
            Debug.Log($"[Shaker] {shakerBelt.shakerMode}");
        }
        // → horizontal-only shaker toggle
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.H))
        {
            shakerBelt.shakerMode = shakerBelt.shakerMode == ShakerMode.horizontalOnly ? ShakerMode.none : ShakerMode.horizontalOnly;
            shakerBelt.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = shakerBelt.shakerMode != ShakerMode.none ? new Color(1f, 0.6f, 0f) : Color.green;
            Debug.Log($"[Shaker] {shakerBelt.shakerMode}");
        }

        // → sliding gate (BlockerT2 — smooth position lerp)
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.L))
        {
            slidingGateClosed = !slidingGateClosed;
            blockerBelt.disabled = slidingGateClosed || blockerClosed;
            Debug.Log($"[SlidingGate] {(slidingGateClosed ? "CLOSED" : "OPEN")}");
        }
        if (slidingGatePart != null)
        {
            Vector3 openPos = new Vector3(5f, 0.35f, allBelts[2].GetComponent<Renderer>().bounds.extents.z + 0.3f);
            Vector3 closedPos = new Vector3(5f, 0.35f, 0f);
            slidingGatePart.position = Vector3.Lerp(slidingGatePart.position, slidingGateClosed ? closedPos : openPos, Time.deltaTime * 5f);
        }

        // → routing junction toggle
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.J))
        {
            routingIsClosed = !routingIsClosed;
            routingBeltA.disabled = routingIsClosed;
            routingBeltB.disabled = !routingIsClosed;
            routingBeltA.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = routingIsClosed ? Color.gray : Color.green;
            routingBeltB.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = routingIsClosed ? Color.green : Color.gray;
            Debug.Log($"[Routing] direction → {(routingIsClosed ? "LEFT" : "FORWARD")}");
        }
        if (routingPart != null)
        {
            Quaternion target = routingIsClosed ? Quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) : Quaternion.identity;
            routingPart.rotation = Quaternion.Lerp(routingPart.rotation, target, Time.deltaTime * 5f);
        }

        // → speed change
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.K))
        {
            speedIndex = (speedIndex + 1) % speeds.Length;
            allBelts[0].speed = speeds[speedIndex];
            allBelts[0].pushDirection = Vector3.right; // recalc not needed, direction stays
            Debug.Log($"[Speed] belt 0 → {speeds[speedIndex]}");
        }

        // → camera orbit (RMB drag)
        if (Input.GetMouseButton(1))
        {
            camYaw += Input.GetAxis("Mouse X") * 3f;
            camPitch -= Input.GetAxis("Mouse Y") * 3f;
            camPitch = Mathf.Clamp(camPitch, 5f, 80f);
        }
        camDist -= Input.GetAxis("Mouse ScrollWheel") * 3f;
        camDist = Mathf.Clamp(camDist, 3f, 20f);
        UpdateCamOrbit();
    }

    void FixedUpdate()
    {
        // → each belt pushes its objects (like ConveyorBelt.FixedUpdate)
        foreach (var belt in allBelts) belt.PushObjects();

        // → batch apply (like ConveyorBeltManager.FixedUpdate)
        for (int i = allPhysObjs.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            if (allPhysObjs[i] == null) { allPhysObjs.RemoveAt(i); continue; }
        }
        foreach (var obj in allPhysObjs)
        {
            if (obj.count == 0) { obj.Reset(); continue; }
            var rb = obj.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
            if (rb == null) continue;
            Vector3 vel = obj.sum / obj.count;
            if (obj.retainY) vel.y = rb.linearVelocity.y;
            else if (obj.bestY > 0f) vel.y = obj.bestY;
            else vel.y = rb.linearVelocity.y;
            rb.linearVelocity = vel;
            obj.Reset();
        }

        // → round-robin cleanup (one belt per frame, like ConveyorBeltManager.Update)
        if (allBelts.Count > 0)
        {
            if (cleanupIndex >= allBelts.Count) cleanupIndex = 0;
            allBelts[cleanupIndex].CleanNulls();
            cleanupIndex++;
        }
    }

    #region Helpers
    void SpawnSphere()
    {
        var s = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Sphere);
        s.name = $"Ore_{spawnedCount++}";
        s.transform.position = allBelts[0].transform.position + Vector3.up * 1.5f + UnityEngine.Random.insideUnitSphere * 0.2f;
        s.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * 0.25f;
        var rb = s.AddComponent<Rigidbody>(); rb.mass = 0.3f;
        var po = s.AddComponent<PPhysObj>(); allPhysObjs.Add(po);
        s.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = UnityEngine.Random.ColorHSV(0, 1, 0.5f, 1, 0.6f, 1);
    }

    PBelt MakeBelt(string name, Vector3 pos, Vector3 fwd, float speed, float len, float width)
    {
        var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        go.name = name; go.transform.position = pos;
        go.transform.rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(fwd, Vector3.up);
        go.transform.localScale = new Vector3(width, 0.05f, len);
        go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.green;
        // → trigger child (dual collider: parent=physical surface, child=trigger zone)
        var tGO = new GameObject("Trigger");
        tGO.transform.parent = go.transform; tGO.transform.localPosition = Vector3.up * 0.1f;
        var tc = tGO.AddComponent<BoxCollider>(); tc.isTrigger = true; tc.size = new Vector3(1f, 4f, 1f);
        var belt = go.AddComponent<PBelt>();
        belt.pushDirection = fwd.normalized; belt.speed = speed; belt.proto = this;
        return belt;
    }

    void UpdateCamOrbit()
    {
        float rad = camPitch * Mathf.Deg2Rad;
        float yawRad = camYaw * Mathf.Deg2Rad;
        Vector3 offset = new Vector3(Mathf.Sin(yawRad) * Mathf.Cos(rad), Mathf.Sin(rad), -Mathf.Cos(yawRad) * Mathf.Cos(rad)) * camDist;
        cam.transform.position = camPivot + offset;
        cam.transform.LookAt(camPivot);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Nested: PPhysObj
    public class PPhysObj : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public Vector3 sum; public float bestY; public int count; public bool retainY;
        public List<PBelt> touchingBelts = new List<PBelt>();
        public void Add(Vector3 v, bool rY)
        {
            if (count == 0) sum = v; else sum += v;
            if (v.y > bestY) bestY = v.y;
            count++; if (rY) retainY = true;
        }
        public void Reset() { sum = default; bestY = 0; count = 0; retainY = false; }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Nested: PBelt
    public enum ShakerMode { none, full, horizontalOnly }
    public class PBelt : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public Vector3 pushDirection; public float speed; public bool disabled;
        public ShakerMode shakerMode; public bool retainY;
        public Proto_ConveyorFlow proto;
        List<PPhysObj> objs = new List<PPhysObj>();
        float shakeFreq = 2f, shakeSpd = 1.5f, vertFreq = 3f, vertSpd = 0.8f;

        void OnTriggerEnter(Collider c)
        {
            var o = c.attachedRigidbody?.GetComponent<PPhysObj>();
            if (o != null && !objs.Contains(o)) { objs.Add(o); o.touchingBelts.Add(this); }
        }
        void OnTriggerExit(Collider c)
        {
            var o = c.attachedRigidbody?.GetComponent<PPhysObj>();
            if (o != null) { objs.Remove(o); o.touchingBelts.Remove(this); }
        }
        void OnDisable()
        {
            foreach (var o in objs) { if (o != null) o.touchingBelts.Remove(this); }
            objs.Clear();
        }
        public void CleanNulls()
        {
            for (int i = objs.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                var o = objs[i];
                if (o == null || !o.isActiveAndEnabled || o.GetComponent<Rigidbody>().isKinematic) objs.RemoveAt(i);
            }
        }
        public void PushObjects()
        {
            if (disabled || objs.Count == 0) return;
            Vector3 vel = pushDirection * speed;
            float t = Time.fixedTime;
            if (shakerMode == ShakerMode.full)
            {
                float sSign = Mathf.Sign(Mathf.Sin(t * Mathf.PI * 2f * shakeFreq));
                vel += transform.right * (shakeSpd * sSign);
                float vVal = Mathf.Sin(t * Mathf.PI * 2f * vertFreq);
                vel += Vector3.up * (vertSpd * vVal);
            }
            else if (shakerMode == ShakerMode.horizontalOnly)
            {
                float sSign = Mathf.Sign(Mathf.Sin(t * Mathf.PI * 2f * shakeFreq));
                vel += transform.right * (shakeSpd * sSign);
            }
            foreach (var o in objs) o.Add(vel, retainY);
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Nested: PSplitter
    public class PSplitter : MonoBehaviour
    {
        float min = -35f, max = 35f, dur = 1.5f, elapsed; bool toMax = true;
        float idleTime = 1f, timeSinceLast = 999f;
        void OnTriggerEnter(Collider c) => timeSinceLast = 0;
        void Update()
        {
            timeSinceLast += Time.deltaTime;
            if (timeSinceLast > idleTime) return; // idle — don't swing
            elapsed += Time.deltaTime;
            float tt = Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, Mathf.Clamp01(elapsed / dur));
            float a = Mathf.Lerp(toMax ? min : max, toMax ? max : min, tt);
            transform.localEulerAngles = new Vector3(0, a, 0);
            if (elapsed >= dur) { elapsed = 0; toMax = !toMax; }
        }
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/phase-d(New)/prototype/Proto_PhaseD_Integration.cs ==== -->
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// STANDALONE INTEGRATION PROTOTYPE — Tests ALL Phase D cross-system event chains.
/// Single MonoBehaviour, zero deps, empty scene → Play.
///
/// What this proves:
///   The per-system prototypes proved Building + Conveyor work alone. This tests the
///   EVENT HANDOFFS between systems — the real-world bugs hide in timing, ordering,
///   and cascade effects (CloseAll, MenuState, equip/unequip, ghost cleanup).
///
/// 10 flows tested:
///   Flow 1: Equip ToolBuilder → ghost appears → OnItemEquipped → SetOwnerContext
///   Flow 2: Place building (LMB) → OnBuildingPlaced → qty decrements → ghost stays
///   Flow 3: Hammer "Take" → BuildingObject creates ToolBuilder → OnBuildingTakeRequested
///           → inventory adds tool → OnItemPickedUp → OnBuildingRemoved
///   Flow 4: Hammer "Pack" → BuildingObject spawns crate → OnBuildingRemoved
///   Flow 5: Crate pickup (E) → creates ToolBuilder → OnToolPickupRequested → inventory adds
///   Flow 6: Drop tool (G) → OnItemDropped → crate spawns with velocity
///   Flow 7: Conveyor flow → trigger → velocity accumulate → batch apply → ore moves
///   Flow 8: Interact on placed building (E) → toggle open/close (ChuteHatch/RoutingConveyor)
///   Flow 9: Menu open (Tab) → OnMenuStateChanged(true) → ghost cleanup → cursor unlock
///   Flow 10: CloseAll cascade → opening menu while building → ghost destroyed, node ghosts hidden
///
/// Controls:
///   WASD+Mouse = FPS move          LMB = place building (if ghost green)
///   1 = equip ToolBuilder          2 = equip Hammer            3 = unequip
///   R = rotate ghost               Q = mirror variant
///   E = interact (pickup crate / toggle building)
///   G = drop equipped tool as crate
///   Tab = toggle inventory (tests MenuState + CloseAll)
///   N = spawn ore sphere on belt   L = DUMP EVENT LOG
///   F1 = clear event log
///
/// Event log: every static event logs [frame] EventName(args). Press L to dump.
/// </summary>
public class Proto_PhaseD_Integration : MonoBehaviour
{
    #region Inline Events — mirrors real GameEvents partial per phase
    // → domain reload cleanup: all nulled in Start()
    static Action<bool> OnMenuStateChanged;
    static Action<string> OnItemEquipped;       // item name
    static Action<string> OnToolPickupRequested; // item name
    static Action<string> OnItemPickedUp;        // item name
    static Action<string> OnItemDropped;         // item name
    static Action<Vector3> OnBuildingPlaced;
    static Action<Vector3> OnBuildingRemoved;
    static Action<string> OnBuildingTakeRequested; // tool name
    static Action OnCloseAllSubManagers;
    static Action OnOpenInventoryView;
    static Action OnCloseInventoryView;
    static List<string> eventLog = new List<string>();

    static void LogEvent(string name, string detail = "")
    {
        string entry = $"[{Time.frameCount}] {name}{(detail != "" ? $"({detail})" : "")}";
        eventLog.Add(entry);
        Debug.Log(entry);
    }

    void RaiseMenuStateChanged(bool open) { LogEvent("MenuStateChanged", open.ToString()); OnMenuStateChanged?.Invoke(open); }
    void RaiseItemEquipped(string name) { LogEvent("ItemEquipped", name); OnItemEquipped?.Invoke(name); }
    void RaiseToolPickupRequested(string name) { LogEvent("ToolPickupRequested", name); OnToolPickupRequested?.Invoke(name); }
    void RaiseItemPickedUp(string name) { LogEvent("ItemPickedUp", name); OnItemPickedUp?.Invoke(name); }
    void RaiseItemDropped(string name) { LogEvent("ItemDropped", name); OnItemDropped?.Invoke(name); }
    void RaiseBuildingPlaced(Vector3 pos) { LogEvent("BuildingPlaced", pos.ToString()); OnBuildingPlaced?.Invoke(pos); }
    void RaiseBuildingRemoved(Vector3 pos) { LogEvent("BuildingRemoved", pos.ToString()); OnBuildingRemoved?.Invoke(pos); }
    void RaiseBuildingTakeRequested(string name) { LogEvent("BuildingTakeRequested", name); OnBuildingTakeRequested?.Invoke(name); }
    void RaiseCloseAll() { LogEvent("CloseAllSubManagers"); OnCloseAllSubManagers?.Invoke(); }
    void RaiseOpenInventory() { LogEvent("OpenInventoryView"); OnOpenInventoryView?.Invoke(); }
    void RaiseCloseInventory() { LogEvent("CloseInventoryView"); OnCloseInventoryView?.Invoke(); }
    #endregion

    #region State
    Camera cam; CharacterController cc; float pitch;
    // → tool system
    enum EquippedTool { none, builder, hammer }
    EquippedTool equipped = EquippedTool.none;
    int builderQty = 5;
    int variantIndex; Quaternion ghostRot = Quaternion.identity;
    GameObject ghost; Material matGreen, matRed;
    bool canPlace, isMenuOpen, ghostActive;
    // → world objects
    List<PBuilding> buildings = new List<PBuilding>();
    List<PCrate> crates = new List<PCrate>();
    // → conveyor
    List<PBelt> belts = new List<PBelt>();
    List<PPhys> physObjs = new List<PPhys>();
    // → highlight
    PBuilding highlighted; Color hlOrigColor;
    #endregion

    #region Start — subscribe + build scene
    void Start()
    {
        // → Pitfall #9: static fields survive domain reload — null them all
        OnMenuStateChanged = null; OnItemEquipped = null; OnToolPickupRequested = null;
        OnItemPickedUp = null; OnItemDropped = null; OnBuildingPlaced = null;
        OnBuildingRemoved = null; OnBuildingTakeRequested = null; OnCloseAllSubManagers = null;
        OnOpenInventoryView = null; OnCloseInventoryView = null;
        eventLog.Clear();

        // → subscribe (mirrors real subscription order)
        // 1. UIManager-like: tracks menu state
        OnMenuStateChanged += open => { isMenuOpen = open; Cursor.lockState = open ? CursorLockMode.None : CursorLockMode.Locked; };
        // 2. InventoryOrchestrator-like: handles pickup
        OnToolPickupRequested += name => { builderQty++; RaiseItemPickedUp(name); LogEvent("Inventory", $"added {name}, qty={builderQty}"); };
        // 3. BuildingTakeRequested → creates tool and fires ToolPickupRequested
        OnBuildingTakeRequested += name => { RaiseToolPickupRequested(name); };
        // 4. CloseAll → close inventory + cleanup ghost
        OnCloseAllSubManagers += () => { if (isMenuOpen) RaiseCloseInventory(); CleanupGhost(); };
        // 5. Inventory view
        OnOpenInventoryView += () => { RaiseMenuStateChanged(true); LogEvent("InventoryUI", "OPENED"); };
        OnCloseInventoryView += () => { RaiseMenuStateChanged(false); LogEvent("InventoryUI", "CLOSED"); };

        // → player
        cc = gameObject.AddComponent<CharacterController>(); cc.height = 1.8f;
        transform.position = new Vector3(3f, 1f, -2f);
        var cGO = new GameObject("Cam"); cGO.transform.parent = transform;
        cGO.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0, 0.8f, 0);
        cam = cGO.AddComponent<Camera>(); cam.nearClipPlane = 0.1f;

        // → materials
        matGreen = MakeMat(new Color(0, 1, 0, 0.3f), true);
        matRed = MakeMat(new Color(1, 0, 0, 0.3f), true);

        // → ghost (starts hidden)
        ghost = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        ghost.name = "Ghost"; Destroy(ghost.GetComponent<Collider>());
        ghost.GetComponent<Renderer>().material = matGreen; ghost.SetActive(false);

        // → floor + platform (for scaffolding visual)
        var floor = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Plane);
        floor.transform.localScale = new Vector3(3, 1, 3);
        floor.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.2f, 0.2f, 0.2f);
        var plat = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        plat.name = "Platform"; plat.transform.position = new Vector3(-3, 2, 5);
        plat.transform.localScale = new Vector3(4, 0.2f, 4);
        plat.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.3f, 0.3f, 0.3f);

        // → conveyor belt line (3 belts for flow test)
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        {
            var bGO = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
            bGO.name = $"Belt_{i}"; bGO.transform.position = new Vector3(8 + i * 2f, 0.05f, 0);
            bGO.transform.localScale = new Vector3(1.8f, 0.05f, 1.2f);
            bGO.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.green;
            var tGO = new GameObject("Trigger"); tGO.transform.parent = bGO.transform;
            tGO.transform.localPosition = Vector3.up * 0.1f;
            var tc = tGO.AddComponent<BoxCollider>(); tc.isTrigger = true; tc.size = new Vector3(1, 4, 1);
            var belt = bGO.AddComponent<PBelt>(); belt.dir = Vector3.right; belt.speed = 2f;
            belt.proto = this; belts.Add(belt);
        }
        // → toggleable building (simulates ChuteHatch / RoutingConveyor interaction)
        var toggleBld = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        toggleBld.name = "ToggleableBuilding"; toggleBld.transform.position = new Vector3(6, 0.5f, 3);
        toggleBld.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.6f, 0.2f, 0.6f);
        var tb = toggleBld.AddComponent<PBuilding>(); tb.go = toggleBld; tb.isToggleable = true;
        buildings.Add(tb);
        // → pre-placed crate
        SpawnCrate(new Vector3(2, 0.3f, 2), Quaternion.identity, Vector3.zero);

        // → light
        var lt = new GameObject("Lt").AddComponent<Light>();
        lt.type = LightType.Directional; lt.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(50, -30, 0);

        Cursor.lockState = CursorLockMode.Locked;
        Debug.Log("=== Proto_PhaseD_Integration ===");
        Debug.Log("1=builder 2=hammer 3=unequip LMB=place R=rot Q=mirror E=interact G=drop Tab=menu N=ore L=log F1=clear");
    }
    #endregion

    #region Update
    void Update()
    {
        Move();
        HandleEquip();
        HandleHighlight();
        if (equipped == EquippedTool.builder) GhostUpdate();
        if (equipped == EquippedTool.builder && Input.GetMouseButtonDown(0)) PlaceBuilding();
        if (equipped == EquippedTool.hammer) HammerInteract();
        HandleInteract();
        HandleDrop();
        HandleMenu();
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.N)) SpawnOre();
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.L)) DumpLog();
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.F1)) { eventLog.Clear(); Debug.Log("[LOG CLEARED]"); }
    }

    void FixedUpdate()
    {
        // → belt push
        foreach (var b in belts) b.Push();
        // → batch apply (ConveyorBeltManager pattern)
        for (int i = physObjs.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (physObjs[i] == null) physObjs.RemoveAt(i); }
        foreach (var o in physObjs)
        {
            if (o.count == 0) { o.Reset(); continue; }
            var rb = o.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
            Vector3 v = o.sum / o.count; v.y = rb.linearVelocity.y;
            rb.linearVelocity = v; o.Reset();
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Movement
    void Move()
    {
        if (isMenuOpen) return;
        float mx = Input.GetAxis("Mouse X") * 2f, my = Input.GetAxis("Mouse Y") * 2f;
        transform.Rotate(0, mx, 0); pitch = Mathf.Clamp(pitch - my, -80, 80);
        cam.transform.localEulerAngles = new Vector3(pitch, 0, 0);
        Vector3 m = transform.right * Input.GetAxis("Horizontal") + transform.forward * Input.GetAxis("Vertical");
        m.y = -9.8f * Time.deltaTime; cc.Move(m * 5f * Time.deltaTime);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Equip — Flow 1
    void HandleEquip()
    {
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha1) && equipped != EquippedTool.builder)
        {
            if (equipped != EquippedTool.none) Unequip();
            equipped = EquippedTool.builder;
            RaiseItemEquipped("ToolBuilder");
            LogEvent("ToolBuilder", "ghost should appear");
            ghostActive = true;
        }
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha2) && equipped != EquippedTool.hammer)
        {
            if (equipped != EquippedTool.none) Unequip();
            equipped = EquippedTool.hammer;
            RaiseItemEquipped("ToolHammer");
        }
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha3)) Unequip();
    }

    void Unequip()
    {
        LogEvent("Unequip", equipped.ToString());
        equipped = EquippedTool.none;
        CleanupGhost();
    }

    void CleanupGhost()
    {
        ghost.SetActive(false); ghostActive = false;
    }
    #endregion

    #region Ghost + Place — Flow 2
    void GhostUpdate()
    {
        if (isMenuOpen || builderQty <= 0) { ghost.SetActive(false); return; }
        Vector3 aim = Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit h, 6f) ? h.point : cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * 6f;
        Vector3 off = aim - new Vector3(0.5f, 0, 0.5f);
        Vector3 gp = new Vector3(Mathf.RoundToInt(off.x) + 0.5f, Mathf.Max(0, Mathf.RoundToInt(off.y)), Mathf.RoundToInt(off.z) + 0.5f);
        ghost.SetActive(true); ghost.transform.position = gp; ghost.transform.rotation = ghostRot;
        ghost.transform.localScale = variantIndex == 0 ? Vector3.one : new Vector3(2, 1, 1);
        // → overlap check
        canPlace = true;
        foreach (var c in Physics.OverlapBox(gp, Vector3.one * 0.45f, ghostRot, ~0, QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore))
            if (c.GetComponent<PBuilding>() != null) { canPlace = false; break; }
        ghost.GetComponent<Renderer>().material = canPlace ? matGreen : matRed;
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.R)) { ghostRot *= Quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0); LogEvent("Rotate", "90°"); }
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Q)) { variantIndex = 1 - variantIndex; LogEvent("Mirror", variantIndex == 0 ? "Normal" : "Wide"); }
    }

    void PlaceBuilding()
    {
        if (!canPlace || builderQty <= 0) return;
        var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        go.name = $"Bld_{buildings.Count}"; go.transform.position = ghost.transform.position;
        go.transform.rotation = ghost.transform.rotation; go.transform.localScale = ghost.transform.localScale;
        go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.HSVToRGB(UnityEngine.Random.Range(0f, 1f), 0.4f, 0.8f);
        var pb = go.AddComponent<PBuilding>(); pb.go = go; buildings.Add(pb);
        // → spawn supports
        SpawnSupports(pb);
        builderQty--;
        RaiseBuildingPlaced(go.transform.position);
        LogEvent("ToolBuilder", $"qty={builderQty}");
        if (builderQty <= 0) { Unequip(); LogEvent("ToolBuilder", "consumed — auto-unequip"); }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Hammer Interact — Flow 3+4
    void HammerInteract()
    {
        if (highlighted == null) return;
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Mouse0))
        {
            // → Take: create ToolBuilder, fire take event chain
            LogEvent("Hammer", "TAKE");
            Vector3 pos = highlighted.go.transform.position;
            buildings.Remove(highlighted); Destroy(highlighted.go); highlighted = null;
            RaiseBuildingTakeRequested("ToolBuilder_from_Take");
            RaiseBuildingRemoved(pos);
        }
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Mouse1))
        {
            // → Pack: spawn crate, fire remove event
            LogEvent("Hammer", "PACK");
            Vector3 pos = highlighted.go.transform.position;
            SpawnCrate(pos + Vector3.up * 0.5f, Quaternion.identity, Vector3.up * 2f);
            buildings.Remove(highlighted); Destroy(highlighted.go); highlighted = null;
            RaiseBuildingRemoved(pos);
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Interact (E) — Flow 5+8
    void HandleInteract()
    {
        if (!Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.E) || isMenuOpen) return;
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 4f)) return;
        // → crate pickup (Flow 5)
        var cr = hit.collider.GetComponent<PCrate>();
        if (cr != null)
        {
            LogEvent("CratePickup", cr.gameObject.name);
            crates.Remove(cr); Destroy(cr.gameObject);
            RaiseToolPickupRequested("ToolBuilder_from_Crate");
            return;
        }
        // → toggleable building interact (Flow 8: ChuteHatch/RoutingConveyor/BlockerT2)
        var bld = hit.collider.GetComponent<PBuilding>();
        if (bld != null && bld.isToggleable)
        {
            bld.isClosed = !bld.isClosed;
            bld.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = bld.isClosed ? Color.red : new Color(0.6f, 0.2f, 0.6f);
            LogEvent("Interact", $"toggle {bld.go.name} → {(bld.isClosed ? "CLOSED" : "OPEN")}");
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Drop (G) — Flow 6
    void HandleDrop()
    {
        if (!Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.G) || equipped == EquippedTool.none) return;
        if (equipped == EquippedTool.builder && builderQty > 0)
        {
            builderQty--;
            SpawnCrate(cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * 0.5f, cam.transform.rotation, cam.transform.forward * 5f);
            RaiseItemDropped("ToolBuilder");
            LogEvent("Drop", $"crate spawned, qty={builderQty}");
            if (builderQty <= 0) Unequip();
        }
        else if (equipped == EquippedTool.hammer)
        {
            RaiseItemDropped("ToolHammer");
            Unequip();
            LogEvent("Drop", "hammer dropped (no crate, just unequip)");
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Menu — Flow 9+10
    void HandleMenu()
    {
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Tab))
        {
            if (isMenuOpen)
            {
                RaiseCloseInventory();
            }
            else
            {
                // → Flow 10: CloseAll before opening new panel
                if (ghostActive) { LogEvent("CloseAll", "ghost was active → cleanup"); RaiseCloseAll(); }
                RaiseOpenInventory();
            }
        }
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Escape) && isMenuOpen) RaiseCloseInventory();
    }
    #endregion

    #region Highlight
    void HandleHighlight()
    {
        if (highlighted != null) { highlighted.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = hlOrigColor; highlighted = null; }
        if (equipped != EquippedTool.hammer || isMenuOpen) return;
        if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.transform.position, cam.transform.forward, out RaycastHit hit, 6f)) return;
        var pb = hit.collider.GetComponent<PBuilding>();
        if (pb == null) return;
        highlighted = pb; hlOrigColor = pb.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color;
        pb.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = Color.Lerp(hlOrigColor, Color.white, 0.5f);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Conveyor — Flow 7
    void SpawnOre()
    {
        if (belts.Count == 0) return;
        var s = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Sphere);
        s.name = "Ore"; s.transform.position = belts[0].transform.position + Vector3.up * 1.5f;
        s.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * 0.25f;
        var rb = s.AddComponent<Rigidbody>(); rb.mass = 0.3f;
        var po = s.AddComponent<PPhys>(); physObjs.Add(po);
        s.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = UnityEngine.Random.ColorHSV(0, 1, 0.5f, 1, 0.6f, 1);
        LogEvent("SpawnOre", s.transform.position.ToString());
    }
    #endregion

    #region Supports
    void SpawnSupports(PBuilding pb)
    {
        Vector3 p = pb.go.transform.position; float hw = 0.45f;
        Vector3[] corners = { p + new Vector3(-hw, 0, -hw), p + new Vector3(hw, 0, -hw), p + new Vector3(-hw, 0, hw), p + new Vector3(hw, 0, hw) };
        foreach (var c in corners)
        {
            if (!Physics.Raycast(c, Vector3.down, out RaycastHit h, 20f) || h.distance < 0.1f) continue;
            int n = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.RoundToInt(h.distance)); Vector3 lp = c;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                var leg = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cylinder);
                leg.name = "Leg"; leg.transform.position = lp - Vector3.up * 0.5f;
                leg.transform.localScale = new Vector3(0.06f, 0.5f, 0.06f); leg.transform.parent = pb.go.transform;
                leg.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.3f, 0.3f, 0.3f);
                Destroy(leg.GetComponent<Collider>()); pb.legs.Add(leg); lp.y -= 1f;
            }
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Helpers
    void SpawnCrate(Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot, Vector3 force)
    {
        var c = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
        c.name = "Crate"; c.transform.position = pos; c.transform.rotation = rot;
        c.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * 0.35f;
        c.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = new Color(0.6f, 0.4f, 0.2f);
        var rb = c.AddComponent<Rigidbody>(); rb.mass = 0.5f;
        if (force.sqrMagnitude > 0) rb.AddForce(force, ForceMode.Impulse);
        var cr = c.AddComponent<PCrate>(); crates.Add(cr);
    }

    void DumpLog()
    {
        Debug.Log("========== EVENT LOG ==========");
        foreach (var e in eventLog) Debug.Log(e);
        Debug.Log($"========== {eventLog.Count} events ==========");
    }

    Material MakeMat(Color col, bool transparent)
    {
        var m = new Material(Shader.Find("Standard")); m.color = col;
        if (transparent)
        {
            m.SetFloat("_Mode", 3);
            m.SetInt("_SrcBlend", (int)UnityEngine.Rendering.BlendMode.SrcAlpha);
            m.SetInt("_DstBlend", (int)UnityEngine.Rendering.BlendMode.OneMinusSrcAlpha);
            m.SetInt("_ZWrite", 0); m.DisableKeyword("_ALPHATEST_ON");
            m.EnableKeyword("_ALPHABLEND_ON"); m.DisableKeyword("_ALPHAPREMULTIPLY_ON");
            m.renderQueue = 3000;
        }
        return m;
    }

    void OnGUI()
    {
        string tool = equipped == EquippedTool.builder ? $"Builder (qty:{builderQty})" : equipped == EquippedTool.hammer ? "Hammer" : "Empty";
        GUI.Label(new Rect(10, 10, 400, 20), $"Tool: {tool}  Menu: {(isMenuOpen ? "OPEN" : "closed")}  Events: {eventLog.Count}");
        GUI.Label(new Rect(10, 28, 500, 20), "1=builder 2=hammer 3=unequip LMB=place RMB=pack E=interact G=drop Tab=menu N=ore L=log");
        if (highlighted != null) GUI.Label(new Rect(10, 46, 300, 20), $"Looking at: {highlighted.go.name} {(highlighted.isToggleable ? "[E=toggle]" : "[LMB=take RMB=pack]")}");
    }
    #endregion

    #region Nested Classes
    public class PBuilding : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public GameObject go; public bool isToggleable, isClosed;
        public List<GameObject> legs = new List<GameObject>();
    }
    public class PCrate : MonoBehaviour { }
    public class PPhys : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public Vector3 sum; public int count;
        public void Add(Vector3 v) { if (count == 0) sum = v; else sum += v; count++; }
        public void Reset() { sum = default; count = 0; }
    }
    public class PBelt : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public Vector3 dir; public float speed; public bool disabled;
        public Proto_PhaseD_Integration proto;
        List<PPhys> objs = new List<PPhys>();
        void OnTriggerEnter(Collider c) { var o = c.attachedRigidbody?.GetComponent<PPhys>(); if (o != null && !objs.Contains(o)) objs.Add(o); }
        void OnTriggerExit(Collider c) { var o = c.attachedRigidbody?.GetComponent<PPhys>(); if (o != null) objs.Remove(o); }
        public void Push()
        {
            if (disabled) return;
            for (int i = objs.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (objs[i] == null) objs.RemoveAt(i); }
            foreach (var o in objs) o.Add(dir * speed);
        }
    }
    #endregion
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/prototype/Proto_InventoryFull.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using UnityEngine.EventSystems;
using TMPro;

/// <summary>
/// STANDALONE prototype — full inventory loop: 3D world items + UI slots + equip/drop.
/// Drop on empty scene with Canvas + EventSystem + Camera + Floor → Press Play.
/// Zero external dependencies — no GameEvents, no DataService, no BaseHeldTool.
///
/// SETUP (1 minute):
///   1. New empty scene
///   2. GameObject → UI → Canvas (auto-creates EventSystem)
///   3. Create Camera at (0, 3, -5) looking at origin, tag "MainCamera"
///   4. Create Floor: 3D Object → Plane at (0, 0, 0), scale (3, 1, 3)
///   5. Create empty GO → name "Proto_InventoryFull" → add this script
///   6. Wire: _canvas → Canvas, _cam → Camera
///   7. Press Play
///
/// WHAT HAPPENS ON PLAY:
///   - 4 colored cubes spawn on the floor (world items)
///   - 5-slot hotbar appears at bottom of screen
///   - Info panel (right side) with Equip + Drop buttons
///
/// CONTROLS:
///   Click cube in world  → picks up into first empty slot + auto-equips (cube floats in front of cam)
///   Click cube again     → duplicate guard — nothing happens (already in inventory)
///   1-5                  → select hotbar slot — auto-equips if has item, empty hands if empty
///   Press same key twice → toggles equip/unequip (empty hands)
///   Scroll wheel         → cycles through occupied slots only (skips empty)
///   Click slot           → shows info panel with Equip/Drop buttons
///   Equip button         → same as selecting that slot (auto-equips)
///   Drop button          → cube drops to floor with velocity, slot empties, "Empty hands"
///   Drag slot → slot     → swap contents (equipped tracking follows the swap)
///   Drag outside UI      → drop item to world
///   G key                → drop equipped item
///
/// WHAT TO VERIFY:
///   - Click world cube → disappears, icon in slot, cube floats in front of camera, status "Equipped: X"
///   - Click same cube again → nothing (duplicate guard)
///   - Press 1 → equip slot 0. Press 1 again → unequip (empty hands). Press 1 again → re-equip.
///   - Press 2 (empty slot) → empty hands, no cube visible
///   - Scroll wheel → skips empty slots, lands on next occupied
///   - Drop (G) → cube falls to floor with physics, status "Empty hands"
///   - Pick up dropped cube again → works (inInventory flag was cleared)
///   - Drag slot A → slot B → contents swap, equipped item follows if swapped
///   - Info panel shows correct name
///   - All actions logged to console
///
/// HELPER CLASSES (defined at bottom of this file — no separate .cs needed):
///   WorldItemTag  — MonoBehaviour with public int itemIndex, added to each world cube at runtime
///   SlotRelay2    — IBeginDragHandler/IDragHandler/IEndDragHandler/IDropHandler/IPointerDownHandler,
///                   added to each UI slot GO at runtime via AddComponent
///
/// EVERYTHING IS RUNTIME-CREATED except: Canvas, EventSystem, Camera, Floor, and this script's GO.
/// </summary>
public class Proto_InventoryFull : MonoBehaviour
{
	[SerializeField] Canvas _canvas;
	[SerializeField] Camera _cam;

	// ─── data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
	struct ItemData
	{
		public string name;
		public Color color;
		public GameObject worldGO;
		public bool inInventory;
		public int qty;
		public int maxStack;
	}

	List<ItemData> allItems = new List<ItemData>();
	ItemData?[] slots;
	int slotCount = 5;
	int selectedSlot = 0;
	int equippedSlot = -1;

	// ─── UI refs ────────────────────────────────────────────────
	List<GameObject> slotGOs = new List<GameObject>();
	GameObject ghostGO;
	Image ghostImage;
	TMP_Text ghostCountText;
	GameObject infoPanelGO;
	TMP_Text infoNameText;
	TMP_Text statusText;
	int dragFromIndex = -1;

	// ─── lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────

	void Start()
	{
		slots = new ItemData?[slotCount];

		// → spawn 4 world cubes
		// → spawn world items (some duplicates to test stacking)
		SpawnWorldItem("Pickaxe", new Color(0.8f, 0.4f, 0.2f), new Vector3(-3, 0.5f, 0), maxStack: 1);
		SpawnWorldItem("Magnet", new Color(0.9f, 0.2f, 0.2f), new Vector3(-1.5f, 0.5f, 0), maxStack: 1);
		SpawnWorldItem("Hammer", new Color(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.6f), new Vector3(0, 0.5f, 0), maxStack: 1);
		SpawnWorldItem("Dynamite", new Color(1f, 0.5f, 0f), new Vector3(1.5f, 0.5f, 0), maxStack: 5);
		SpawnWorldItem("Dynamite", new Color(1f, 0.5f, 0f), new Vector3(2f, 0.5f, 0), maxStack: 5);
		SpawnWorldItem("Dynamite", new Color(1f, 0.5f, 0f), new Vector3(2.5f, 0.5f, 0), maxStack: 5);

		// → build UI
		var container = CreateSlotContainer();
		for (int i = 0; i < slotCount; i++)
			slotGOs.Add(CreateSlotGO(container, i));
		ghostGO = CreateGhost();
		infoPanelGO = CreateInfoPanel();
		statusText = CreateStatusText();

		SelectSlot(0);
		UpdateStatus();
		Debug.Log("[Proto] Ready. Click cubes to pick up, 1-5 select, scroll cycle, G drop.");
	}

	void Update()
	{
		// → click world items to pick up
		if (Input.GetMouseButtonDown(0) && !EventSystem.current.IsPointerOverGameObject())
		{
			Ray ray = _cam.ScreenPointToRay(Input.mousePosition);
			if (Physics.Raycast(ray, out var hit, 50f))
			{
				var worldItem = hit.collider.GetComponent<WorldItemTag>();
				if (worldItem != null) TryPickup(worldItem.itemIndex);
			}
		}

		// → hotbar keys (selecting auto-equips, like main source)
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha1)) SelectSlot(0);
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha2)) SelectSlot(1);
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha3)) SelectSlot(2);
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha4)) SelectSlot(3);
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha5)) SelectSlot(4);

		// → scroll wheel: cycle through occupied hotbar slots (skip empty)
		float scroll = Input.GetAxis("Mouse ScrollWheel");
		if (scroll != 0f) ScrollToNextOccupied(scroll > 0f ? 1 : -1);

		// → G = drop equipped item
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.G)) DropEquipped();

		// → keep equipped item floating in front of camera
		if (equippedSlot >= 0 && slots[equippedSlot].HasValue)
		{
			var item = slots[equippedSlot].Value;
			if (item.worldGO != null)
			{
				item.worldGO.transform.position = _cam.transform.position + _cam.transform.forward * 2f + Vector3.down * 0.3f;
				item.worldGO.transform.rotation = _cam.transform.rotation;
			}
		}
	}

	// ─── inventory actions ──────────────────────────────────────

	void TryPickup(int itemIndex)
	{
		if (itemIndex < 0 || itemIndex >= allItems.Count) return;
		var item = allItems[itemIndex];

		// → duplicate guard: skip if this exact world GO is already picked up
		if (item.inInventory)
		{
			Debug.Log($"[Proto] '{item.name}' already in inventory — skipped");
			return;
		}

		// → stacking: if same name exists in a slot with space, add to qty
		if (item.maxStack > 1)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < slots.Length; i++)
			{
				if (slots[i].HasValue && slots[i].Value.name == item.name && slots[i].Value.qty < slots[i].Value.maxStack)
				{
					var existing = slots[i].Value;
					existing.qty++;
					slots[i] = existing;
					item.inInventory = true;
					item.worldGO.SetActive(false);
					allItems[itemIndex] = item;
					RefreshAllSlots();
					UpdateStatus();
					Debug.Log($"[Proto] Stacked '{item.name}' → slot {i} (qty: {existing.qty})");
					return;
				}
			}
		}

		// → find first empty slot
		int target = -1;
		for (int i = 0; i < slots.Length; i++)
			if (!slots[i].HasValue) { target = i; break; }
		if (target == -1) { Debug.Log("[Proto] Inventory full!"); return; }

		// → pick up: hide world GO, store in slot
		item.inInventory = true;
		item.qty = 1;
		item.worldGO.SetActive(false);
		allItems[itemIndex] = item;
		slots[target] = item;

		// → auto-equip on pickup (like EquipWhenPickedUp)
		SelectSlot(target);
		Debug.Log($"[Proto] Picked up '{item.name}' → slot {target} (auto-equipped)");
	}

	void SelectSlot(int index)
	{
		if (index < 0 || index >= slotCount) return;

		// → hide previously equipped item
		if (equippedSlot >= 0 && slots[equippedSlot].HasValue)
			slots[equippedSlot].Value.worldGO.SetActive(false);

		// → toggle: pressing same slot again unequips (empty hands)
		if (index == equippedSlot)
		{
			equippedSlot = -1;
			selectedSlot = index;
			RefreshAllSlots();
			UpdateStatus();
			Debug.Log($"[Proto] UNEQUIPPED (empty hands)");
			return;
		}

		selectedSlot = index;

		// → auto-equip if slot has item (like main source: pressing 1-5 equips that tool)
		if (slots[index].HasValue)
		{
			var item = slots[index].Value;
			item.worldGO.SetActive(true);
			item.worldGO.GetComponent<Rigidbody>().isKinematic = true;
			equippedSlot = index;
			Debug.Log($"[Proto] EQUIPPED: {item.name} (slot {index})");
		}
		else
		{
			// → selected empty slot = empty hands
			equippedSlot = -1;
			Debug.Log($"[Proto] Selected empty slot {index} (empty hands)");
		}

		RefreshAllSlots();
		UpdateStatus();
	}

	void ScrollToNextOccupied(int dir)
	{
		int start = selectedSlot;
		for (int i = 0; i < slotCount; i++)
		{
			int next = (start + dir + slotCount) % slotCount;
			start = next;
			if (slots[next].HasValue) { SelectSlot(next); return; }
		}
	}

	void UpdateStatus()
	{
		if (statusText == null) return;
		if (equippedSlot >= 0 && slots[equippedSlot].HasValue)
			statusText.text = $"Equipped: {slots[equippedSlot].Value.name}";
		else
			statusText.text = "Empty hands";
	}

	void DropEquipped()
	{
		if (equippedSlot < 0 || !slots[equippedSlot].HasValue) return;
		DropFromSlot(equippedSlot);
		equippedSlot = -1;
	}

	void DropFromSlot(int index)
	{
		if (!slots[index].HasValue) return;
		var item = slots[index].Value;

		// → show world GO, apply physics drop
		item.worldGO.SetActive(true);
		item.worldGO.transform.position = _cam.transform.position + _cam.transform.forward * 2f;
		var rb = item.worldGO.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
		rb.isKinematic = false;
		rb.linearVelocity = _cam.transform.forward * 3f + Vector3.up * 2f;

		// → mark as not in inventory
		item.inInventory = false;
		int itemIdx = allItems.FindIndex(x => x.name == item.name);
		if (itemIdx >= 0) allItems[itemIdx] = item;

		slots[index] = null;
		if (equippedSlot == index) equippedSlot = -1;
		infoPanelGO.SetActive(false);
		RefreshAllSlots();
		UpdateStatus();
		Debug.Log($"[Proto] DROPPED: {item.name} from slot {index}");
	}

	void SwapSlots(int a, int b)
	{
		if (a < 0 || b < 0 || a >= slotCount || b >= slotCount || a == b) return;
		var temp = slots[a];
		slots[a] = slots[b];
		slots[b] = temp;
		// → update equipped slot tracking
		if (equippedSlot == a) equippedSlot = b;
		else if (equippedSlot == b) equippedSlot = a;
		RefreshAllSlots();
		Debug.Log($"[Proto] Swapped slot {a} ↔ {b}");
	}

	void RefreshAllSlots()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < slotGOs.Count; i++)
		{
			var icon = slotGOs[i].transform.Find("Icon").GetComponent<Image>();
			var label = slotGOs[i].transform.Find("Label").GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
			var count = slotGOs[i].transform.Find("Count").GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
			var bg = slotGOs[i].GetComponent<Image>();

			bool isSelected = (i == selectedSlot);
			bool isEquipped = (i == equippedSlot);
			bg.color = isEquipped ? new Color(0.2f, 0.5f, 0.9f, 0.4f)
				: isSelected ? new Color(0.3f, 0.8f, 0.4f, 0.3f)
				: new Color(0.2f, 0.2f, 0.2f, 0.5f);

			if (slots[i].HasValue)
			{
				icon.enabled = true;
				icon.color = slots[i].Value.color;
				label.text = slots[i].Value.name;
				count.text = slots[i].Value.qty > 1 ? $"x{slots[i].Value.qty}" : "";
			}
			else
			{
				icon.enabled = false;
				label.text = "";
				count.text = "";
			}
		}
	}

	void ShowInfoPanel(int index)
	{
		if (!slots[index].HasValue) { infoPanelGO.SetActive(false); return; }
		infoPanelGO.SetActive(true);
		var s = slots[index].Value;
		infoNameText.text = s.qty > 1 ? $"{s.name} x{s.qty}" : s.name;
	}

	// ─── drag-drop handlers ─────────────────────────────────────

	void OnSlotBeginDrag(int index, PointerEventData e)
	{
		if (!slots[index].HasValue) return;
		dragFromIndex = index;
		slotGOs[index].transform.Find("Icon").gameObject.SetActive(false);
		slotGOs[index].transform.Find("Label").gameObject.SetActive(false);
		slotGOs[index].transform.Find("Count").gameObject.SetActive(false);
		ghostGO.SetActive(true);
		ghostImage.color = slots[index].Value.color;
		ghostCountText.text = slots[index].Value.qty > 1 ? $"x{slots[index].Value.qty}" : "";
		ghostGO.transform.SetAsLastSibling();
	}

	void OnSlotDrag(PointerEventData e)
	{
		if (dragFromIndex < 0) return;
		ghostGO.transform.position = e.position;
	}

	void OnSlotEndDrag(int index, PointerEventData e)
	{
		slotGOs[index].transform.Find("Icon").gameObject.SetActive(true);
		slotGOs[index].transform.Find("Label").gameObject.SetActive(true);
		slotGOs[index].transform.Find("Count").gameObject.SetActive(true);
		ghostGO.SetActive(false);
		// → drop outside UI = drop item to world
		if (dragFromIndex >= 0 && e.pointerEnter == null)
			DropFromSlot(dragFromIndex);
		dragFromIndex = -1;
		RefreshAllSlots();
	}

	void OnSlotDrop(int targetIndex, PointerEventData e)
	{
		if (dragFromIndex < 0 || dragFromIndex == targetIndex) return;
		SwapSlots(dragFromIndex, targetIndex);
	}

	// ─── status text ────────────────────────────────────────────

	TMP_Text CreateStatusText()
	{
		var go = new GameObject("StatusText", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(TextMeshProUGUI));
		go.transform.SetParent(_canvas.transform, false);
		var rt = go.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		rt.anchorMin = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f); rt.anchorMax = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f);
		rt.pivot = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f); rt.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(0, -20);
		rt.sizeDelta = new Vector2(400, 40);
		var tmp = go.GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
		tmp.text = "Empty hands"; tmp.fontSize = 22;
		tmp.alignment = TextAlignmentOptions.Center; tmp.color = Color.white;
		tmp.raycastTarget = false;
		return tmp;
	}

	// ─── world item spawning ────────────────────────────────────

	void SpawnWorldItem(string name, Color color, Vector3 pos, int maxStack = 1)
	{
		var go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
		go.name = name;
		go.transform.position = pos;
		go.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * 0.4f;
		go.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.color = color;
		var rb = go.AddComponent<Rigidbody>();
		rb.mass = 0.5f;
		var tag = go.AddComponent<WorldItemTag>();
		tag.itemIndex = allItems.Count;
		allItems.Add(new ItemData { name = name, color = color, worldGO = go, inInventory = false, qty = 1, maxStack = maxStack });
	}

	// ─── UI creation (all runtime) ──────────────────────────────

	Transform CreateSlotContainer()
	{
		var go = new GameObject("SlotContainer", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(HorizontalLayoutGroup), typeof(Image));
		go.transform.SetParent(_canvas.transform, false);
		var rt = go.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		rt.anchorMin = new Vector2(0.5f, 0f); rt.anchorMax = new Vector2(0.5f, 0f);
		rt.pivot = new Vector2(0.5f, 0f); rt.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(0, 20);
		rt.sizeDelta = new Vector2(slotCount * 80 + 20, 90);
		var hlg = go.GetComponent<HorizontalLayoutGroup>();
		hlg.spacing = 5; hlg.padding = new RectOffset(5, 5, 5, 5); hlg.childAlignment = TextAnchor.MiddleCenter;
		go.GetComponent<Image>().color = new Color(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.8f);
		return go.transform;
	}

	GameObject CreateSlotGO(Transform parent, int index)
	{
		var slotGO = new GameObject($"Slot_{index}", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
		slotGO.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
		slotGO.GetComponent<RectTransform>().sizeDelta = new Vector2(70, 70);
		slotGO.GetComponent<Image>().color = new Color(0.2f, 0.2f, 0.2f, 0.5f);
		slotGO.GetComponent<Image>().raycastTarget = true;

		var iconGO = new GameObject("Icon", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
		iconGO.transform.SetParent(slotGO.transform, false);
		var iconRT = iconGO.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		iconRT.anchorMin = Vector2.zero; iconRT.anchorMax = Vector2.one;
		iconRT.offsetMin = new Vector2(8, 16); iconRT.offsetMax = new Vector2(-8, -8);
		iconGO.GetComponent<Image>().enabled = false;
		iconGO.GetComponent<Image>().raycastTarget = false;

		var labelGO = new GameObject("Label", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(TextMeshProUGUI));
		labelGO.transform.SetParent(slotGO.transform, false);
		var labelRT = labelGO.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		labelRT.anchorMin = new Vector2(0, 0); labelRT.anchorMax = new Vector2(1, 0.3f);
		labelRT.offsetMin = Vector2.zero; labelRT.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
		var tmp = labelGO.GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
		tmp.fontSize = 8; tmp.alignment = TextAlignmentOptions.Center; tmp.raycastTarget = false;

		// → count text (bottom-right corner, shows "x3" for stacked items)
		var countGO = new GameObject("Count", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(TextMeshProUGUI));
		countGO.transform.SetParent(slotGO.transform, false);
		var countRT = countGO.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		countRT.anchorMin = new Vector2(0.6f, 0.6f); countRT.anchorMax = new Vector2(1f, 1f);
		countRT.offsetMin = Vector2.zero; countRT.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
		var countTmp = countGO.GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
		countTmp.fontSize = 12; countTmp.alignment = TextAlignmentOptions.BottomRight;
		countTmp.color = Color.yellow; countTmp.raycastTarget = false;

		var relay = slotGO.AddComponent<SlotRelay2>();
		int idx = index;
		relay.onBeginDrag = (e) => OnSlotBeginDrag(idx, e);
		relay.onDrag = (e) => OnSlotDrag(e);
		relay.onEndDrag = (e) => OnSlotEndDrag(idx, e);
		relay.onDrop = (e) => OnSlotDrop(idx, e);
		relay.onPointerDown = (e) => SelectSlot(idx);
		return slotGO;
	}

	GameObject CreateGhost()
	{
		var go = new GameObject("DragGhost", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
		go.transform.SetParent(_canvas.transform, false);
		go.GetComponent<RectTransform>().sizeDelta = new Vector2(50, 50);
		ghostImage = go.GetComponent<Image>();
		ghostImage.raycastTarget = false;
		// → count text on ghost
		var countGO = new GameObject("GhostCount", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(TextMeshProUGUI));
		countGO.transform.SetParent(go.transform, false);
		var crt = countGO.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		crt.anchorMin = new Vector2(0.5f, 0f); crt.anchorMax = new Vector2(1f, 0.5f);
		crt.offsetMin = Vector2.zero; crt.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
		ghostCountText = countGO.GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
		ghostCountText.fontSize = 12; ghostCountText.alignment = TextAlignmentOptions.BottomRight;
		ghostCountText.color = Color.yellow; ghostCountText.raycastTarget = false;
		go.SetActive(false);
		return go;
	}

	GameObject CreateInfoPanel()
	{
		var panel = new GameObject("InfoPanel", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image), typeof(VerticalLayoutGroup));
		panel.transform.SetParent(_canvas.transform, false);
		var rt = panel.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		rt.anchorMin = new Vector2(1f, 0f); rt.anchorMax = new Vector2(1f, 0f);
		rt.pivot = new Vector2(1f, 0f); rt.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(-20, 20);
		rt.sizeDelta = new Vector2(180, 130);
		panel.GetComponent<Image>().color = new Color(0.15f, 0.15f, 0.15f, 0.95f);
		var vlg = panel.GetComponent<VerticalLayoutGroup>();
		vlg.spacing = 5; vlg.padding = new RectOffset(10, 10, 10, 10);
		vlg.childForceExpandWidth = true; vlg.childForceExpandHeight = false;

		var nameGO = new GameObject("NameText", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(TextMeshProUGUI));
		nameGO.transform.SetParent(panel.transform, false);
		infoNameText = nameGO.GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
		infoNameText.fontSize = 18; infoNameText.alignment = TextAlignmentOptions.Center;
		infoNameText.color = Color.white;
		nameGO.AddComponent<LayoutElement>().preferredHeight = 30;

		CreatePanelButton(panel.transform, "Equip (E)", new Color(0.2f, 0.6f, 0.8f), () => SelectSlot(selectedSlot));
		CreatePanelButton(panel.transform, "Drop (G)", new Color(0.8f, 0.3f, 0.2f), () => DropFromSlot(selectedSlot));
		panel.SetActive(false);
		return panel;
	}

	void CreatePanelButton(Transform parent, string label, Color color, UnityEngine.Events.UnityAction onClick)
	{
		var btnGO = new GameObject(label, typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image), typeof(Button), typeof(LayoutElement));
		btnGO.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
		btnGO.GetComponent<Image>().color = color;
		btnGO.GetComponent<Button>().onClick.AddListener(onClick);
		btnGO.GetComponent<LayoutElement>().preferredHeight = 35;
		var textGO = new GameObject("Text", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(TextMeshProUGUI));
		textGO.transform.SetParent(btnGO.transform, false);
		var textRT = textGO.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		textRT.anchorMin = Vector2.zero; textRT.anchorMax = Vector2.one;
		textRT.offsetMin = Vector2.zero; textRT.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
		var tmp = textGO.GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
		tmp.text = label; tmp.fontSize = 14; tmp.alignment = TextAlignmentOptions.Center;
		tmp.color = Color.white; tmp.raycastTarget = false;
	}
}

/// <summary> Tags a world cube with its item index so raycast can identify it. </summary>
public class WorldItemTag : MonoBehaviour { public int itemIndex; }

/// <summary> Inline EventSystem relay — same as SlotRelay but separate class name to avoid conflict. </summary>
public class SlotRelay2 : MonoBehaviour,
	IBeginDragHandler, IDragHandler, IEndDragHandler, IDropHandler, IPointerDownHandler
{
	public System.Action<PointerEventData> onBeginDrag, onDrag, onEndDrag, onDrop, onPointerDown;
	public void OnBeginDrag(PointerEventData e) => onBeginDrag?.Invoke(e);
	public void OnDrag(PointerEventData e) => onDrag?.Invoke(e);
	public void OnEndDrag(PointerEventData e) => onEndDrag?.Invoke(e);
	public void OnDrop(PointerEventData e) => onDrop?.Invoke(e);
	public void OnPointerDown(PointerEventData e) => onPointerDown?.Invoke(e);
}

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/prototype/Proto_InventoryFull_SUMMARY.md ==== -->
# Proto_InventoryFull — One-Page Summary

> Standalone prototype: 3D world items + UI inventory + equip/drop + stacking + drag-swap.
> One `.cs` file, zero dependencies. 1-minute setup → full inventory loop.

---

## Setup (1 minute)

1. New empty scene
2. `GameObject → UI → Canvas` (auto-creates EventSystem)
3. Camera at `(0, 3, -5)` looking at origin, tag `MainCamera`
4. Floor: `3D Object → Plane` at `(0, 0, 0)`, scale `(3, 1, 3)`
5. Empty GO → name `Proto_InventoryFull` → add script
6. Wire: `_canvas` → Canvas, `_cam` → Camera
7. **Play**

---

## Architecture

```
                    WORLD (3D)                          UI (Canvas)
            ┌───────────────────┐             ┌──────────────────────┐
            │  4 cubes on floor │             │  5-slot hotbar       │
            │  + 3 Dynamite     │             │  ┌──┬──┬──┬──┬──┐   │
            │  (stackable)      │             │  │01│02│03│04│05│   │
            └────────┬──────────┘             │  └──┴──┴──┴──┴──┘   │
                     │ click                  │                      │
                     ▼                        │  Status: "Equipped:  │
              TryPickup()                     │           Pickaxe"   │
                     │                        │                      │
          ┌──────────┴──────────┐             │  ┌────────────────┐  │
          │ stackable?          │             │  │  Info Panel     │  │
          │ YES → find same     │             │  │  [Equip (E)]   │  │
          │   name slot, qty++  │             │  │  [Drop  (G)]   │  │
          │ NO → find empty slot│             │  └────────────────┘  │
          └──────────┬──────────┘             │                      │
                     │                        │  Ghost (drag icon)   │
                     ▼                        │  follows cursor      │
              slots[i] = item                 └──────────────────────┘
              item.worldGO.SetActive(false)
                     │
              SelectSlot(i) ← auto-equip
                     │
              ┌──────┴──────┐
              │ equippedSlot│ → worldGO floats in front of camera
              └─────────────┘
                     │
              G key or Drop btn
                     │
                     ▼
              DropFromSlot()
              worldGO.SetActive(true)
              rb.isKinematic = false
              rb.linearVelocity = forward + up
              slots[i] = null
              status: "Empty hands"
```

---

## Controls

| Input | Action | What You See |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| **Click cube** | Pick up → first empty slot (or stack) | Cube disappears, icon in slot, floats in front of cam |
| **Click same cube** | Duplicate guard | Nothing — console: "already in inventory" |
| **1-5** | Select slot → auto-equip | Blue highlight on slot, cube visible in front of cam |
| **Same key twice** | Toggle unequip | Cube hides, "Empty hands", green highlight only |
| **Empty slot key** | Select empty | "Empty hands", no cube visible |
| **Scroll wheel** | Cycle occupied slots (skip empty) | Next occupied slot equips |
| **G** | Drop equipped | Cube flies to floor with physics, slot empties |
| **Click slot** | Show info panel | Right panel: name + Equip/Drop buttons |
| **Equip button** | Same as select | Auto-equips |
| **Drop button** | Drop from selected slot | Same as G for that slot |
| **Drag slot → slot** | Swap contents | Icons swap, equipped tracking follows |
| **Drag outside UI** | Drop to world | Item removed, cube appears at camera |

---

## Stacking Example

```
Scene has:  Pickaxe (maxStack:1)  Magnet (maxStack:1)  Hammer (maxStack:1)
            Dynamite×3 (maxStack:5 each — 3 separate cubes on floor)

Step 1: Click Dynamite #1 → slot 0: [Dynamite]        (no count shown, qty=1)
Step 2: Click Dynamite #2 → slot 0: [Dynamite x2]     (yellow "x2" top-right)
Step 3: Click Dynamite #3 → slot 0: [Dynamite x3]     (yellow "x3")
Step 4: Click Pickaxe     → slot 1: [Pickaxe]          (no stacking, maxStack=1)
Step 5: Drag slot 0 → 1  → slot 0: [Pickaxe], slot 1: [Dynamite x3]  (swapped)
```

**Count shows on:**
- Slot icon (top-right, yellow `x3`)
- Ghost drag icon (bottom-right, yellow `x3`)
- Info panel name text (`Dynamite x3`)

---

## Slot Highlight Colors

| State | Color | When |
|-------|-------|------|
| **Equipped** | Blue `(0.2, 0.5, 0.9, 0.4)` | This slot's item is active in front of camera |
| **Selected** | Green `(0.3, 0.8, 0.4, 0.3)` | Cursor/key selected but not equipped (or empty) |
| **Default** | Dark grey `(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.5)` | Unselected |

---

## Edge Cases Checklist

- [ ] Click world cube → disappears, icon appears, cube floats in front of camera
- [ ] Click same cube again → nothing (duplicate guard, console log)
- [ ] Press 1 → equip. Press 1 again → unequip. Press 1 again → re-equip.
- [ ] Press key for empty slot → "Empty hands", no cube visible
- [ ] Scroll wheel → skips empty, lands on next occupied
- [ ] G key → cube falls to floor with physics, "Empty hands"
- [ ] Pick up dropped cube again → works (inInventory flag cleared on drop)
- [ ] Dynamite stacks: 3 clicks → one slot with "x3"
- [ ] Drag stack to another slot → "x3" follows
- [ ] Drag outside UI → item dropped to world
- [ ] Swap equipped slot → equipped tracking follows the swap
- [ ] Info panel shows "Dynamite x3" for stacked items
- [ ] Ghost shows "x3" during drag
- [ ] Console logs every action
- [ ] Zero errors

---

## File Structure

```
Proto_InventoryFull.cs (single file)
│
├── Proto_InventoryFull : MonoBehaviour     ← main class (~480 lines)
│   ├── [SerializeField] _canvas, _cam     ← only 2 wired fields
│   ├── ItemData struct                     ← name, color, worldGO, inInventory, qty, maxStack
│   ├── Start()                             ← spawns 7 world cubes + builds all UI at runtime
│   ├── Update()                            ← input routing + equipped item follows camera
│   ├── TryPickup()                         ← stacking + duplicate guard + auto-equip
│   ├── SelectSlot()                        ← auto-equip/toggle/empty hands
│   ├── DropFromSlot()                      ← physics drop + clear slot
│   ├── Drag handlers                       ← ghost + swap + drop-outside
│   └── UI creation methods                 ← all runtime: slots, ghost, info panel, status text
│
├── WorldItemTag : MonoBehaviour            ← 1 field: public int itemIndex
└── SlotRelay2 : MonoBehaviour              ← IBeginDrag/IDrag/IEndDrag/IDrop/IPointerDown relay
```

---

## How It Maps to Phase B

| Proto Concept | Phase B Real Script |
|--------------|-------------------|
| `ItemData` struct | `IInventoryItem` interface |
| `slots[]` array | `InventoryDataService` + `InventorySlot` entity |
| `SelectSlot()` | `InventoryOrchestrator.SwitchToSlot()` |
| `TryPickup()` | `InventoryOrchestrator.HandleToolPickup()` |
| `DropFromSlot()` | `InventoryOrchestrator.HandleDropActiveItem()` |
| `RefreshAllSlots()` | `InventoryOrchestrator.RefreshAllSlots()` |
| `SlotRelay2` | `UIEventRelay` |
| `WorldItemTag` | `BaseHeldTool` (IInteractable → Take) |
| `CreateSlotGO()` | `Field_InventorySlot` prefab |
| `CreateInfoPanel()` | `Field_SelectedItemInfo` component |
| Status text | Phase H: HUD status display |
| Stacking (qty > 1) | `InventoryDataService.TryAdd()` stacking logic |

<!-- ==== FILE: learn/prototype/Proto_SlotDragDrop.cs ==== -->
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using UnityEngine.EventSystems;
using TMPro;

/// <summary>
/// STANDALONE prototype — drop on an empty scene with Canvas + EventSystem and press Play.
/// Tests: UI slot drag-drop, swap, add slot via button, select slot, ghost icon follows cursor.
/// Zero external dependencies — no GameEvents, no DataService, no InventoryOrchestrator.
/// Everything is created at runtime from code.
///
/// SETUP (takes 30 seconds):
///   1. Create new empty scene
///   2. GameObject → UI → Canvas (auto-creates EventSystem)
///   3. Create empty GO → name "Proto_SlotDragDrop" → add this script
///   4. Wire: _canvas → the Canvas GO
///   5. Press Play
///
/// CONTROLS:
///   A       → add tool to first empty slot + auto-equip (simulates pickup)
///   1-5     → select slot — auto-equips if has item, empty hands if empty
///   Same key twice → toggles equip/unequip (empty hands)
///   Scroll  → cycles through occupied slots (skips empty)
///   G       → drop equipped item (slot empties, "Empty hands")
///   Click   → select slot + show info panel
///   Equip btn → same as selecting (auto-equips)
///   Drop btn  → clears slot, "Empty hands"
///   Drag    → drag slot icon to another slot → swap on drop
///
/// WHAT TO VERIFY:
///   - A adds colored tool to first empty slot + auto-equips (blue highlight + status text)
///   - Press 1 → equip. Press 1 again → unequip (empty hands). Press 1 again → re-equip.
///   - Press empty slot → "Empty hands"
///   - Scroll wheel → skips empty, lands on next occupied
///   - G drops equipped, status shows "Empty hands"
///   - Drag A → B → swap, equipped tracking follows
///   - Drag outside → item dropped
///   - Info panel shows Equip + Drop buttons
///   - Status text (top center): "Equipped: X" or "Empty hands"
///   - Console logs every action
/// </summary>
public class Proto_SlotDragDrop : MonoBehaviour
{
	[SerializeField] Canvas _canvas;

	// runtime data
	struct SlotData 
	{ 
		public bool hasItem; 
		public Color color;
		public string name; 
	}
	List<SlotData> slots = new List<SlotData>();
	List<GameObject> slotGOs = new List<GameObject>();
	GameObject ghostGO;
	Image ghostImage;
	GameObject infoPanelGO;
	TMP_Text infoNameText;
	TMP_Text statusText;
	int selectedIndex = 0;
	int equippedIndex = -1;
	int dragFromIndex = -1;
	int slotCount = 5;
	int toolCounter = 0;
	string[] toolNames = { "Pickaxe", "Magnet", "Hammer", "Hat", "Wrench", "Scanner", "Builder" };

	void Start()
	{
		// → create slot container with HorizontalLayoutGroup
		var container = CreateSlotContainer();
		// → create slots
		for (int i = 0; i < slotCount; i++)
		{
			slots.Add(new SlotData { hasItem = false, color = Color.clear, name = "" });
			slotGOs.Add(CreateSlotGO(container, i));
		}
		// → create ghost (starts hidden)
		ghostGO = CreateGhost();
		// → create Add button
		CreateAddButton();
		// → create info panel with Equip + Drop buttons (starts hidden)
		infoPanelGO = CreateInfoPanel();
		// → create status text (top center)
		statusText = CreateStatusText();
		// → select first slot
		SelectSlot(0);
		UpdateStatus();
		Debug.Log("[Proto] Ready. A=add, 1-5=select/equip, scroll=cycle, G=drop, drag=swap.");
	}

	void Update()
	{
		// A → add tool to first empty slot
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.A)) AddTool();
		// 1-5 → select slot
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha1)) SelectSlot(0);
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha2)) SelectSlot(1);
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha3)) SelectSlot(2);
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha4)) SelectSlot(3);
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha5)) SelectSlot(4);
		// scroll wheel: cycle through occupied slots (skip empty)
		float scroll = Input.GetAxis("Mouse ScrollWheel");
		if (scroll != 0f) ScrollToNextOccupied(scroll > 0f ? 1 : -1);
		// G = drop equipped
		if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.G)) DropEquipped();
	}

	// ─── SLOT ACTIONS ───────────────────────────────────────────

	void AddTool()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < slots.Count; i++)
		{
			if (!slots[i].hasItem)
			{
				string name = toolNames[toolCounter % toolNames.Length];
				Color color = Color.HSVToRGB((toolCounter * 0.15f) % 1f, 0.7f, 0.9f);
				slots[i] = new SlotData { hasItem = true, color = color, name = name };
				toolCounter++;
				// → auto-equip on add (like EquipWhenPickedUp)
				SelectSlot(i);
				Debug.Log($"[Proto] Added '{name}' to slot {i} (auto-equipped)");
				return;
			}
		}
		Debug.Log("[Proto] All slots full!");
	}

	void SelectSlot(int index)
	{
		if (index < 0 || index >= slots.Count) return;
		// → toggle: pressing same slot again unequips (empty hands)
		if (index == equippedIndex)
		{
			equippedIndex = -1;
			selectedIndex = index;
			RefreshAllSlots();
			UpdateStatus();
			Debug.Log($"[Proto] UNEQUIPPED (empty hands)");
			return;
		}
		selectedIndex = index;
		// → auto-equip if slot has item
		if (slots[index].hasItem)
		{
			equippedIndex = index;
			Debug.Log($"[Proto] EQUIPPED: {slots[index].name} (slot {index})");
		}
		else
		{
			equippedIndex = -1;
			Debug.Log($"[Proto] Selected empty slot {index} (empty hands)");
		}
		RefreshAllSlots();
		UpdateStatus();
		ShowInfoPanel(index);
	}

	void ScrollToNextOccupied(int dir)
	{
		int start = selectedIndex;
		for (int i = 0; i < slots.Count; i++)
		{
			int next = (start + dir + slots.Count) % slots.Count;
			start = next;
			if (slots[next].hasItem) { SelectSlot(next); return; }
		}
	}

	void DropEquipped()
	{
		if (equippedIndex < 0 || !slots[equippedIndex].hasItem) return;
		ClearSlot(equippedIndex);
		equippedIndex = -1;
		UpdateStatus();
	}

	void UpdateStatus()
	{
		if (statusText == null) return;
		if (equippedIndex >= 0 && slots[equippedIndex].hasItem)
			statusText.text = $"Equipped: {slots[equippedIndex].name}";
		else
			statusText.text = "Empty hands";
	}

	void SwapSlots(int a, int b)
	{
		if (a < 0 || b < 0 || a >= slots.Count || b >= slots.Count || a == b) return;
		var temp = slots[a];
		slots[a] = slots[b];
		slots[b] = temp;
		// → equipped tracking follows the swap
		if (equippedIndex == a) equippedIndex = b;
		else if (equippedIndex == b) equippedIndex = a;
		RefreshAllSlots();
		UpdateStatus();
		Debug.Log($"[Proto] Swapped slot {a} ↔ {b}");
	}

	void ClearSlot(int index)
	{
		if (index < 0 || index >= slots.Count) return;
		string name = slots[index].name;
		slots[index] = new SlotData { hasItem = false, color = Color.clear, name = "" };
		RefreshAllSlots();
		Debug.Log($"[Proto] Dropped '{name}' from slot {index}");
	}

	void RefreshAllSlots()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < slotGOs.Count; i++)
		{
			var bg = slotGOs[i].GetComponent<Image>();
			var icon = slotGOs[i].transform.Find("Icon").GetComponent<Image>();
			var label = slotGOs[i].transform.Find("Label").GetComponent<TMP_Text>();

			// → background: blue if equipped, green if selected, dark grey otherwise
			bg.color = (i == equippedIndex) ? new Color(0.2f, 0.5f, 0.9f, 0.4f)
				: (i == selectedIndex) ? new Color(0.3f, 0.8f, 0.4f, 0.3f)
				: new Color(0.2f, 0.2f, 0.2f, 0.5f);

			if (slots[i].hasItem)
			{
				icon.enabled = true;
				icon.color = slots[i].color;
				label.text = slots[i].name;
			}
			else
			{
				icon.enabled = false;
				label.text = "";
			}
		}
	}

	// ─── DRAG-DROP HANDLERS ─────────────────────────────────────

	void OnSlotBeginDrag(int index, PointerEventData e)
	{
		if (!slots[index].hasItem) return;
		dragFromIndex = index;
		// → hide source slot content
		slotGOs[index].transform.Find("Icon").gameObject.SetActive(false);
		slotGOs[index].transform.Find("Label").gameObject.SetActive(false);
		// → show ghost
		ghostGO.SetActive(true);
		ghostImage.color = slots[index].color;
		ghostGO.transform.SetAsLastSibling();
		Debug.Log($"[Proto] Begin drag from slot {index} ({slots[index].name})");
	}

	void OnSlotDrag(PointerEventData e)
	{
		if (dragFromIndex < 0) return;
		ghostGO.transform.position = e.position;
	}

	void OnSlotEndDrag(int index, PointerEventData e)
	{
		// → restore source slot visuals
		slotGOs[index].transform.Find("Icon").gameObject.SetActive(true);
		slotGOs[index].transform.Find("Label").gameObject.SetActive(true);
		ghostGO.SetActive(false);

		// → if dropped outside any slot (no valid drop target received OnDrop)
		if (dragFromIndex >= 0 && e.pointerEnter == null)
			ClearSlot(dragFromIndex);

		dragFromIndex = -1;
		RefreshAllSlots();
	}

	void OnSlotDrop(int targetIndex, PointerEventData e)
	{
		if (dragFromIndex < 0 || dragFromIndex == targetIndex) return;
		SwapSlots(dragFromIndex, targetIndex);
	}

	void OnSlotClick(int index)
	{
		SelectSlot(index);
		// → show info panel if slot has item, hide if empty
		ShowInfoPanel(index);
	}

	void ShowInfoPanel(int index)
	{
		var s = slots[index];
		if (!s.hasItem) { infoPanelGO.SetActive(false); return; }
		infoPanelGO.SetActive(true);
		infoNameText.text = s.name;
		Debug.Log($"[Proto] Info panel: {s.name} — Equip or Drop?");
	}

	void EquipSelected()
	{
		// → "equip" just means select it (highlight green)
		if (!slots[selectedIndex].hasItem) return;
		Debug.Log($"[Proto] EQUIPPED: {slots[selectedIndex].name} (slot {selectedIndex} highlighted)");
		infoPanelGO.SetActive(false);
	}

	void DropSelected()
	{
		if (!slots[selectedIndex].hasItem) return;
		string name = slots[selectedIndex].name;
		ClearSlot(selectedIndex);
		infoPanelGO.SetActive(false);
		Debug.Log($"[Proto] DROPPED: {name} from slot {selectedIndex}");
	}

	// ─── UI CREATION (all runtime) ──────────────────────────────

	Transform CreateSlotContainer()
	{
		var go = new GameObject("SlotContainer", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(HorizontalLayoutGroup), typeof(Image));
		go.transform.SetParent(_canvas.transform, false);
		var rt = go.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		rt.anchorMin = new Vector2(0.5f, 0f);
		rt.anchorMax = new Vector2(0.5f, 0f);
		rt.pivot = new Vector2(0.5f, 0f);
		rt.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(0, 20);
		rt.sizeDelta = new Vector2(slotCount * 80 + 20, 90);
		var hlg = go.GetComponent<HorizontalLayoutGroup>();
		hlg.spacing = 5;
		hlg.padding = new RectOffset(5, 5, 5, 5);
		hlg.childAlignment = TextAnchor.MiddleCenter;
		go.GetComponent<Image>().color = new Color(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.8f);
		return go.transform;
	}

	GameObject CreateSlotGO(Transform parent, int index)
	{
		// → slot background
		var slotGO = new GameObject($"Slot_{index}", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
		slotGO.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
		var rt = slotGO.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		rt.sizeDelta = new Vector2(70, 70);
		slotGO.GetComponent<Image>().color = new Color(0.2f, 0.2f, 0.2f, 0.5f);
		// → IMPORTANT: raycastTarget = true on the slot background (receives drop events)
		slotGO.GetComponent<Image>().raycastTarget = true;

		// → icon (colored square representing a tool)
		var iconGO = new GameObject("Icon", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
		iconGO.transform.SetParent(slotGO.transform, false);
		var iconRT = iconGO.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		iconRT.anchorMin = Vector2.zero; iconRT.anchorMax = Vector2.one;
		iconRT.offsetMin = new Vector2(8, 16); iconRT.offsetMax = new Vector2(-8, -8);
		iconGO.GetComponent<Image>().enabled = false;
		iconGO.GetComponent<Image>().raycastTarget = false; // icon must NOT block drop events

		// → label
		var labelGO = new GameObject("Label", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(TextMeshProUGUI));
		labelGO.transform.SetParent(slotGO.transform, false);
		var labelRT = labelGO.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		labelRT.anchorMin = new Vector2(0, 0); labelRT.anchorMax = new Vector2(1, 0.3f);
		labelRT.offsetMin = Vector2.zero; labelRT.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
		var tmp = labelGO.GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
		tmp.fontSize = 8; tmp.alignment = TextAlignmentOptions.Center;
		tmp.raycastTarget = false;

		// → add EventSystem relay (inline — no separate UIEventRelay script needed)
		var relay = slotGO.AddComponent<SlotRelay>();
		int idx = index; // capture for closure
		relay.onBeginDrag = (e) => OnSlotBeginDrag(idx, e);
		relay.onDrag = (e) => OnSlotDrag(e);
		relay.onEndDrag = (e) => OnSlotEndDrag(idx, e);
		relay.onDrop = (e) => OnSlotDrop(idx, e);
		relay.onPointerDown = (e) => OnSlotClick(idx);

		return slotGO;
	}

	GameObject CreateGhost()
	{
		var go = new GameObject("DragGhost", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
		go.transform.SetParent(_canvas.transform, false);
		var rt = go.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		rt.sizeDelta = new Vector2(50, 50);
		ghostImage = go.GetComponent<Image>();
		ghostImage.raycastTarget = false; // CRITICAL: ghost must not block drop targets
		go.SetActive(false);
		return go;
	}

	GameObject CreateInfoPanel()
	{
		// → panel background
		var panel = new GameObject("InfoPanel", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image), typeof(VerticalLayoutGroup));
		panel.transform.SetParent(_canvas.transform, false);
		var rt = panel.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
		rt.anchorMin = new Vector2(1f, 0f);
		rt.anchorMax = new Vector2(1f, 0f);
		rt.pivot = new Vector2(1f, 0f);
		rt.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(-20, 20);
		rt.sizeDelta = new Vector2(180, 130);
